duas.title: Supplications for when you wake up (1 of 4)
duas.arabic: الْحَمْدُ للَّهِ الَّذِي أَحْيَانَا بَعْدَ مَا أَمَاتَنَا، وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ
duas.transliteration: Al-ḥamdu li-llāhi alladhī aḥyānā baʿda mā amātanā, wa ilayhi an-nushūr
duas.translation: All praise is for Allah who gave us life after having taken it from us and unto Him is the resurrection.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Supplications for when you wake up · Entry 1
duas.chapterTitle: Supplications for when you wake up

duas.title: Supplications for when you wake up (2 of 4)
duas.arabic: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَريكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ للَّهِ، وَلاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ، وَاللَّهُ أَكبَرُ، وَلاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِاللَّهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْعَظِيمِ، رَبِّ اغْفرْ لِي
duas.transliteration: Lā ilāha illā llāhu waḥdahu lā sharyka lahu, lahu l-mulku walahu l-ḥamdu, wahuwa ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīrun, subḥāna llāhi, wa-l-ḥamdu li-llāhi, walā ilāha illā llāhu, wa-llāhu akbaru, walā ḥawla walā quwwata illā bi-llāhi l-ʿaliyyi l-ʿaẓīmi, rabbi ighfr lī
duas.translation: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone without associate, to Him belongs sovereignty and praise and He is over all things wholly capable. How perfect Allah is, and all praise is for Allah, and none has the right to be worshipped except Allah, Allah is the greatest and there is no power nor might except with Allah, The Most High, The Supreme. O my Lord forgive me
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Supplications for when you wake up · Entry 2
duas.chapterTitle: Supplications for when you wake up

duas.title: Supplications for when you wake up (3 of 4)
duas.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي عَافَانِي فِي جَسَدِي، وَرَدَّ عَلَيَّ رُوحِي، وَأَذِنَ لي بِذِكْرِهِ
duas.transliteration: Al-ḥamdu li-llāhi alladhī ʿāfānī fī jasadī, waradda ʿalayya rūḥī, wa adhina ly bi-dhikrih
duas.translation: All praise is for Allah who restored to me my health and returned my soul and has allowed me to remember Him.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Supplications for when you wake up · Entry 3
duas.chapterTitle: Supplications for when you wake up

duas.title: Supplications for when you wake up (4 of 4)
duas.arabic: ﴿ إِنَّ فِي خَلْقِ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ وَاخْتِلاَفِ اللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ لَآيَاتٍ لأُوْلِي الألْبَابِ * الَّذِينَ يَذْكُرُونَ اللَّهَ قِيَاماً وَقُعُوداً وَعَلَىَ جُنُوبِهِمْ وَيَتَفَكَّرُونَ فِي خَلْقِ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ رَبَّنَا مَا خَلَقْتَ هَذا بَاطِلاً سُبْحَانَكَ فَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ* رَبَّنَا إِنَّكَ مَن تُدْخِلِ النَّارَ فَقَدْ أَخْزَيْتَهُ وَمَا لِلظَّالِمِينَ مِنْ أَنصَارٍ* رَّبَّنَا إِنَّنَا سَمِعْنَا مُنَادِياً يُنَادِي لِلإِيمَانِ أَنْ آمِنُواْ بِرَبِّكُمْ فَآمَنَّا رَبَّنَا فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَكَفِّرْ عَنَّا سَيِّئَاتِنَا وَتَوَفَّنَا مَعَ الأبْرَارِ* رَبَّنَا وَآتِنَا مَا وَعَدتَّنَا عَلَى رُسُلِكَ وَلاَ تُخْزِنَا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ إِنَّكَ لاَ تُخْلِفُ الْمِيعَادَ* فَاسْتَجَابَ لَهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ أَنِّي لاَ أُضِيعُ عَمَلَ عَامِلٍ مِّنكُم مِّن ذَكَرٍ أَوْ أُنثَى بَعْضُكُم مِّن بَعْضٍ فَالَّذِينَ هَاجَرُواْ وَأُخْرِجُواْ مِن دِيَارِهِمْ وَأُوذُواْ فِي سَبِيلِي وَقَاتَلُواْ وَقُتِلُواْ لأُكَفِّرَنَّ عَنْهُمْ سَيِّئَاتِهِمْ وَلأُدْخِلَنَّهُمْ جَنَّاتٍ تَجْرِي مِن تَحْتِهَا الأَنْهَارُ ثَوَاباً مِّن عِندِ اللَّهِ وَاللَّهُ عِندَهُ حُسْنُ الثَّوَابِ * لاَ يَغُرَّنَّكَ تَقَلُّبُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ فِي الْبِلاَدِ * مَتَاعٌ قَلِيلٌ ثُمَّ مَأْوَاهُمْ جَهَنَّمُ وَبِئْسَ الْمِهَادُ * لَكِنِ الَّذِينَ اتَّقَوْاْ رَبَّهُمْ لَهُمْ جَنَّاتٌ تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الأَنْهَارُ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا نُزُلاً مِّنْ عِندِ اللَّهِ وَمَا عِندَ اللَّهِ خَيْرٌ لِّلأَبْرَارِ * وَإِنَّ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ لَمَن يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَمَا أُنزِلَ إِلَيْكُمْ وَمَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْهِمْ خَاشِعِينَ لِلَّهِ لاَ يَشْتَرُونَ بِآيَاتِ اللَّهِ ثَمَناً قَلِيلاً أُوْلَئِكَ لَهُمْ أَجْرُهُمْ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ إِنَّ اللَّهَ سَرِيعُ الْحِسَابِ*يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُواْ اصْبِرُواْ وَصَابِرُواْ وَرَابِطُواْ وَاتَّقُواْ اللَّهَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ ﴾
duas.transliteration: Inna fī khalqi as-samawāti wa-l-ʾarḍi wa ikhtilāfi l-layli wa an-nahāri lāyātin lʾūlī l-ʾlbābi alladhīna yadhkurūna llāha qiyāman wa quʿūdan wa ʿalaya junūbihim wa yatafakkarūna fī khalqi as-samawāti wa-l-ʾarḍi rabbanā mā khalaqta hādhā bāṭilan subḥānaka fa qinā ʿadhāba an-nāri rabbanā innaka man tudkhili an-nāra faqad akhzaytahu wamā li-lẓẓālimīna min anṣārin rrabbanā innanā samiʿnā munādīan yunādī li-lʾīmāni an āminū bi-rabbikum fa āmannā rabbanā fa ighfir lanā dhunūbanā wa kaffir ʿannā sayyiʾātinā wa tawaffanā maʿa l-ʾbrāri rabbanā wa ātinā mā wa ʿadttanā ʿalā rusulika walā tukhzinā yawma l-qiyāmati innaka lā tukhlifu l-mīʿāda fa istajāba lahum rabbuhum annī lā uḍīʿu ʿamala ʿāmilin mminkum mmin dhakarin aw unthā baʿḍukum mmin baʿḍin fa alladhīna hājarū wa ukhrijū min diyārihim wa ūdhū fī sabīlī wa qātalū wa qutilū lʾukaffiranna ʿanhum sayyiʾātihim wa lʾudkhilannahum jannātin tajrī min taḥtihā l-ʾanhāru thawāban mmin ʿindi llāhi wa-llāhu ʿindahu ḥusnu ath-thawābi lā yaghurrannaka taqallubu alladhīna ka-fa rū fī l-bilādi matāʿun qalīlun thumma maʾwāhum jahannamu wa biʾsa l-mihādu lākini alladhīna ttaqaw rabbahum lahum jannātun tajrī min taḥtihā l-ʾanhāru khālidīna fīhā nuzulan mmin ʿindi llāhi wamā ʿinda llāhi khayrun llilʾabrāri waʾinna min ahli l-kitābi laman yuʾminu bi-llāhi wamā unzila ilaykum wamā unzila ilayhim khāshiʿīna li-llāhi lā yashtarūna bi-āyāti llāhi thamanan qalīlan ūlaʾika lahum ajruhum ʿinda rabbihim inna llāha sarīʿu l-ḥisābi yā ayyuhā alladhīna āmanū iṣbirū wa ṣābirū wa rābiṭū wāttaqū llāha laʿallakum tufliḥūn
duas.translation: 190 In the creation of the heavens and the earth, and in the alternation of night and day, are signs for people of understanding. 191 They remember Allah while standing, sitting, and lying on their sides, and they reflect on the creation of the heavens and the earth: “Our Lord, You did not create this without purpose. Glory be to You; protect us from the punishment of the Fire.” 192 “Our Lord, anyone You admit to the Fire is truly disgraced, and the wrongdoers will have no helpers.” 193 “Our Lord, we heard a caller inviting people to faith: ‘Believe in your Lord,’ and we believed. Our Lord, forgive our sins, erase our misdeeds, and let us die among the righteous.” 194 “Our Lord, grant us what You promised through Your messengers, and do not disgrace us on the Day of Resurrection. You never break Your promise.” 195 Their Lord answered them: “I will never let the work of any of you be lost, whether male or female; you are from one another. I will erase the misdeeds of those who emigrated, were driven from their homes, were harmed in My cause, fought, or were killed, and I will admit them to gardens beneath which rivers flow—a reward from Allah. With Allah is the finest reward.” 196 Do not be deceived by the freedom with which the disbelievers move through the land. 197 It is only a brief enjoyment; then Hell will be their home—and what a miserable resting place. 198 But those who are mindful of their Lord will have gardens beneath which rivers flow, where they will remain: a welcome from Allah. What is with Allah is better for the righteous. 199 Among the People of the Scripture are those who believe in Allah, in what was revealed to you, and in what was revealed to them. They humble themselves before Allah and do not trade Allah’s revelations for a small price. Their reward is with their Lord; Allah is swift in reckoning. 200 Believers, be steadfast, outdo one another in steadfastness, remain ready, and be mindful of Allah so that you may succeed.

duas.title: Invocation when getting dressed
duas.arabic: الْحَمْدُ للَّهِ الَّذِي كَسَانِي هَذَا (الثَّوْبَ) وَرَزَقَنِيهِ مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِنِّي وَلاَ قُوَّة...
duas.transliteration: Al-ḥamdu li-llāhi alladhī ka-sānī hādhā ath-thawba wa razaqanīhi min ghayri ḥawlin minnī walā quwwah...
duas.translation: All Praise is for Allah who has clothed me with this garment and provided it for me, with no power nor might from myself.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Invocation when getting dressed · Entry 5
duas.chapterTitle: Invocation when getting dressed

duas.title: Invocation when putting on new clothes
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ أَنْتَ كَسَوْتَنِيهِ، أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ خَيْرِهِ وَخَيْرِ مَا صُنِعَ لَهُ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهِ وَشَرِّ مَا صُنِعَ لَهُ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma laka l-ḥamdu anta ka-sawtanīhi, asʾaluka min khayrihi wa khayri mā ṣuniʿa lahu, wa aʿūdhu bika min sharrihi washarri mā ṣuniʿa lah
duas.translation: O Allah, for You is all praise, You have clothed me with it i.e. the garment, I ask You for the good of it and the good for which it was made, and I seek refuge with You from the evil of it and the evil for which it was made.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Invocation when putting on new clothes · Entry 6
duas.chapterTitle: Invocation when putting on new clothes

duas.title: Invocations for someone who has put on new clothes (1 of 2)
duas.arabic: تُبْلِي وَيُخْلِفُ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى
duas.transliteration: Tublī wa yukhlifu llāhu taʿālā
duas.translation: May you wear it out and Allah تعالى replace it with another.’
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Invocations for someone who has put on new clothes · Entry 7
duas.chapterTitle: Invocations for someone who has put on new clothes

duas.title: Invocations for someone who has put on new clothes (2 of 2)
duas.arabic: اِلْبَسْ جَدِيداً وَعِشْ حَمِيداً وَمُتْ شَهِيداً
duas.transliteration: Al-bas jadīdan waʿish ḥamīdan wamut shahīdā
duas.translation: Wear anew, live commendably and die a shaheed.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Invocations for someone who has put on new clothes · Entry 8
duas.chapterTitle: Invocations for someone who has put on new clothes

duas.title: Invocation for entering the restroom
duas.arabic: [بِسْمِ اللَّهِ] اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْخُبْثِ وَالْخَبائِث
duas.transliteration: Bismi llāhi llāhumma innī aʿūdhu bika mina l-khubthi wa-l-khabʾith
duas.translation: In the name of Allah. O Allah, I take refuge with you from all evil and evil-doers.

duas.transliteration: Bismi llāh

duas.title: What to say upon completing ablution (1 of 3)
duas.arabic: أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّداً عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ..
duas.transliteration: Ashhadu an lā ilāha illā llāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lahu wa ashhadu anna muḥammadan ʿabduhu wa rasūluh..
duas.translation: I bear witness that none has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone without partner, and I bear witness that Muhammad is His slave and Messenger.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · What to say upon completing ablution · Entry 13
duas.chapterTitle: What to say upon completing ablution

duas.title: What to say upon completing ablution (2 of 3)
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْنِي مِنَ التَّوَّابِينَ وَاجْعَلْنِي مِنَ الْمُتَطَهِّرِينَ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma ijʿalnī mina at-tawwābīna wa ijʿalnī mina l-mutaṭahhirīn
duas.translation: O Allah, make me of those who return to You often in repentance and make me of those who remain clean and pure.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · What to say upon completing ablution · Entry 14
duas.chapterTitle: What to say upon completing ablution

duas.title: What to say upon completing ablution (3 of 3)
duas.arabic: سُبْحانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ، أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ وَأَتوبُ إِلَيْكَ
duas.transliteration: Subḥnaka llāhumma wa bi-ḥamdika, ashhadu an lā ilāha illā anta, astaghfiruka wa atwbu ilayk
duas.translation: How perfect You are O Allah, and I praise You, I bear witness that none has the right to be worshipped except You, I seek Your forgiveness and turn in repentance to You.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · What to say upon completing ablution · Entry 15
duas.chapterTitle: What to say upon completing ablution

duas.title: What to say when leaving the home (1 of 2)
duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللَّهِ، وَلَاَ حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِاللَّهِ
duas.transliteration: Bismi llāhi, tawakkaltu ʿalā llāhi, walā ḥawla walā quwwata illā bi-llāh
duas.translation: In the name of Allah, I place my trust in Allah, and there is no might nor power except with Allah.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · What to say when leaving the home · Entry 16
duas.chapterTitle: What to say when leaving the home

duas.title: What to say when leaving the home (2 of 2)
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ أَضِلَّ، أَوْ أُضَلَّ، أَوْ أَزِلَّ، أَوْ أُزَلَّ، أَوْ أَظْلِمَ، أَوْ أُظْلَمَ، أَوْ أَجْهَلَ، أَوْ يُجْهَلَ عَلَيَّ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma innī aʿūdhu bika an aḍilla, aw uḍalla, aw azilla, aw uzalla, aw aẓlima, aw uẓlama, aw ajhala, aw yujhala ʿalayya
duas.translation: O Allah, I take refuge with You lest I should stray or be led astray, or slip or be tripped, or oppress or be oppressed, or behave foolishly or be treated foolishly.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · What to say when leaving the home · Entry 17
duas.chapterTitle: What to say when leaving the home

duas.title: What to say when entering the home
duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَلَجْنَا، وَبِسْمِ اللَّهِ خَرَجْنَا، وَعَلَى اللَّهِ رَبِّنَا تَوَكَّلْنَا، ثُمَّ لِيُسَلِّمْ عَلَى أَهْلِهِ
duas.transliteration: Bismi llāhi wa lajnā, wa bismi llāhi kharajnā, wa ʿalā llāhi rabbinā tawakkalnā, thumma li-yusallim ʿalā ahlih
duas.translation: In the name of Allah we enter and in the name of Allah we leave, and upon our Lord we place our trust.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · What to say when entering the home · Entry 18
duas.chapterTitle: What to say when entering the home

duas.title: Invocation for going to the mosque
duas.arabic: (اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ فِي قَلْبِي نُوراً، وَفِي لِسَانِي نُوراً، وَفِي سَمْعِي نُوراً، وَفِي بَصَرِي نُوراً، وَمِنْ فَوْقِي نُوراً، وَمِنْ تَحْتِي نُوراً، وَعَنْ يَمِينِي نُوراً، وَعَنْ شِمَالِي نُوراً، وَمِنْ أَمَامِي نُوراً، وَمِنْ خَلْفِي نُوراً، وَاجْعَلْ فِي نَفْسِي نُوراً، وَأَعْظِمْ لِي نُوراً، وَعَظِّم لِي نُوراً، وَاجْعَلْ لِي نُوراً، وَاجْعَلْنِي نُوراً، اللَّهُمَّ أَعْطِنِي نُوراً، وَاجْعَلْ فِي عَصَبِي نُوراً، وَفِي لَحْمِي نُوراً، وَفِي دَمِي نُوراً، وَفِي شَعْرِي نُوراً، وَفِي بَشَرِي نُوراً)([اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ لِي نُوراً فِي قَبْرِي... وَنُوراً فِي عِظَامِي])[(وَزِدْنِي نُوراً، وَزِدْنِي نُوراً، وَزِدْنِي نُوراً)][(وَهَبْ لِي نُوراً عَلَى نُورٍ)]
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma ijʿal fī qalbī nūran, wa fī li-sānī nūran, wa fī samʿī nūran, wa fī baṣarī nūran, wamin fawqī nūran, wamin taḥtī nūran, waʿan yamīnī nūran, waʿan shimālī nūran, wamin amāmī nūran, wamin khalfī nūran, wa ijʿal fī nafsī nūran, wa aʿẓim lī nūran, wa ʿaẓẓim lī nūran, wa ijʿal lī nūran, wa ijʿalnī nūran, allāhumma aʿṭinī nūran, wa ijʿal fī ʿaṣabī nūran, wa fī laḥmī nūran, wa fī damī nūran, wa fī shaʿrī nūran, wa fī basharī nūran allāhumma ijʿal lī nūran fī qabrī... wa nūran fī ʿiẓāmī wa zidnī nūran, wa zidnī nūran, wa zidnī nūran wahab lī nūran ʿalā nūr
duas.translation: ‘O Allaah, place within my heart light; and upon my tongue light; and within my ears light; and within my eyes light; and place above me light; and beneath me light; and on my right light; and on my left light; and in front of me light; and behind me light; and place light within my soul; and augment light for me; and greaten light for me; and grant me light and make me light. O Allaah, bestow upon me light; and place light in my tendons; and light in my flesh; and light in my blood; and in light in my hair and light in my skin.’ [O Allaah, place light for me in my grave and light in my bones]. [And increase me with light and increase me with light and increase me with light]. [And grant me light upon light.]’
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Invocation for going to the mosque · Entry 19
duas.chapterTitle: Invocation for going to the mosque

duas.title: Invocation for entering the mosque
duas.arabic: ((أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ العَظِيمِ، وَبِوَجْهِهِ الْكَرِيمِ، وَسُلْطَانِهِ الْقَدِيمِ، مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ)) [بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، وَالصَّلَاةُ] [وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ] ((اللَّهُمَّ افْتَحْ لِي أَبْوَابَ رَحْمَتِكَ))
duas.transliteration: Aʿūdhu bi-llāhi l-ʿaẓīmi, wa bi-wajhihi l-karīmi, wa sulṭānihi l-qadīmi, mina ash-shayṭāni ar-rajīmi bismi llāhi, wa aṣ-ṣalātu wa as-salāmu ʿalā rasūli llāhi llāhumma iftaḥ lī abwāba raḥmatik
duas.translation: I take refuge with Allah, The Supreme and with His Noble Face, and His eternal authority from the accursed devil. In the name of Allah, and prayers and peace be upon the Messenger of Allah. O Allah, open the gates of Your mercy for me.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Invocation for entering the mosque · Entry 20
duas.chapterTitle: Invocation for entering the mosque

duas.title: Invocation for leaving the mosque
duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَالصّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِك، اللَّهُمَّ اعْصِمْنِي مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ
duas.transliteration: Bismi llāhi wa aṣ-ṣlātu wa as-salāmu ʿalā rasūli llāhi, allāhumma innī asʾaluka min faḍlik, allāhumma iʿṣimnī mina ash-shayṭāni ar-rajīm
duas.translation: In the name of Allah, and prayers and peace be upon the Messenger of Allah. O Allah, I ask You from Your favour. O Allah, guard me from the accursed devil.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Invocation for leaving the mosque · Entry 21
duas.chapterTitle: Invocation for leaving the mosque

duas.title: What to say upon hearing the Athan (call to prayer) (1 of 5)
duas.arabic: لاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِاللَّهِ
duas.transliteration: Lā ḥawla walā quwwata illā bi-llāh
duas.translation: ‘There is no might nor power except with Allah.’
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · What to say upon hearing the Athan (call to prayer) · Entry 22
duas.chapterTitle: What to say upon hearing the Athan (call to prayer)

duas.title: What to say upon hearing the Athan (call to prayer) (2 of 5)
duas.arabic: وَأَنَا أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّداً عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ، رَضِيتُ بِاللَّهِ رَبَّاً، وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ رَسُولاً، وَبِالْإِسْلاَمِ دِينَاً
duas.transliteration: Wa anā ashhadu an lā ilāha illā llāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lahu waʾanna muḥammadan ʿabduhu wa rasūluhu, raḍītu bi-llāhi rabbā, wa bi-muḥammadin rasūlan, wa bi-l-ʾislāmi dīnā
duas.translation: ‘And I too bear witness that none has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner, and that Muhammad is His salve and Messenger. I am pleased with Allah as a Lord, and Muhammad as a Messenger and Islam as a religion.’
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · What to say upon hearing the Athan (call to prayer) · Entry 23
duas.chapterTitle: What to say upon hearing the Athan (call to prayer)

duas.title: What to say upon hearing the Athan (call to prayer) (4 of 5)
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ هَذِهِ الدَّعْوَةِ التَّامَّةِ، وَالصَّلاَةِ الْقَائِمَةِ، آتِ مُحَمَّداً الْوَسِيلَةَ وَالْفَضِيلَةَ، وَابْعَثْهُ مَقَامَاً مَحمُوداً الَّذِي وَعَدْتَهُ، إِنَّكَ لَا تُخْلِفُ الْمِيعَادَ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma rabba hādhihi ad-daʿwati at-tāmmati, wa aṣ-ṣalāti l-qāʾimati, āti muḥammadan al-wasīlata wa-l-faḍīlata, wa ibʿathhu maqāmā maḥmūdan alladhī wa ʿadtahu, innaka lā tukhlifu l-mīʿād
duas.translation: ‘O Allah, Owner of this perfect call and Owner of this prayer to be performed, bestow upon Muhammad al-waseelah and al-fadeelah and send him upon a praised platform which You have promised him. Verily, You never fail in Your promise.’
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · What to say upon hearing the Athan (call to prayer) · Entry 25
duas.chapterTitle: What to say upon hearing the Athan (call to prayer)

duas.title: Invocations for the beginning of the prayer (1 of 6)
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بَاعِدْ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَ خَطَايَايَ كَمَا بَاعَدْتَ بَيْنَ الْمَشْرِقِ وَالْمَغْرِبِ، اللَّهُمَّ نَقِّنِي مِنْ خَطَايَايَ كَمَا يُنَقَّى الثَّوْبُ الْأَبْيَضُ مِنَ الدَّنَسِ، اللَّهُمَّ اغْسِلْني مِنْ خَطَايَايَ، بِالثَّلْجِ وَالْماءِ وَالْبَرَدِ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma bāʿid baynī wa bayna khaṭāyāya kamā bāʿadta bayna l-mashriqi wa-l-maghribi, allāhumma naqqinī min khaṭāyāya kamā yunaqqā ath-thawbu l-ʾabyaḍu mina ad-danasi, allāhumma ighsilny min khaṭāyāya, bi-ath-thalji wa-l-mʾi wa-l-barad
duas.translation: O Allah, distance me from my sins just as You have distanced The East from The West, O Allah, purify me of my sins as a white robe is purified of filth, O Allah, cleanse me of my sins with snow, water, and ice.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Invocations for the beginning of the prayer · Entry 27
duas.chapterTitle: Invocations for the beginning of the prayer

duas.title: Invocations for the beginning of the prayer (2 of 6)
duas.arabic: سُبْحانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ، وَتَبارَكَ اسْمُكَ، وَتَعَالَى جَدُّكَ، وَلاَ إِلَهَ غَيْرُكَ
duas.transliteration: Subḥnaka llāhumma wa bi-ḥamdika, wa tabraka ismuka, wa taʿālā jadduka, walā ilāha ghayruk
duas.translation: How perfect You are O Allah, and I praise You. Blessed be Your name, and lofty is Your position and none has the right to be worshipped except You.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Invocations for the beginning of the prayer · Entry 28
duas.chapterTitle: Invocations for the beginning of the prayer

duas.title: Invocations for the beginning of the prayer (3 of 6)
duas.arabic: وَجَّهْتُ وَجْهِيَ لِلَّذِي فَطَرَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضَ حَنِيفَاً وَمَا أَنَا مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ، إِنَّ صَلاَتِي، وَنُسُكِي، وَمَحْيَايَ، وَمَمَاتِي لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ، لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ وَبِذَلِكَ أُمِرْتُ وَأَنَا مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ. اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ المَلِكُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ، أَنْتَ رَبِّي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ، ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي وَاعْتَرَفْتُ بِذَنْبِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي ذُنُوبي جَمِيعَاً إِنَّهُ لاَ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنوبَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ. وَاهْدِنِي لِأَحْسَنِ الأَخْلاقِ لاَ يَهْدِي لِأَحْسَنِها إِلاَّ أَنْتَ، وَاصْرِفْ عَنِّي سَيِّئَهَا، لاَ يَصْرِفُ عَنِّي سَيِّئَهَا إِلاَّ أَنْتَ، لَبَّيْكَ وَسَعْدَيْكَ، وَالخَيْرُ كُلُّهُ بِيَدَيْكَ، وَالشَّرُّ لَيْسَ إِلَيْكَ، أَنَا بِكَ وَإِلَيْكَ، تَبارَكْتَ وَتَعَالَيْتَ، أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ وَأَتوبُ إِلَيْكَ
duas.transliteration: Wajjahtu wajhiya lilladhī faṭara as-samawāti wa-l-ʾarḍa ḥanīfā wamā anā mina l-mushrikīna, inna ṣalātī, wa nusukī, wa maḥyāya, wa mamātī li-llāhi rabbi l-ʿālamīna, lā sharīka lahu wa bi-dhālika umirtu wa anā mina l-muslimīn. allāhumma anta l-maliku lā ilāha illā anta, anta rabbī wa anā ʿabduka, ẓalamtu nafsī wa iʿtaraftu bi-dhanbī fa ighfir lī dhunūby jamīʿā innahu lā yaghfiru adh-dhunwba illā ant. wa ihdinī li-aḥsani l-ʾakhlqi lā yahdī li-aḥsanih illā anta, wa iṣrif ʿannī sayyiʾahā, lā yaṣrifu ʿannī sayyiʾahā illā anta, labbayka wa saʿdayka, wa-l-khayru kulluhu bi-yadayka, wa ash-sharru laysa ilayka, anā bika wa ilayka, tabrakta wa taʿālayta, astaghfiruka wa atwbu ilayk
duas.translation: I have turned my face sincerely towards He who has brought forth the heavens and the Earth and I am not of those who associate others with Allah. Indeed my prayer, my sacrifice, my life and my death are for Allah, Lord of the worlds, no partner has He, with this I am commanded and I am of the Muslims. O Allah, You are the Sovereign, none has the right to be worshipped except You. You are my Lord and I am Your servant, I have wronged my own soul and have acknowledged my sin, so forgive me all my sins for no one forgives sins except You. Guide me to the best of characters for none can guide to it other than You, and deliver me from the worst of characters for none can deliver me from it other than You. Here I am, in answer to Your call, happy to serve you. All good is within Your hands and evil does not stem from You. I exist by your will and will return to you. Blessed and High are You, I seek Your forgiveness and repent unto You.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Invocations for the beginning of the prayer · Entry 29
duas.chapterTitle: Invocations for the beginning of the prayer

duas.title: Invocations for the beginning of the prayer (4 of 6)
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ جِبْرَائِيلَ، وَمِيْكَائِيلَ، وَإِسْرَافِيلَ، فَاطِرَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ، عَالِمَ الغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ أَنْتَ تَحْكُمُ بَيْنَ عِبَادِكَ فِيمَا كَانُوا فِيهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ. اهْدِنِي لِمَا اخْتُلِفَ فِيهِ مِنَ الْحَقِّ بِإِذْنِكَ إِنَّكَ تَهْدِي مَنْ تَشَاءُ إِلَى صِرَاطٍ مُسْتَقيمٍ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma rabba jibrāʾīla, wa mīkāʾīla, wa isrāfīla, fāṭira as-samawāti wa-l-ʾarḍi, ʿālima l-ghaybi wa ash-shahādati anta taḥkumu bayna ʿibādika fīmā kānū fīhi yakhtalifūn. ihdinī limā ikhtulifa fīhi mina l-ḥaqqi bi-idhnika innaka tahdī man tashāʾu ilā ṣirāṭin mustaqym
duas.translation: O Allah, Lord of Jibra-eel, Meeka-eel and Israfeel great angles, Creator of the heavens and the Earth, Knower of the seen and the unseen. You are the arbitrator between Your servants in that which they have disputed. Guide me to the truth by Your leave, in that which they have differed, for verily You guide whom You will to a straight path.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Invocations for the beginning of the prayer · Entry 30
duas.chapterTitle: Invocations for the beginning of the prayer

duas.title: Invocations for the beginning of the prayer (5 of 6)
duas.arabic: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ كَبِيراً
duas.transliteration: Allāhu akbaru ka-bi-yrā
duas.translation: Allah is Most Great.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Invocations for the beginning of the prayer · Entry 31
duas.chapterTitle: Invocations for the beginning of the prayer

duas.title: Invocations for the beginning of the prayer (5 of 6)
duas.arabic: وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ كَثِيراً
duas.transliteration: Wa-l-ḥamdu li-llāhi ka-thīrā
duas.translation: Much praise is for Allah.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Invocations for the beginning of the prayer · Entry 31
duas.chapterTitle: Invocations for the beginning of the prayer

duas.title: Invocations for the beginning of the prayer (5 of 6)
duas.arabic: وَسُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ بُكْرَةً وَأَصِيلاً
duas.transliteration: Wa subḥāna llāhi bukratan wa aṣīlā
duas.translation: I declare the perfection of Allah in the early morning and in the late afternoon.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Invocations for the beginning of the prayer · Entry 31
duas.chapterTitle: Invocations for the beginning of the prayer

duas.title: Invocations for the beginning of the prayer (5 of 6)
duas.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ: مِنْ نَفْخِهِ، وَنَفْثِهِ، وَهَمْزِهِ
duas.transliteration: Aʿūdhu bi-llāhi mina ash-shayṭāni: min nafkhihi, wa nafthihi, wa hamzih
duas.translation: I take refuge with Allah from the devil, from his pride, his poetry and his madness.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Invocations for the beginning of the prayer · Entry 31
duas.chapterTitle: Invocations for the beginning of the prayer

duas.title: Invocations for the beginning of the prayer (6 of 6)
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ، أَنْتَ نُورُ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ وَمَنْ فِيهِنَّ، وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ أَنْتَ قَيِّمُ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ وَمَنْ فِيهِنَّ، [وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ أَنْتَ رَبُّ السَّمَواتِ وَالأَرْضِ وَمَنْ فِيهِنَّ] [وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ لَكَ مُلْكُ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ وَمَنْ فِيهِنَّ] [وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ أَنْتَ مَلِكُ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ] [وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ] [أَنْتَ الْحَقُّ، وَوَعْدُكَ الْحَقُّ، وَقَوْلُكَ الْحَقُّ، وَلِقاؤُكَ الْحَقُّ، وَالْجَنَّةُ حَقٌّ، وَالنَّارُ حَقٌّ، وَالنَّبِيُّونَ حَقٌّ، وَمحَمَّدٌ صلى الله عليه وسلم حَقٌّ، وَالسّاعَةُ حَقٌّ] [اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ أَسْلَمتُ، وَعَلَيْكَ تَوَكَّلْتُ، وَبِكَ آمَنْتُ، وَإِلَيْكَ أَنَبْتُ، وَبِكَ خاصَمْتُ، وَإِلَيْكَ حاكَمْتُ. فَاغْفِرْ لِي مَا قَدَّمْتُ، وَمَا أَخَّرْتُ، وَمَا أَسْرَرْتُ، وَمَا أَعْلَنْتُ] [أَنْتَ المُقَدِّمُ، وَأَنْتَ المُؤَخِّرُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ] [أَنْتَ إِلَهِي لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ]
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma laka l-ḥamdu, anta nūru as-samawāti wa-l-ʾarḍi waman fīhinna, walaka l-ḥamdu anta qayyimu as-samawāti wa-l-ʾarḍi waman fīhinna, walaka l-ḥamdu anta rabbu as-samawti wa-l-ʾarḍi waman fīhinna walaka l-ḥamdu laka mulku as-samawāti wa-l-ʾarḍi waman fīhinna walaka l-ḥamdu anta maliku as-samawāti wa-l-ʾarḍi walaka l-ḥamdu anta l-ḥaqqu, wa waʿduka l-ḥaqqu, wa qawluka l-ḥaqqu, wa li-qʾuka l-ḥaqqu, wa-l-jannatu ḥaqqun, wa an-nāru ḥaqqun, wa an-nabiyyūna ḥaqqun, wa mḥammadun ṣallā llāh ʿalayhi wa sallam ḥaqqun, wa as-sʿatu ḥaqqun allāhumma laka aslamtu, wa ʿalayka tawakkaltu, wabika āmantu, wa ilayka anabtu, wabika khṣamtu, wa ilayka ḥkamt. fa ighfir lī mā qaddamtu, wamā akhkhartu, wamā asrartu, wamā aʿlantu anta l-muqaddimu, wa anta l-muʾakhkhiru lā ilāha illā anta anta ilahī lā ilāha illā ant
duas.translation: O Allah, to You belongs all praise, You are the Light of the heavens and the Earth and all that is within them. To You belongs all praise, You are the Sustainer of the heavens and the Earth and all that is within them. To You belongs all praise. You are Lord of the heavens and the Earth and all that is within them. To You belongs all praise and the kingdom of the heavens and the Earth and all that is within them. To You belongs all praise, You are the King of the heavens and the Earth and to You belongs all praise. You are The Truth, Your promise is true, your Word is true, and the Day in which we will encounter You is true, the Garden of Paradise is true and the Fire is true, and the Prophets are true, Muhammad is true and the Final Hour is true. O Allah, unto You I have submitted, and upon You I have relied, and in You I have believed, and to You I have turned in repentance, and over You I have disputed, and to You I have turned for judgment. So forgive me for what has come to pass of my sins and what will come to pass, and what I have hidden and what I have made public. You are Al-Muqaddim and Al-Mu-akhkhir. None has the right to be worshipped except You, You are my Deity, none has the right to be worshipped except You.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Invocations for the beginning of the prayer · Entry 32
duas.chapterTitle: Invocations for the beginning of the prayer

duas.title: Invocations during Ruki' (bowing in prayer) (1 of 5)
duas.arabic: سُبْحانَ رَبِّيَ الْعَظِيمِ
duas.transliteration: Subḥna rabbiya l-ʿaẓīm
duas.translation: How perfect my Lord is, The Supreme.’
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Invocations during Ruki' (bowing in prayer) · Entry 33
duas.chapterTitle: Invocations during Ruki' (bowing in prayer)

duas.title: Invocations during Ruki' (bowing in prayer) (2 of 5)
duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَا وَبِحَمْدِكَ، اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي
duas.transliteration: Subḥānaka llāhumma rabbanā wa bi-ḥamdika, allāhumma ighfir lī
duas.translation: How perfect You are O Allah, our Lord and I praise You. O Allah, forgive me.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Invocations during Ruki' (bowing in prayer) · Entry 34
duas.chapterTitle: Invocations during Ruki' (bowing in prayer)

duas.title: Invocations during Ruki' (bowing in prayer) (3 of 5)
duas.arabic: سُبُّوُحٌ، قُدُّوسٌ، رَبُّ المَلاَئِكَةِ وَالرُّوحِ
duas.transliteration: Subbuwuḥun, quddūsun, rabbu l-malāʾikati wa ar-rūḥ
duas.translation: Perfect and Holy He is, Lord of the angles and the Rooh i.e. Jibra-eel.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Invocations during Ruki' (bowing in prayer) · Entry 35
duas.chapterTitle: Invocations during Ruki' (bowing in prayer)

duas.title: Invocations during Ruki' (bowing in prayer) (4 of 5)
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ رَكَعْتُ، وَبِكَ آمَنْتُ، وَلَكَ أَسْلَمْتُ، خَشَعَ لَكَ سَمْعِي، وَبَصَرِي، وَمُخِّي، وَعَظْمِي، وَعَصَبِي، [وَمَا استَقَلَّتْ بِهِ قَدَمِي]
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma laka rakaʿtu, wabika āmantu, walaka aslamtu, khashaʿa laka samʿī, wa baṣarī, wa mukhkhī, wa ʿaẓmī, wa ʿaṣabī, wamā staqallat bihi qadamī
duas.translation: O Allah, unto You I have bowed, and in You I have believed, and to You I have submitted. My hearing, sight, mind, bones, tendons and what my feet carry are humbled before You.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Invocations during Ruki' (bowing in prayer) · Entry 36
duas.chapterTitle: Invocations during Ruki' (bowing in prayer)

duas.title: Invocations during Ruki' (bowing in prayer) (5 of 5)
duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَ ذِي الْجَبَرُوتِ، وَالْمَلَكُوتِ، وَالْكِبْرِيَاءِ، وَالْعَظَمَةِ
duas.transliteration: Subḥāna dhī l-jabarūti, wa-l-malakūti, wa-l-kibriyāʾi, wa-l-ʿaẓamah
duas.translation: How perfect He is, The Possessor of total power, sovereignty, magnificence and grandeur.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Invocations during Ruki' (bowing in prayer) · Entry 37
duas.chapterTitle: Invocations during Ruki' (bowing in prayer)

duas.title: Invocations for rising from the Ruki' (1 of 3)
duas.arabic: سَمِعَ اللَّهُ لِمَنْ حَمِدَهُ
duas.transliteration: Samiʿa llāhu liman ḥamidah
duas.translation: May Allah answer he who praises Him.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Invocations for rising from the Ruki' · Entry 38
duas.chapterTitle: Invocations for rising from the Ruki'

duas.title: Invocations for rising from the Ruki' (2 of 3)
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ، حَمْداً كَثيراً طَيِّباً مُبارَكاً فِيهِ
duas.transliteration: Rabbanā walaka l-ḥamdu, ḥamdan ka-thyran ṭayyiban mubrakan fīh
duas.translation: Our Lord, for You is all praise, an abundant beautiful blessed praise.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Invocations for rising from the Ruki' · Entry 39
duas.chapterTitle: Invocations for rising from the Ruki'

duas.title: Invocations for rising from the Ruki' (3 of 3)
duas.arabic: مِلْءَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَمِلْءَ الأَرْضِ، وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا، وَمِلْءَ مَا شِئْتَ مِنْ شَيءٍ بَعْدُ. أَهلَ الثَّناءِ وَالْمَجْدِ، أَحَقُّ مَا قَالَ الْعَبْدُ، وَكُلُّنَا لَكَ عَبْدٌ. اللَّهُمَّ لاَ مَانِعَ لِمَا أَعْطَيْتَ، وَلاَ مُعْطِيَ لِمَا مَنَعْتَ، وَلاَ يَنْفَعُ ذَا الجَدِّ مِنْكَ الجَدُّ
duas.transliteration: Milʾa as-samawāti wa milʾa l-ʾarḍi, wamā baynahumā, wa milʾa mā shiʾta min shayʾin baʿd. ahla ath-thanʾi wa-l-majdi, aḥaqqu mā qāla l-ʿabdu, wa kullunā laka ʿabd. allāhumma lā māniʿa limā aʿṭayta, walā muʿṭiya limā manaʿta, walā yanfaʿu dhā l-jaddi minka l-jaddu
duas.translation: The heavens and the Earth and all between them abound with Your praises, and all that You will abounds with Your praises. O Possessor of praise and majesty, the truest thing a slave has said of You and we are all Your slaves. O Allah, none can prevent what You have willed to bestow and none can bestow what You have willed to prevent, and no wealth or majesty can benefit anyone, as from You is all wealth and majesty. This supplication is made optionally only in conjunction with the previous one.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Invocations for rising from the Ruki' · Entry 40
duas.chapterTitle: Invocations for rising from the Ruki'

duas.title: Invocations during Sujood (1 of 7)
duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَ رَبِّيَ الأَعْلَى
duas.transliteration: Subḥāna rabbiya l-ʾaʿlā
duas.translation: How perfect my Lord is, The Most High.’
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Invocations during Sujood · Entry 41
duas.chapterTitle: Invocations during Sujood

duas.title: Invocations during Sujood (2 of 7)
duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَا وَبِحَمْدِكَ، اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي
duas.transliteration: Subḥānaka llāhumma rabbanā wa bi-ḥamdika, allāhumma ighfir lī
duas.translation: How perfect You are O Allah, our Lord, and I praise You. O Allah, forgive me.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Invocations during Sujood · Entry 42
duas.chapterTitle: Invocations during Sujood

duas.title: Invocations during Sujood (3 of 7)
duas.arabic: سُبوحٌ، قُدُّوسٌ، رَبُّ الْمَلَائِكَةِ وَالرُّوحِ
duas.transliteration: Subwḥun, quddūsun, rabbu l-malāʾikati wa ar-rūḥ
duas.translation: Perfect and Holy He is, Lord of the angles and the Rooh i.e. Jibra-eel.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Invocations during Sujood · Entry 43
duas.chapterTitle: Invocations during Sujood

duas.title: Invocations during Sujood (4 of 7)
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ سَجَدْتُ وَبِكَ آمَنْتُ، وَلَكَ أَسْلَمْتُ، سَجَدَ وَجْهِيَ لِلَّذِي خَلَقَهُ، وَصَوَّرَهُ، وَشَقَّ سَمْعَهُ وَبَصَرَهُ، تَبَارَكَ اللَّهُ أَحْسنُ الْخَالِقينَ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma laka sajadtu wabika āmantu, walaka aslamtu, sajada wajhiya lilladhī khalaqahu, wa ṣawwarahu, washaqqa samʿahu wa baṣarahu, tabāraka llāhu aḥsnu l-khāliqyn
duas.translation: O Allah, unto You I have prostrated and in You I have believed, and unto You I have submitted. My face has prostrated before He Who created it and fashioned it, and brought forth its faculties of hearing and seeing. Blessed is Allah, the Best of creators.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Invocations during Sujood · Entry 44
duas.chapterTitle: Invocations during Sujood

duas.title: Invocations during Sujood (5 of 7)
duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَ ذِي الْجَبَرُوتِ، وَالْمَلَكُوتِ، وَالْكِبْرِيَاءِ، وَالْعَظَمَةِ
duas.transliteration: Subḥāna dhī l-jabarūti, wa-l-malakūti, wa-l-kibriyāʾi, wa-l-ʿaẓamah
duas.translation: How perfect He is, The Possessor of total power, sovereignty, magnificence and grandeur.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Invocations during Sujood · Entry 45
duas.chapterTitle: Invocations during Sujood

duas.title: Invocations during Sujood (6 of 7)
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي ذَنْبِي كُلَّهُ: دِقَّهُ وَجِلَّهُ، وَأَوَّلَهُ وَآخِرَهُ، وَعَلاَنِيَّتَهُ وَسِرَّهُ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma ighfir lī dhanbī kullahu: diqqahu wa jillahu, wa awwalahu wa ākhirahu, wa ʿalāniyyatahu wa sirrah
duas.translation: O Allah, forgive me all of my sins, the small and great of them, the first and last of them, and the seen and hidden of them.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Invocations during Sujood · Entry 46
duas.chapterTitle: Invocations during Sujood

duas.title: Invocations during Sujood (7 of 7)
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِرِضَاكَ مِنْ سَخَطِكَ، وَبِمُعَافَاتِكَ مِنْ عُقوبَتِكَ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْكَ، لاَ أُحْصِي ثَنَاءً عَلَيْكَ، أَنْتَ كَمَا أَثْنَيْتَ عَلَى نَفْسِكَ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma innī aʿūdhu bi-riḍāka min sakhaṭika, wa bi-muʿāfātika min ʿuqwbatika, wa aʿūdhu bika minka, lā uḥṣī thanāʾan ʿalayka, anta kamā athnayta ʿalā nafsik
duas.translation: O Allah, I take refuge within Your pleasure from Your displeasure and within Your pardon from Your punishment, and I take refuge in You from You. I cannot enumerate Your praise, You are as You have praised Yourself.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Invocations during Sujood · Entry 47
duas.chapterTitle: Invocations during Sujood

duas.title: Invocations for sitting between two prostrations (1 of 2)
duas.arabic: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي، رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي
duas.transliteration: Rabbi ighfir lī, rabbi ighfir lī
duas.translation: My Lord forgive me, My Lord forgive me.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Invocations for sitting between two prostrations · Entry 48
duas.chapterTitle: Invocations for sitting between two prostrations

duas.title: Invocations for sitting between two prostrations (2 of 2)
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي، وَارْحَمْنِي، وَاهْدِنِي، وَاجْبُرْنِي، وَعَافِنِي، وَارْزُقْنِي، وَارْفَعْنِي
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma ighfir lī, wa irḥamnī, wa ihdinī, wa ijburnī, wa ʿāfinī, wa irzuqnī, wa irfaʿnī
duas.translation: O Allah, forgive me, have mercy upon me, guide me, enrich me, give me health, grant me sustenance and raise my rank.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Invocations for sitting between two prostrations · Entry 49
duas.chapterTitle: Invocations for sitting between two prostrations

duas.title: Supplications for prostrating due to recitation of the Qur'an (1 of 2)
duas.arabic: سَجَدَ وَجْهِيَ لِلَّذِي خَلَقَهُ، وَشَقَّ سَمْعَهُ وَبَصَرَهُ بِحَوْلِهِ وَقُوَّتِهِ، ﴿فَتَبارَكَ اللَّهُ أَحْسَنُ الْخَالِقِينَ﴾
duas.transliteration: Sajada wajhiya lilladhī khalaqahu, washaqqa samʿahu wa baṣarahu bi-ḥawlihi wa quwwatihi, fa tabraka llāhu aḥsanu l-khāliqīn
duas.translation: My face fell prostrate before He who created it and brought forth its faculties of hearing and seeing by His might and power.<< So Blessed is Allah, the best of creators.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Supplications for prostrating due to recitation of the Qur'an · Entry 50
duas.chapterTitle: Supplications for prostrating due to recitation of the Qur'an

duas.title: Supplications for prostrating due to recitation of the Qur'an (2 of 2)
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اكْتُبْ لِي بِهَا عِنْدَكَ أَجْراً، وَضَعْ عَنِّي بِهَا وِزْراً، وَاجْعَلْهَا لِي عِنْدَكَ ذُخْراً، وَتَقَبَّلْهَا مِنِّي كَمَا تَقَبَّلْتَهَا مِنْ عَبْدِكَ دَاوُدَ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma iktub lī bihā ʿindaka ajran, waḍaʿ ʿannī bihā wizran, wa ijʿalhā lī ʿindaka dhukhran, wa taqabbalhā minnī kamā taqabbaltahā min ʿabdika dāwud
duas.translation: O Allah, record for me a reward for this prostration, and remove from me a sin. Save it for me and accept it from me just as You had accepted it from Your servant Dawood.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Supplications for prostrating due to recitation of the Qur'an · Entry 51
duas.chapterTitle: Supplications for prostrating due to recitation of the Qur'an

duas.title: Invocation for At-Tashahhud (sitting in prayer)
duas.arabic: التَّحِيَّاتُ لِلَّهِ، وَالصَّلَواتُ، وَالطَّيِّباتُ، السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ أَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ، السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْنَا وَعَلَى عِبَادِ اللَّهِ الصَّالِحِينَ. أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّداً عَبْدُهُ وَرَسولُهُ
duas.transliteration: At-taḥiyyātu li-llāhi, wa aṣ-ṣalawtu, wa aṭ-ṭayyibtu, as-salāmu ʿalayka ayyuhā an-nabiyyu wa raḥmatu llāhi wa barakātuhu, as-salāmu ʿalaynā wa ʿalā ʿibādi llāhi aṣ-ṣāliḥīn. ashhadu an lā ilāha illā llāhu wa ashhadu anna muḥammadan ʿabduhu wa raswluh
duas.translation: At-tahiyyat is for Allah. All acts of worship and good deeds are for Him. Peace and the mercy and blessings of Allah be upon you O Prophet. Peace be upon us and all of Allah’s righteous servants. I bear witness that none has the right to be worshipped except Allah and I bear witness that Muhammad is His slave and Messenger.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Invocation for At-Tashahhud (sitting in prayer) · Entry 52
duas.chapterTitle: Invocation for At-Tashahhud (sitting in prayer)

duas.title: How to recite blessings on the Prophet after the Tashahhud (1 of 2)
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ، وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ، كَمَا صَلَّيتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَعَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ، اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ، كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammadin, wa ʿalā āli muḥammadin, kamā ṣallayta ʿalā ibrāhīma, wa ʿalā āli ibrāhīma, innaka ḥamīdun majīdun, allāhumma bārik ʿalā muḥammadin wa ʿalā āli muḥammadin, kamā bārakta ʿalā ibrāhīma wa ʿalā āli ibrāhīma, innaka ḥamīdun majīd
duas.translation: O Allah, send prayers upon Muhammad and the followers of Muhammad, just as You sent prayers upon Ibraheem and upon the followers of Ibraheem. Verily, You are full of praise and majesty. O Allah, send blessings upon Mohammad and upon the family of Muhammad, just as You sent blessings upon Ibraheem and upon the family of Ibraheem. Verily, You are full of praise and majesty.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · How to recite blessings on the Prophet after the Tashahhud · Entry 53
duas.chapterTitle: How to recite blessings on the Prophet after the Tashahhud

duas.title: How to recite blessings on the Prophet after the Tashahhud (2 of 2)
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أَزْوَاجِهِ وَذُرِّيَّتِهِ، كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ. وَبَارِكْ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أَزْواجِهِ وَذُرِّيَّتِهِ، كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ. إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammadin wa ʿalā azwājihi wa dhurriyyatihi, kamā ṣallayta ʿalā āli ibrāhīm. wa bārik ʿalā muḥammadin wa ʿalā azwjihi wa dhurriyyatihi, kamā bārakta ʿalā āli ibrāhīm. innaka ḥamīdun majīd
duas.translation: O Allah, send prayers upon Muhammad and upon the wives and descendants of Muhammad, just as You sent prayers upon the family of Ibraheem, and send blessings upon Muhammad and upon the wives and descendants of Muhammad, just as You sent blessings upon the family of Ibraheem. Verily, You are full of praise and majesty.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · How to recite blessings on the Prophet after the Tashahhud · Entry 54
duas.chapterTitle: How to recite blessings on the Prophet after the Tashahhud

duas.title: Invocations after the final Tash-ahhud and before ending the prayer (1 of 11)
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ، وَمِنْ عَذَابِ جَهَنَّمَ، وَمِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْمَحْيَا وَالْمَمَاتِ، وَمِنْ شَرِّ فِتْنَةِ الْمَسِيحِ الدَّجَّالِ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma innī aʿūdhu bika min ʿadhābi l-qabri, wamin ʿadhābi jahannama, wamin fitnati l-maḥyā wa-l-mamāti, wamin sharri fitnati l-masīḥi ad-dajjāl
duas.translation: O Allah, I take refuge in You from the punishment of the grave, from the torment of the Fire, from the trials and tribulations of life and death and from the evil affliction of Al-Maseeh Ad-Dajjal.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Invocations after the final Tash-ahhud and before ending the prayer · Entry 55
duas.chapterTitle: Invocations after the final Tash-ahhud and before ending the prayer

duas.title: Invocations after the final Tash-ahhud and before ending the prayer (2 of 11)
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ، وَأَعوذُ بِكَ مِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْمَسِيحِ الدَّجَّالِ، وَأَعوذُ بِكَ مِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْمَحْيَا وَالْمَمَاتِ. اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْمَأْثَمِ وَالْمَغْرَمِ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma innī aʿwdhu bika min ʿadhābi l-qabri, wa aʿwdhu bika min fitnati l-masīḥi ad-dajjāli, wa aʿwdhu bika min fitnati l-maḥyā wa-l-mamāt. allāhumma innī aʿwdhu bika mina l-maʾthami wa-l-maghram
duas.translation: O Allah, I take refuge in You from the punishment of the grave, and I take refuge in You from the temptation and trial of Al-Maseeh Ad-Dajjal, and I take refuge in You from the trials and tribulations of life and death. O Allah, I take refuge in You from sin and debt.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Invocations after the final Tash-ahhud and before ending the prayer · Entry 56
duas.chapterTitle: Invocations after the final Tash-ahhud and before ending the prayer

duas.title: Invocations after the final Tash-ahhud and before ending the prayer (3 of 11)
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي ظُلْماً كَثِيراً، وَلاَ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنوبَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ، فَاغْفِرْ لِي مَغْفِرَةً مِنْ عِنْدِكَ وَارْحَمْنِي، إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الغَفورُ الرَّحيمُ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma innī ẓalamtu nafsī ẓulman ka-thīran, walā yaghfiru adh-dhunwba illā anta, fa ighfir lī maghfiratan min ʿindika wa irḥamnī, innaka anta l-ghafwru ar-raḥīm
duas.translation: O Allah, I have indeed oppressed my soul excessively and none can forgive sin except You, so forgive me a forgiveness from Yourself and have mercy upon me. Surely, You are The Most-Forgiving, The Most-Merciful.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Invocations after the final Tash-ahhud and before ending the prayer · Entry 57
duas.chapterTitle: Invocations after the final Tash-ahhud and before ending the prayer

duas.title: Invocations after the final Tash-ahhud and before ending the prayer (4 of 11)
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي مَا قَدَّمْتُ، وَمَا أَخَّرْتُ، وَمَا أَسْرَرْتُ، وَمَا أَعْلَنْتُ، وَمَا أَسْرَفْتُ، وَمَا أَنْتَ أَعْلَمُ بِهِ مِنِّي. أَنْتَ الْمُقَدِّمُ، وَأَنْتَ الْمُؤَخِّرُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma ighfir lī mā qaddamtu, wamā akhkhartu, wamā asrartu, wamā aʿlantu, wamā asraftu, wamā anta aʿlamu bihi minnī. anta l-muqaddimu, wa anta l-muʾakhkhiru lā ilāha illā ant
duas.translation: O Allah, forgive me for those sins which have come to pass as well as those which shall come to pass, and those I have committed in secret as well as those I have made public, and where I have exceeded all bounds as well as those things about which You are more knowledgeable. You are Al-Muqaddim and Al-Mu-akhkhir. None has the right to be worshipped except You.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Invocations after the final Tash-ahhud and before ending the prayer · Entry 58
duas.chapterTitle: Invocations after the final Tash-ahhud and before ending the prayer

duas.title: Invocations after the final Tash-ahhud and before ending the prayer (5 of 11)
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَعِنِّي عَلَى ذِكْرِكَ، وَشُكْرِكَ، وَحُسْنِ عِبادَتِكَ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma aʿinnī ʿalā dhikrika, wa shukrika, wa ḥusni ʿibdatik
duas.translation: O Allah, help me to remember You, to thank You, and to worship You in the best of manners.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Invocations after the final Tash-ahhud and before ending the prayer · Entry 59
duas.chapterTitle: Invocations after the final Tash-ahhud and before ending the prayer

duas.title: Invocations after the final Tash-ahhud and before ending the prayer (6 of 11)
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْبُخْلِ، وَأَعوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْجُبْنِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ أَنْ أُرَدَّ إِلَى أَرْذَلِ الْعُمُرِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ فِتْنَةِ الدُّنْيَا وَعَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma innī aʿūdhu bika mina l-bukhli, wa aʿwdhu bika mina l-jubni, wa aʿūdhu bika min an uradda ilā ardhali l-ʿumuri, wa aʿūdhu bika min fitnati ad-dunyā wa ʿadhābi l-qabr
duas.translation: O Allah, I take refuge in You from miserliness and cowardice, I take refuge in You lest I be returned to the worst of lives “i.e. old age, being weak, incapable and in a state of fear”, and I take refuge in You from the trials and tribulations of this life and the punishment of the grave.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Invocations after the final Tash-ahhud and before ending the prayer · Entry 60
duas.chapterTitle: Invocations after the final Tash-ahhud and before ending the prayer

duas.title: Invocations after the final Tash-ahhud and before ending the prayer (7 of 11)
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْجَنَّةَ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ النَّارِ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma innī asʾaluka l-jannata wa aʿūdhu bika mina an-nār
duas.translation: O Allah, I ask You to grant me Paradise and I take refuge in You from the Fire.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Invocations after the final Tash-ahhud and before ending the prayer · Entry 61
duas.chapterTitle: Invocations after the final Tash-ahhud and before ending the prayer

duas.title: Invocations after the final Tash-ahhud and before ending the prayer (8 of 11)
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بِعِلْمِكَ الغَيْبَ وَقُدْرَتِكَ عَلَى الْخَلقِ أَحْيِنِي مَا عَلِمْتَ الْحَيَاةَ خَيْراً لِي، وَتَوَفَّنِي إِذَا عَلِمْتَ الْوَفَاةَ خَيْراً لِي، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَشْيَتَكَ فِي الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ كَلِمَةَ الْحَقِّ فِي الرِّضَا وَالْغَضَبِ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ الْقَصْدَ فِي الْغِنَى وَالْفَقْرِ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ نَعِيماً لاَ يَنْفَدُ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ قُرَّةَ عَيْنٍ لاَ تَنْقَطِعُ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ الرِّضَا بَعْدَ الْقَضَاءِ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ بَرْدَ الْعَيْشِ بَعْدَ الْمَوْتِ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ لَذَّةَ النَّظَرِ إِلَى وَجْهِكَ، وَالشَّوْقَ إِلَى لِقائِكَ فِي غَيرِ ضَرَّاءَ مُضِرَّةٍ، وَلاَ فِتْنَةٍ مُضِلَّةٍ، اللَّهُمَّ زَيِّنَا بِزِينَةِ الإِيمَانِ، وَاجْعَلْنَا هُدَاةً مُهْتَدِينَ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma bi-ʿilmika l-ghayba wa qudratika ʿalā l-khalqi aḥyinī mā ʿalimta l-ḥayāta khayran lī, wa tawaffanī idhā ʿalimta l-wafāta khayran lī, allāhumma innī asʾaluka khashyataka fī l-ghaybi wa ash-shahādati, wa asʾaluka ka-limata l-ḥaqqi fī ar-riḍā wa-l-ghaḍabi, wa asʾaluka l-qaṣda fī l-ghinā wa-l-faqri, wa asʾaluka naʿīman lā yanfadu, wa asʾaluka qurrata ʿaynin lā tanqaṭiʿu, wa asʾaluka ar-riḍā baʿda l-qaḍāʾi, wa asʾaluka barda l-ʿayshi baʿda l-mawti, wa asʾaluka ladhdhata an-naẓari ilā wajhika, wa ash-shawqa ilā li-qʾika fī ghayri ḍarrāʾa muḍirratin, walā fitnatin muḍillatin, allāhumma zayyinā bi-zīnati l-ʾīmāni, wa ijʿalnā hudātan muhtadīn
duas.translation: O Allah, by Your knowledge of the unseen and Your power over creation, keep me alive so long as You know such life to be good for me and take me if You know death to be better for me. O Allah, make me fearful of You whether in secret or in public and I ask You to make me true in speech, in times of pleasure and anger. I ask you to make me moderate in times of wealth and poverty and I ask You for everlasting bliss and joy which will never cease. I ask You to make me pleased with what You have decreed and for an easy life after death. I ask You for the sweetness of looking upon Your Face and a longing to encounter You in a manner which does not entail a calamity which will bring about harm nor a trial which will cause deviation. O Allah, beautify us with the adornment of faith and make us of those who guide and are rightly guided.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Invocations after the final Tash-ahhud and before ending the prayer · Entry 62
duas.chapterTitle: Invocations after the final Tash-ahhud and before ending the prayer

duas.title: Invocations after the final Tash-ahhud and before ending the prayer (9 of 11)
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ يَا أَللَّهُ بِأَنَّكَ الْوَاحِدُ الْأَحَدُ الصَّمَدُ الَّذِي لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يولَدْ، وَلَمْ يَكنْ لَهُ كُفُواً أَحَدٌ، أَنْ تَغْفِرَ لِي ذُنُوبِي إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِّيمُ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma innī asʾaluka yā llāhu bi-annaka l-wāḥidu l-ʾaḥadu aṣ-ṣamadu alladhī lam yalid walam ywlad, walam yakn lahu kufūan aḥadun, an taghfira lī dhunūbī innaka anta l-ghafūru ar-raḥīm
duas.translation: O Allah, I ask You O Allah, as You are The One, The Only, AS-Samad, The One who begets not, nor was He begotten and there is none like unto Him that You forgive me my sins for verily You are The Oft-Forgiving, Most-Merciful.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Invocations after the final Tash-ahhud and before ending the prayer · Entry 63
duas.chapterTitle: Invocations after the final Tash-ahhud and before ending the prayer

duas.title: Invocations after the final Tash-ahhud and before ending the prayer (10 of 11)
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِأَنَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدَ لَا إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ وَحْدَكَ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَكَ، الْمَنَّانُ، يَا بَدِيعَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ يَا ذَا الْجَلاَلِ وَالْإِكْرَامِ، يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْجَنَّةَ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ النَّارِ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma innī asʾaluka biʾanna laka l-ḥamda lā ilāha illā anta waḥdaka lā sharīka laka, al-mannānu, yā badīʿa as-samawāti wa-l-ʾarḍi yā dhā l-jalāli wa-l-ʾikrāmi, yā ḥayyu yā qayyūmu innī asʾaluka l-jannata wa aʿūdhu bika mina an-nār
duas.translation: O Allah, I ask You as unto You is all praise, none has the right to be worshipped except You, alone, without partner. You are the Benefactor. O Originator of the heavens and the Earth, O Possessor of majesty and honour, O Ever Living, O Self-Subsisting and Supporter of all, verily I ask You for Paradise and I take refuge with You from the Fire.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Invocations after the final Tash-ahhud and before ending the prayer · Entry 64
duas.chapterTitle: Invocations after the final Tash-ahhud and before ending the prayer

duas.title: Invocations after the final Tash-ahhud and before ending the prayer (11 of 11)
duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِأَنَّي أَشْهَدُ أَنَّكَ أَنْتَ اللَّهُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ الْأَحَدُ الصَّمَدُ الَّذِي لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ كُفُواً أَحَدٌ))
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma innī asʾaluka bi-annay ashhadu annaka anta llāhu lā ilāha illā anta l-ʾaḥadu aṣ-ṣamadu alladhī lam yalid walam yūlad walam yakun lahu kufūan aḥad
duas.translation: O Allah, I ask You, as I bear witness that You are Allah, none has the right to be worshipped except You, The One, AS-Samad Who begets not nor was He begotten and there is none like unto Him.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Invocations after the final Tash-ahhud and before ending the prayer · Entry 65
duas.chapterTitle: Invocations after the final Tash-ahhud and before ending the prayer

duas.title: What to say after completing the prayer (1 of 8)
duas.arabic: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ
duas.transliteration: Astaghfiru llāh
duas.translation: I ask Allah for forgiveness.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · What to say after completing the prayer · Entry 66
duas.chapterTitle: What to say after completing the prayer

duas.title: What to say after completing the prayer (1 of 8)
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ السَّلاَمُ، وَمِنْكَ السَّلاَمُ، تَبَارَكْتَ يَا ذَا الْجَلاَلِ وَالْإِكْرَامِ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma anta as-salāmu, wa minka as-salāmu, tabārakta yā dhā l-jalāli wa-l-ʾikrām
duas.translation: O Allah, You are As-Salam and from You is all peace, blessed are You, O Possessor of majesty and honour.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · What to say after completing the prayer · Entry 66
duas.chapterTitle: What to say after completing the prayer

duas.title: What to say after completing the prayer (2 of 8)
duas.arabic: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
duas.transliteration: Lā ilāha illā llāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lahu, lahu l-mulku walahu l-ḥamdu wahuwa ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīr
duas.translation: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah alone, without partner. To Him belong all sovereignty and praise, and He has power over all things.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · What to say after completing the prayer · Entry 67
duas.chapterTitle: What to say after completing the prayer

duas.title: What to say after completing the prayer (2 of 8)
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لاَ مَانِعَ لِمَا أَعْطَيْتَ، وَلاَ مُعْطِيَ لِمَا مَنَعْتَ، وَلاَ يَنْفَعُ ذَا الْجَدِّ مِنْكَ الجَدُّ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma lā māniʿa limā aʿṭayta, walā muʿṭiya limā manaʿta, walā yanfaʿu dhā l-jaddi minka l-jaddu
duas.translation: O Allah, none can withhold what You give, none can give what You withhold, and no wealth or status can benefit its possessor against You.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · What to say after completing the prayer · Entry 67
duas.chapterTitle: What to say after completing the prayer

duas.title: What to say after completing the prayer (3 of 8)
duas.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ، وَلَهُ الْحَمدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ. لاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِاللَّهِ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ، وَلاَ نَعْبُدُ إِلاَّ إِيَّاهُ, لَهُ النِّعْمَةُ وَلَهُ الْفَضْلُ وَلَهُ الثَّنَاءُ الْحَسَنُ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ الدِّينَ وَلَوْ كَرِهَ الكَافِرُونَ
duas.transliteration: Lā ilāha illā llāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lahu, lahu l-mulku, walahu l-ḥamdu, wahuwa ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīr. lā ḥawla walā quwwata illā bi-llāhi, lā ilāha illā llāhu, walā naʿbudu illā iyyāhu, lahu an-niʿmatu walahu l-faḍlu walahu ath-thanāʾu l-ḥasanu, lā ilāha illā llāhu mukhliṣīna lahu ad-dīna walaw kariha l-kāfirūn
duas.translation: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner, to Him belongs all sovereignty and praise and He is over all things omnipotent. There is no might nor power except with Allah, none has the right to be worshipped except Allah and we worship none except Him. For Him is all favour, grace, and glorious praise. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah and we are sincere in faith and devotion to Him although the disbelievers detest it.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · What to say after completing the prayer · Entry 68
duas.chapterTitle: What to say after completing the prayer

duas.title: What to say after completing the prayer (4 of 8)
duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ
duas.transliteration: Subḥāna llāh
duas.translation: Glory be to Allah.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · What to say after completing the prayer · Entry 69
duas.chapterTitle: What to say after completing the prayer

duas.title: What to say after completing the prayer (4 of 8)
duas.arabic: وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ
duas.transliteration: Wa-l-ḥamdu li-llāh
duas.translation: All praise is for Allah.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · What to say after completing the prayer · Entry 69
duas.chapterTitle: What to say after completing the prayer

duas.title: What to say after completing the prayer (4 of 8)
duas.arabic: وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
duas.transliteration: Wa-llāhu akbar
duas.translation: Allah is the Greatest.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · What to say after completing the prayer · Entry 69
duas.chapterTitle: What to say after completing the prayer

duas.title: What to say after completing the prayer (4 of 8)
duas.arabic: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
duas.transliteration: Lā ilāha illā llāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lahu, lahu l-mulku walahu l-ḥamdu wahuwa ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīr
duas.translation: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah alone, without partner. To Him belong all sovereignty and praise, and He has power over all things.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · What to say after completing the prayer · Entry 69
duas.chapterTitle: What to say after completing the prayer

duas.title: What to say after completing the prayer (5 of 8)
duas.arabic: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم ﴿قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ* اللَّهُ الصَّمَدُ* لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ* وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُ كُفُواً أَحَدٌ﴾، بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم ﴿قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ* مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ* وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ* وَمِن شَرِّ النَّفَّاثَاتِ فِي الْعُقَدِ* وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ﴾،بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم ﴿قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ* مَلِكِ النَّاسِ* إِلَهِ النَّاسِ* مِن شَرِّ الْوَسْوَاسِ الْخَنَّاسِ* الَّذِي يُوَسْوِسُ فِي صُدُورِ النَّاسِ* مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَ النَّاسِ﴾
duas.transliteration: Bismi llāh ar-raḥmān ar-raḥīm qul huwa llāhu aḥadun allāhu aṣ-ṣamadu lam yalid walam yūlad walam yakun llahu kufūan aḥadun bismi llāh ar-raḥmān ar-raḥīm qul aʿūdhu birabbi l-falaqi min sharri mā khalaqa wamin sharri ghāsiqin idhā waqaba wamin sharri an-naffāthāti fī l-ʿuqadi wamin sharri ḥāsidin idhā ḥasada bismi llāh ar-raḥmān ar-raḥīm qul aʿūdhu birabbi an-nāsi maliki an-nāsi ilāhi an-nāsi min sharri l-waswāsi l-khannāsi alladhī yuwaswisu fī ṣudūri an-nāsi mina l-jinnati wa an-nās
duas.translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful. 112:1 Say: He is Allah, the One. 112:2 Allah, the One on whom all depend. 112:3 He neither begets nor was born. 112:4 Nothing is comparable to Him. In the name of Allah, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful. 113:1 Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak, 113:2 from the evil of what He created, 113:3 from the evil of darkness when it settles, 113:4 from the evil of those who blow upon knots, 113:5 and from the evil of an envier when he envies. In the name of Allah, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful. 114:1 Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of humankind, 114:2 the King of humankind, 114:3 the God of humankind, 114:4 from the evil of the retreating whisperer, 114:5 who whispers into people’s hearts, 114:6 whether from the jinn or humankind.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · What to say after completing the prayer · Entry 70
duas.chapterTitle: What to say after completing the prayer

duas.title: What to say after completing the prayer (6 of 8)
duas.arabic: ﴿اللَّهُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ لاَ تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلاَ نَوْمٌ لَّهُ مَا فِي السَّمَوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الأَرْضِ مَن ذَا الَّذِي يَشْفَعُ عِنْدَهُ إِلاَّ بِإِذْنِهِ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَلاَ يُحِيطُونَ بِشَيْءٍ مِّنْ عِلْمِهِ إِلاَّ بِمَا شَاءَ وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضَ وَلاَ يَؤُودُهُ حِفْظُهُمَا وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمُ﴾
duas.transliteration: Allāhu lā ilāha illā huwa l-ḥayyu l-qayyūmu lā taʾkhudhuhu sinatun walā nawmun llahu mā fī as-samawāti wamā fī l-ʾarḍi man dhā alladhī yashfaʿu ʿindahu illā bi-idhnihi yaʿlamu mā bayna aydīhim wamā khalfahum walā yuḥīṭūna bi-shayʾin mmin ʿilmihi illā bimā shāʾa wasiʿa kursiyyuhu as-samawāti wa-l-ʾarḍa walā yaʾūduhu ḥifẓuhumā wahuwa l-ʿaliyyu l-ʿaẓīm
duas.translation: Allah—there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of all. Neither drowsiness nor sleep overtakes Him. Everything in the heavens and on the earth belongs to Him. Who can intercede with Him except by His permission? He knows what lies before people and what lies beyond them, while they grasp nothing of His knowledge except what He wills. His Kursi extends over the heavens and the earth, and preserving them does not tire Him. He is the Most High, the Magnificent.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · What to say after completing the prayer · Entry 71
duas.chapterTitle: What to say after completing the prayer

duas.title: What to say after completing the prayer (7 of 8)
duas.arabic: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
duas.transliteration: Lā ilāha illā llāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lahu, lahu l-mulku walahu l-ḥamdu yuḥyī wa yumītu wahuwa ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīr
duas.translation: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner, to Him belongs all sovereignty and praise, He gives life and causes death and He is over all things omnipotent.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · What to say after completing the prayer · Entry 72
duas.chapterTitle: What to say after completing the prayer

duas.title: What to say after completing the prayer (8 of 8)
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ عِلْماً نافِعاً، وَرِزْقاً طَيِّباً، وَعَمَلاً مُتَقَبَّلاً
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma innī asʾaluka ʿilman nfiʿan, wa rizqan ṭayyiban, wa ʿamalan mutaqabbalā
duas.translation: O Allah, I ask You for knowledge which is beneficial and sustenance which is good, and deeds which are acceptable.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · What to say after completing the prayer · Entry 73
duas.chapterTitle: What to say after completing the prayer

duas.title: Istikharah (seeking Allah's Counsel)
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْتَخِيرُكَ بِعِلْمِكَ، وَأَسْتَقْدِرُكَ بِقُدْرَتِكَ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ العَظِيمِ؛ فَإِنَّكَ تَقْدِرُ وَلاَ أَقْدِرُ، وَتَعْلَمُ وَلاَ أَعْلَمُ، وَأَنْتَ عَلاَّمُ الغُيُوبِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنْ كُنْتَ تَعْلَمُ أَنَّ هَذَا الأمْرَ {{need}} خَيْرٌ لِي فِي دِينِي وَمَعَاشِي وَعَاقِبَةِ أَمْرِي فَاقْدُرْهُ لِي وَيَسِّرْهُ لِي ثمَّ بَارِكْ لِي فِيهِ، وَإِنْ كُنْتَ تَعْلَمُ أَنَّ هَذَا الْأَمْرَ شَرٌّ لِي فِي دِينِي وَمَعَاشِي وَعَاقِبَةِ أَمْرِي فَاصْرِفْهُ عَنِّي وَاصْرِفْنِي عَنْهُ وَاقْدُرْ لِيَ الْخَيْرَ حَيْثُ كَانَ، ثُمَّ أَرْضِنِي بِهِ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma innī astakhīruka bi-ʿilmika, wa astaqdiruka bi-qudratika, wa asʾaluka min faḍlika l-ʿaẓīmi; fa innaka taqdiru walā aqdiru, wa taʿlamu walā aʿlamu, wa anta ʿallāmu l-ghuyūbi, allāhumma in kunta taʿlamu anna hādhā l-ʾmra {{need}} khayrun lī fī dīnī wa maʿāshī wa ʿāqibati amrī fa iqdurhu lī wa yassirhu lī thmma bārik lī fīhi, waʾin kunta taʿlamu anna hādhā l-ʾamra sharrun lī fī dīnī wa maʿāshī wa ʿāqibati amrī fa iṣrifhu ʿannī wa iṣrifnī ʿanhu wa iqdur liya l-khayra ḥaythu kāna, thumma arḍinī bih
duas.translation: ‘O Allah, I seek Your counsel by Your knowledge and by Your power I seek strength and I ask You from Your immense favour, for verily You are able while I am not and verily You know while I do not and You are the Knower of the unseen. O Allah, if You know this affair {{need}} to be good for me in relation to my religion, my life, and end, then decree and facilitate it for me, and bless me with it, and if You know this affair to be ill for me towards my religion, my life, and end, then remove it from me and remove me from it, and decree for me what is good wherever it be and make me satisfied with such.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Istikharah (seeking Allah's Counsel) · Entry 74

duas.title: Istikharah (seeking Allah's Counsel)

O Allah, if You know this affair {{need}} to be good for me in relation to the immediate and later consequences of my affair, then decree and facilitate it for me, and bless me with it, and if You know this affair to be ill for me in relation to the immediate and later consequences of my affair, then remove it from me and remove me from it, and decree for me what is good wherever it be and make me satisfied with such.

duas.chapterTitle: Istikharah (seeking Allah's Counsel)

duas.title: Words of remembrance for morning and evening (1 of 24)
duas.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ ﴿اللَّهُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ لاَ تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلاَ نَوْمٌ لَّهُ مَا فِي السَّمَوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الأَرْضِ مَن ذَا الَّذِي يَشْفَعُ عِنْدَهُ إِلاَّ بِإِذْنِهِ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَلاَ يُحِيطُونَ بِشَيْءٍ مِّنْ عِلْمِهِ إِلاَّ بِمَا شَاء وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ وَلاَ يَؤُودُهُ حِفْظُهُمَا وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمُ﴾
duas.transliteration: Aʿūdhu bi-llāhi mina ash-shayṭāni ar-rajīmi llāhu lā ilāha illā huwa l-ḥayyu l-qayyūmu lā taʾkhudhuhu sinatun walā nawmun llahu mā fī as-samawāti wamā fī l-ʾarḍi man dhā alladhī yashfaʿu ʿindahu illā bi-idhnihi yaʿlamu mā bayna aydīhim wamā khalfahum walā yuḥīṭūna bi-shayʾin mmin ʿilmihi illā bimā shāʾ wasiʿa kursiyyuhu as-samawāti wa-l-ʾarḍa walā yaʾūduhu ḥifẓuhumā wahuwa l-ʿaliyyu l-ʿaẓīm
duas.translation: I seek refuge in Allah from Satan, the rejected. Allah—there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of all. Neither drowsiness nor sleep overtakes Him. Everything in the heavens and on the earth belongs to Him. Who can intercede with Him except by His permission? He knows what lies before people and what lies beyond them, while they grasp nothing of His knowledge except what He wills. His Kursi extends over the heavens and the earth, and preserving them does not tire Him. He is the Most High, the Magnificent.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Words of remembrance for morning and evening · Entry 75

duas.translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful. 112:1 Say: He is Allah, the One. 112:2 Allah, the One on whom all depend. 112:3 He neither begets nor was born. 112:4 Nothing is comparable to Him. In the name of Allah, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful. 113:1 Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak, 113:2 from the evil of what He created, 113:3 from the evil of darkness when it settles, 113:4 from the evil of those who blow upon knots, 113:5 and from the evil of an envier when he envies. In the name of Allah, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful. 114:1 Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of humankind, 114:2 the King of humankind, 114:3 the God of humankind, 114:4 from the evil of the retreating whisperer, 114:5 who whispers into people’s hearts, 114:6 whether from the jinn or humankind.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Words of remembrance for morning and evening · Entry 76
duas.chapterTitle: Words of remembrance for morning and evening

duas.title: Words of remembrance for morning and evening (3 of 24)
duas.arabic: أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَ الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، رَبِّ أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ مَا فِي هَذَا الْيَوْمِ وَخَيرَ مَا بَعْدَهُ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا فِي هَذَا الْيَوْمِ وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهُ، رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكَسَلِ وَسُوءِ الْكِبَرِ، رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ فِي النَّارِ وَعَذَابٍ فِي الْقَبْرِ
duas.transliteration: Aṣbaḥnā wa aṣbaḥa l-mulku li-llāhi wa-l-ḥamdu li-llāhi, lā ilāha illā llāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lahu, lahu l-mulku walahu l-ḥamdu wahuwa ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīrun, rabbi asʾaluka khayra mā fī hādhā l-yawmi wa khayra mā baʿdahu wa aʿūdhu bika min sharri mā fī hādhā l-yawmi washarri mā baʿdahu, rabbi aʿūdhu bika mina l-kasali wa sūʾi l-kibari, rabbi aʿūdhu bika min ʿadhābin fī an-nāri wa ʿadhābin fī l-qabr
duas.translation: We have entered the morning, and all sovereignty belongs to Allah. All praise is for Allah. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah alone, without partner. To Him belong all sovereignty and praise, and He has power over all things. My Lord, I ask You for the good of this day and what follows it. I seek refuge in You from the evil of this day and what follows it. My Lord, I seek refuge in You from laziness and the evils of old age. My Lord, I seek refuge in You from punishment in the Fire and punishment in the grave.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Words of remembrance for morning and evening · Entry 77
duas.chapterTitle: Words of remembrance for morning and evening

duas.title: Words of remembrance for morning and evening (3 of 24)
duas.arabic: أَمْسَيْنَا وَأَمْسَى الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، رَبِّ أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ مَا فِي هَذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ وَخَيرَ مَا بَعْدَهَا، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا فِي هَذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهَا، رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكَسَلِ وَسُوءِ الْكِبَرِ، رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ فِي النَّارِ وَعَذَابٍ فِي الْقَبْرِ
duas.transliteration: Amsaynā wa amsā l-mulku li-llāhi wa-l-ḥamdu li-llāhi, lā ilāha illā llāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lahu, lahu l-mulku walahu l-ḥamdu wahuwa ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīrun, rabbi asʾaluka khayra mā fī hādhihi l-laylati wa khayra mā baʿdahā, wa aʿūdhu bika min sharri mā fī hādhihi l-laylati washarri mā baʿdahā, rabbi aʿūdhu bika mina l-kasali wa sūʾi l-kibari, rabbi aʿūdhu bika min ʿadhābin fī an-nāri wa ʿadhābin fī l-qabr
duas.translation: We have entered the evening, and all sovereignty belongs to Allah. All praise is for Allah. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah alone, without partner. To Him belong all sovereignty and praise, and He has power over all things. My Lord, I ask You for the good of this night and what follows it. I seek refuge in You from the evil of this night and what follows it. My Lord, I seek refuge in You from laziness and the evils of old age. My Lord, I seek refuge in You from punishment in the Fire and punishment in the grave.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Words of remembrance for morning and evening · Entry 77
duas.chapterTitle: Words of remembrance for morning and evening

duas.title: Words of remembrance for morning and evening (4 of 24)
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا، وَبِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا، وَبِكَ نَحْيَا، وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ، وَإِلَيْكَ النُّشُورُ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma bika aṣbaḥnā, wabika amsaynā, wabika naḥyā, wabika namūtu, wa ilayka an-nushūr
duas.translation: O Allah, by You we enter the morning, and by You we enter the evening. By You we live and by You we die, and to You is the resurrection.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Words of remembrance for morning and evening · Entry 78
duas.chapterTitle: Words of remembrance for morning and evening

duas.title: Words of remembrance for morning and evening (4 of 24)
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا، وَبِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا، وَبِكَ نَحْيَا، وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ، وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma bika amsaynā, wabika aṣbaḥnā, wabika naḥyā, wabika namūtu, wa ilayka l-maṣīr
duas.translation: O Allah, by You we enter the evening, and by You we enter the morning. By You we live and by You we die, and to You is our return.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Words of remembrance for morning and evening · Entry 78
duas.chapterTitle: Words of remembrance for morning and evening

duas.title: Words of remembrance for morning and evening (5 of 24)
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لَا إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ، خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ، وَأَنَا عَلَى عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ، أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ، وَأَبُوءُ بِذَنْبِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي فَإِنَّهُ لاَ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنوبَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma anta rabbī lā ilāha illā anta, khalaqtanī wa anā ʿabduka, wa anā ʿalā ʿahdika wa waʿdika mā istaṭaʿtu, aʿūdhu bika min sharri mā ṣanaʿtu, abūʾu laka bi-niʿmatika ʿalayya, wa abūʾu bi-dhanbī fa ighfir lī fa innahu lā yaghfiru adh-dhunwba illā ant
duas.translation: O Allah, You are my Lord, none has the right to be worshipped except You, You created me and I am Your servant and I abide to Your covenant and promise as best I can, I take refuge in You from the evil of which I have committed. I acknowledge Your favour upon me and I acknowledge my sin, so forgive me, for verily none can forgive sin except You.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Words of remembrance for morning and evening · Entry 79
duas.chapterTitle: Words of remembrance for morning and evening

duas.title: Words of remembrance for morning and evening (6 of 24)
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَصْبَحْتُ أُشْهِدُكَ، وَأُشْهِدُ حَمَلَةَ عَرْشِكَ، وَمَلاَئِكَتِكَ، وَجَمِيعَ خَلْقِكَ، أَنَّكَ أَنْتَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ وَحْدَكَ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَكَ، وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّداً عَبْدُكَ وَرَسُولُكَ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma innī aṣbaḥtu ushhiduka, wa ushhidu ḥamalata ʿarshika, wa malāʾikatika, wa jamīʿa khalqika, annaka anta llāhu lā ilāha illā anta waḥdaka lā sharīka laka, waʾanna muḥammadan ʿabduka wa rasūluk
duas.translation: O Allah, I have entered the morning, and I call You, the bearers of Your Throne, Your angels, and all Your creation to witness that You are Allah. None has the right to be worshipped except You alone, without partner, and Muhammad is Your servant and messenger.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Words of remembrance for morning and evening · Entry 80
duas.chapterTitle: Words of remembrance for morning and evening

duas.title: Words of remembrance for morning and evening (6 of 24)
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَمْسَيْتُ أُشْهِدُكَ، وَأُشْهِدُ حَمَلَةَ عَرْشِكَ، وَمَلاَئِكَتِكَ، وَجَمِيعَ خَلْقِكَ، أَنَّكَ أَنْتَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ وَحْدَكَ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَكَ، وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّداً عَبْدُكَ وَرَسُولُكَ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma innī amsaytu ushhiduka, wa ushhidu ḥamalata ʿarshika, wa malāʾikatika, wa jamīʿa khalqika, annaka anta llāhu lā ilāha illā anta waḥdaka lā sharīka laka, waʾanna muḥammadan ʿabduka wa rasūluk
duas.translation: O Allah, I have entered the evening, and I call You, the bearers of Your Throne, Your angels, and all Your creation to witness that You are Allah. None has the right to be worshipped except You alone, without partner, and Muhammad is Your servant and messenger.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Words of remembrance for morning and evening · Entry 80
duas.chapterTitle: Words of remembrance for morning and evening

duas.title: Words of remembrance for morning and evening (7 of 24)
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ مَا أَصْبَحَ بِي مِنْ نِعْمَةٍ أَوْ بِأَحَدٍ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ فَمِنْكَ وَحْدَكَ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَكَ، فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ وَلَكَ الشُّكْرُ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma mā aṣbaḥa bī min niʿmatin aw bi-aḥadin min khalqika fa minka waḥdaka lā sharīka laka, falaka l-ḥamdu walaka ash-shukr
duas.translation: O Allah, whatever blessing has come to me or to any of Your creation this morning is from You alone, without partner. To You belongs all praise, and to You belongs all thanks.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Words of remembrance for morning and evening · Entry 81
duas.chapterTitle: Words of remembrance for morning and evening

duas.title: Words of remembrance for morning and evening (7 of 24)
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ مَا أَمْسَى بِي مِنْ نِعْمَةٍ أَوْ بِأَحَدٍ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ فَمِنْكَ وَحْدَكَ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَكَ، فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ وَلَكَ الشُّكْرُ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma mā amsā bī min niʿmatin aw bi-aḥadin min khalqika fa minka waḥdaka lā sharīka laka, falaka l-ḥamdu walaka ash-shukr
duas.translation: O Allah, whatever blessing has come to me or to any of Your creation this evening is from You alone, without partner. To You belongs all praise, and to You belongs all thanks.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Words of remembrance for morning and evening · Entry 81
duas.chapterTitle: Words of remembrance for morning and evening

duas.title: Words of remembrance for morning and evening (8 of 24)
