duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَدَنِي، اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي سَمْعِي، اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَصَرِي، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ. اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكُفْرِ، وَالفَقْرِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ القَبْرِ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma ʿāfinī fī badanī, allāhumma ʿāfinī fī samʿī, allāhumma ʿāfinī fī baṣarī, lā ilāha illā ant. allāhumma innī aʿūdhu bika mina l-kufri, wa-l-faqri, wa aʿūdhu bika min ʿadhābi l-qabri, lā ilāha illā ant
duas.translation: O Allah, grant my body health, O Allah, grant my hearing health, O Allah, grant my sight health. None has the right to be worshipped except You. O Allah, I take refuge with You from disbelief and poverty, and I take refuge with You from the punishment of the grave. None has the right to be worshipped except You.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Words of remembrance for morning and evening · Entry 82
duas.chapterTitle: Words of remembrance for morning and evening

duas.title: Words of remembrance for morning and evening (9 of 24)
duas.arabic: حَسْبِيَ اللَّهُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ عَلَيهِ تَوَكَّلتُ وَهُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ
duas.transliteration: Ḥasbiya llāhu lā ilāha illā huwa ʿalayhi tawakkaltu wahuwa rabbu l-ʿarshi l-ʿaẓīm
duas.translation: Allah is Sufficient for me, none has the right to be worshipped except Him, upon Him I rely and He is Lord of the exalted throne.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Words of remembrance for morning and evening · Entry 83
duas.chapterTitle: Words of remembrance for morning and evening

duas.title: Words of remembrance for morning and evening (10 of 24)
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالآخِرَةِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ: فِي دِينِي وَدُنْيَايَ وَأَهْلِي، وَمَالِي، اللَّهُمَّ اسْتُرْ عَوْرَاتِي، وَآمِنْ رَوْعَاتِي، اللَّهُمَّ احْفَظْنِي مِنْ بَينِ يَدَيَّ، وَمِنْ خَلْفِي، وَعَنْ يَمِينِي، وَعَنْ شِمَالِي، وَمِنْ فَوْقِي، وَأَعُوذُ بِعَظَمَتِكَ أَنْ أُغْتَالَ مِنْ تَحْتِي
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma innī asʾaluka l-ʿafwa wa-l-ʿāfiyata fī ad-dunyā wa-l-ʾākhirati, allāhumma innī asʾaluka l-ʿafwa wa-l-ʿāfiyata: fī dīnī wa dunyāya wa ahlī, wa mālī, allāhumma istur ʿawrātī, wa āmin rawʿātī, allāhumma iḥfaẓnī min bayni yadayya, wamin khalfī, waʿan yamīnī, waʿan shimālī, wamin fawqī, wa aʿūdhu bi-ʿaẓamatika an ughtāla min taḥtī
duas.translation: O Allah, I ask You for pardon and well-being in this life and the next. O Allah, I ask You for pardon and well-being in my religious and worldly affairs, and my family and my wealth. O Allah, veil my weaknesses and set at ease my dismay. O Allah, preserve me from the front and from behind and on my right and on my left and from above, and I take refuge with You lest I be swallowed up by the earth.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Words of remembrance for morning and evening · Entry 84
duas.chapterTitle: Words of remembrance for morning and evening

duas.title: Words of remembrance for morning and evening (11 of 24)
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ عَالِمَ الغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ فَاطِرَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ، رَبَّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَمَلِيكَهُ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ نَفْسِي، وَمِنْ شَرِّ الشَّيْطانِ وَشَرَكِهِ، وَأَنْ أَقْتَرِفَ عَلَى نَفْسِي سُوءاً، أَوْ أَجُرَّهُ إِلَى مُسْلِمٍ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma ʿālima l-ghaybi wa ash-shahādati fāṭira as-samawāti wa-l-ʾarḍi, rabba kulli shayʾin wa malīkahu, ashhadu an lā ilāha illā anta, aʿūdhu bika min sharri nafsī, wamin sharri ash-shayṭni wa sharakihi, waʾan aqtarifa ʿalā nafsī sūʾan, aw ajurrahu ilā muslim
duas.translation: O Allah, Knower of the unseen and the seen, Creator of the heavens and the Earth, Lord and Sovereign of all things, I bear witness that none has the right to be worshipped except You. I take refuge in You from the evil of my soul and from the evil and shirk of the devil, and from committing wrong against my soul or bringing such upon another Muslim.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Words of remembrance for morning and evening · Entry 85
duas.chapterTitle: Words of remembrance for morning and evening

duas.title: Words of remembrance for morning and evening (12 of 24)
duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي لاَ يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلاَ فِي السّمَاءِ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
duas.transliteration: Bismi llāhi alladhī lā yaḍurru maʿa ismihi shayʾun fī l-ʾarḍi walā fī as-smāʾi wahuwa as-samīʿu l-ʿalīm
duas.translation: In the name of Allah with whose name nothing is harmed on earth nor in the heavens, and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Words of remembrance for morning and evening · Entry 86
duas.chapterTitle: Words of remembrance for morning and evening

duas.title: Words of remembrance for morning and evening (13 of 24)
duas.arabic: رَضِيتُ بِاللَّهِ رَبَّاً، وَبِالْإِسْلاَمِ دِيناً، وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَبِيّاً
duas.transliteration: Raḍītu bi-llāhi rabbā, wa bi-l-ʾislāmi dīnan, wa bi-muḥammadin ṣallā llāh ʿalayhi wa sallam nabīā
duas.translation: I am pleased with Allah as Lord, with Islam as religion, and with Muhammad as Prophet.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Words of remembrance for morning and evening · Entry 87
duas.chapterTitle: Words of remembrance for morning and evening

duas.title: Words of remembrance for morning and evening (14 of 24)
duas.arabic: يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ بِرَحْمَتِكَ أَسْتَغيثُ أَصْلِحْ لِي شَأْنِيَ كُلَّهُ وَلاَ تَكِلْنِي إِلَى نَفْسِي طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ
duas.transliteration: Yā ḥayyu yā qayyūmu bi-raḥmatika astaghythu aṣliḥ lī shaʾniya kullahu walā takilnī ilā nafsī ṭarfata ʿayn
duas.translation: O Ever Living, O Self-Subsisting and Supporter of all, by Your mercy I seek assistance, rectify for me all of my affairs and do not leave me to myself, even for the blink of an eye.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Words of remembrance for morning and evening · Entry 88
duas.chapterTitle: Words of remembrance for morning and evening

duas.title: Words of remembrance for morning and evening (15 of 24)
duas.arabic: أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَ الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ هَذَا الْيَوْمِ: فَتْحَهُ، وَنَصْرَهُ، وَنُورَهُ، وَبَرَكَتَهُ، وَهُدَاهُ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا فِيهِ وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهُ
duas.transliteration: Aṣbaḥnā wa aṣbaḥa l-mulku li-llāhi rabbi l-ʿālamīna, allāhumma innī asʾaluka khayra hādhā l-yawmi: fatḥahu, wa naṣrahu, wa nūrahu, wa barakatahu, wa hudāhu, wa aʿūdhu bika min sharri mā fīhi washarri mā baʿdah
duas.translation: We have entered the morning, and all sovereignty belongs to Allah, Lord of the worlds. O Allah, I ask You for the good of this day: its success, victory, light, blessing, and guidance. I seek refuge in You from the evil within it and the evil that follows it.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Words of remembrance for morning and evening · Entry 89
duas.chapterTitle: Words of remembrance for morning and evening

duas.title: Words of remembrance for morning and evening (15 of 24)
duas.arabic: أَمْسَيْنَا وَأَمْسَى الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ هَذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ: فَتْحَهَا، وَنَصْرَهَا، وَنُورَهَا، وَبَرَكَتَهَا، وَهُدَاهَا، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا فِيهَا وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهَا
duas.transliteration: Amsaynā wa amsā l-mulku li-llāhi rabbi l-ʿālamīna, allāhumma innī asʾaluka khayra hādhihi l-laylati: fatḥahā, wa naṣrahā, wa nūrahā, wa barakatahā, wa hudāhā, wa aʿūdhu bika min sharri mā fīhā washarri mā baʿdahā
duas.translation: We have entered the evening, and all sovereignty belongs to Allah, Lord of the worlds. O Allah, I ask You for the good of this night: its success, victory, light, blessing, and guidance. I seek refuge in You from the evil within it and the evil that follows it.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Words of remembrance for morning and evening · Entry 89
duas.chapterTitle: Words of remembrance for morning and evening

duas.title: Words of remembrance for morning and evening (16 of 24)
duas.arabic: أَصْبَحْنَا عَلَى فِطْرَةِ الْإِسْلاَمِ، وَعَلَى كَلِمَةِ الْإِخْلاَصِ، وَعَلَى دِينِ نَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ صلى الله عليه وسلم، وَعَلَى مِلَّةِ أَبِينَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَنِيفاً مُسْلِماً وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ
duas.transliteration: Aṣbaḥnā ʿalā fiṭrati l-ʾislāmi, wa ʿalā ka-limati l-ʾikhlāṣi, wa ʿalā dīni nabiyyinā muḥammadin ṣallā llāh ʿalayhi wa sallam, wa ʿalā millati abīnā ibrāhīma, ḥanīfan musliman wamā kāna mina l-mushrikīn
duas.translation: We have entered the morning upon the natural way of Islam, the declaration of sincere faith, the religion of our Prophet Muhammad (may Allah’s peace and blessings be upon him), and the faith of our forefather Ibraheem, who was upright, a Muslim, and not among those who associate partners with Allah.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Words of remembrance for morning and evening · Entry 90
duas.chapterTitle: Words of remembrance for morning and evening

duas.title: Words of remembrance for morning and evening (16 of 24)
duas.arabic: أَمْسَيْنَا عَلَى فِطْرَةِ الْإِسْلاَمِ، وَعَلَى كَلِمَةِ الْإِخْلاَصِ، وَعَلَى دِينِ نَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ صلى الله عليه وسلم، وَعَلَى مِلَّةِ أَبِينَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَنِيفاً مُسْلِماً وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ
duas.transliteration: Amsaynā ʿalā fiṭrati l-ʾislāmi, wa ʿalā ka-limati l-ʾikhlāṣi, wa ʿalā dīni nabiyyinā muḥammadin ṣallā llāh ʿalayhi wa sallam, wa ʿalā millati abīnā ibrāhīma, ḥanīfan musliman wamā kāna mina l-mushrikīn
duas.translation: We have entered the evening upon the natural way of Islam, the declaration of sincere faith, the religion of our Prophet Muhammad (may Allah’s peace and blessings be upon him), and the faith of our forefather Ibraheem, who was upright, a Muslim, and not among those who associate partners with Allah.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Words of remembrance for morning and evening · Entry 90
duas.chapterTitle: Words of remembrance for morning and evening

duas.title: Words of remembrance for morning and evening (17 of 24)
duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ
duas.transliteration: Subḥāna llāhi wa bi-ḥamdih
duas.translation: How perfect Allah is and I praise Him.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Words of remembrance for morning and evening · Entry 91
duas.chapterTitle: Words of remembrance for morning and evening

duas.title: Words of remembrance for morning and evening (18 of 24)
duas.arabic: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
duas.transliteration: Lā ilāha illā llāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lahu, lahu l-mulku walahu l-ḥamdu, wahuwa ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīr
duas.translation: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner, to Him belongs all sovereignty and praise, and He is over all things omnipotent.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Words of remembrance for morning and evening · Entry 92
duas.chapterTitle: Words of remembrance for morning and evening

duas.title: Words of remembrance for morning and evening (19 of 24)
duas.arabic: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ، وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
duas.transliteration: Lā ilāha illā llāhu, waḥdahu lā sharīka lahu, lahu l-mulku walahu l-ḥamdu wahuwa ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīr
duas.translation: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner, to Him belongs all sovereignty and praise, and He is over all things omnipotent.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Words of remembrance for morning and evening · Entry 93
duas.chapterTitle: Words of remembrance for morning and evening

duas.title: Words of remembrance for morning and evening (20 of 24)
duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ: عَدَدَ خَلْقِهِ، وَرِضَا نَفْسِهِ، وَزِنَةَ عَرْشِهِ، وَمِدَادَ كَلِمَاتِهِ
duas.transliteration: Subḥāna llāhi wa bi-ḥamdihi: ʿadada khalqihi, wa riḍā nafsihi, wa zinata ʿarshihi, wa midāda ka-li-mātih
duas.translation: How perfect Allah is and I praise Him by the number of His creation and His pleasure, and by the weight of His throne, and the ink of His words.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Words of remembrance for morning and evening · Entry 94
duas.chapterTitle: Words of remembrance for morning and evening

duas.title: Words of remembrance for morning and evening (21 of 24)
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ عِلْماً نَافِعاً، وَرِزْقاً طَيِّباً، وَعَمَلاً مُتَقَبَّلاً
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma innī asʾaluka ʿilman nāfiʿan, wa rizqan ṭayyiban, wa ʿamalan mutaqabbalā
duas.translation: O Allah, I ask You for knowledge which is beneficial and sustenance which is good, and deeds which are acceptable.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Words of remembrance for morning and evening · Entry 95
duas.chapterTitle: Words of remembrance for morning and evening

duas.title: Words of remembrance for morning and evening (22 of 24)
duas.arabic: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ
duas.transliteration: Astaghfiru llāha wa atūbu ilayh
duas.translation: ‘I seek Allaah’s forgiveness and I turn to Him in repentance.’
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Words of remembrance for morning and evening · Entry 96
duas.chapterTitle: Words of remembrance for morning and evening

duas.title: Words of remembrance for morning and evening (23 of 24)
duas.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
duas.transliteration: Aʿūdhu bi-ka-li-māti llāhi at-tāmmāti min sharri mā khalaq
duas.translation: I take refuge in Allah’s perfect words from the evil He has created.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Words of remembrance for morning and evening · Entry 97
duas.chapterTitle: Words of remembrance for morning and evening

duas.title: Words of remembrance for morning and evening (24 of 24)
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى نَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli wa sallim ʿalā nabiyyinā muḥammad
duas.translation: ‘O Allaah, send prayers and peace upon our Prophet Muhammad.’
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Words of remembrance for morning and evening · Entry 98
duas.chapterTitle: Words of remembrance for morning and evening

duas.title: What to say before sleeping (1 of 13)
duas.arabic: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم ﴿قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ * اللَّهُ الصَّمَدُ* لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ* وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُ كُفُواً أَحَدٌ﴾. بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم ﴿قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ* مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ* وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ* وَمِن شَرِّ النَّفَّاثَاتِ فِي الْعُقَدِ* وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ﴾. بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم ﴿قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ* مَلِكِ النَّاسِ* إِلَهِ النَّاسِ* مِن شَرِّ الْوَسْوَاسِ الْخَنَّاسِ* الَّذِي يُوَسْوِسُ فِي صُدُورِ النَّاسِ* مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَ النَّاسِ﴾
duas.transliteration: Bismi llāh ar-raḥmān ar-raḥīm qul huwa llāhu aḥadun allāhu aṣ-ṣamadu lam yalid walam yūlad walam yakun llahu kufūan aḥadun bismi llāh ar-raḥmān ar-raḥīm qul aʿūdhu birabbi l-falaqi min sharri mā khalaqa wamin sharri ghāsiqin idhā waqaba wamin sharri an-naffāthāti fī l-ʿuqadi wamin sharri ḥāsidin idhā ḥasada bismi llāh ar-raḥmān ar-raḥīm qul aʿūdhu birabbi an-nāsi maliki an-nāsi ilāhi an-nāsi min sharri l-waswāsi l-khannāsi alladhī yuwaswisu fī ṣudūri an-nāsi mina l-jinnati wa an-nās
duas.translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful. 112:1 Say: He is Allah, the One. 112:2 Allah, the One on whom all depend. 112:3 He neither begets nor was born. 112:4 Nothing is comparable to Him. In the name of Allah, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful. 113:1 Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak, 113:2 from the evil of what He created, 113:3 from the evil of darkness when it settles, 113:4 from the evil of those who blow upon knots, 113:5 and from the evil of an envier when he envies. In the name of Allah, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful. 114:1 Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of humankind, 114:2 the King of humankind, 114:3 the God of humankind, 114:4 from the evil of the retreating whisperer, 114:5 who whispers into people’s hearts, 114:6 whether from the jinn or humankind.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · What to say before sleeping · Entry 99
duas.chapterTitle: What to say before sleeping

duas.title: What to say before sleeping (2 of 13)
duas.arabic: ﴿اللَّهُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ لاَ تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلاَ نَوْمٌ لَّهُ مَا فِي السَّمَوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الأَرْضِ مَن ذَا الَّذِي يَشْفَعُ عِنْدَهُ إِلاَّ بِإِذْنِهِ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَلاَ يُحِيطُونَ بِشَيْءٍ مِّنْ عِلْمِهِ إِلاَّ بِمَا شَاء وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضَ وَلاَ يَؤُودُهُ حِفْظُهُمَا وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمُ﴾
duas.transliteration: Allāhu lā ilāha illā huwa l-ḥayyu l-qayyūmu lā taʾkhudhuhu sinatun walā nawmun llahu mā fī as-samawāti wamā fī l-ʾarḍi man dhā alladhī yashfaʿu ʿindahu illā bi-idhnihi yaʿlamu mā bayna aydīhim wamā khalfahum walā yuḥīṭūna bi-shayʾin mmin ʿilmihi illā bimā shāʾ wasiʿa kursiyyuhu as-samawāti wa-l-ʾarḍa walā yaʾūduhu ḥifẓuhumā wahuwa l-ʿaliyyu l-ʿaẓīm
duas.translation: Allah—there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of all. Neither drowsiness nor sleep overtakes Him. Everything in the heavens and on the earth belongs to Him. Who can intercede with Him except by His permission? He knows what lies before people and what lies beyond them, while they grasp nothing of His knowledge except what He wills. His Kursi extends over the heavens and the earth, and preserving them does not tire Him. He is the Most High, the Magnificent.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · What to say before sleeping · Entry 100
duas.chapterTitle: What to say before sleeping

duas.title: What to say before sleeping (3 of 13)
duas.arabic: ﴿آمَنَ الرَّسُولُ بِمَا أُنزِلَ إِلَيْهِ مِن رَّبِّهِ وَالْمُؤْمِنُونَ كُلٌّ آمَنَ بِاللَّهِ وَمَلآئِكَتِهِ وَكُتُبِهِ وَرُسُلِهِ لاَ نُفَرِّقُ بَيْنَ أَحَدٍ مِّن رُّسُلِهِ وَقَالُواْ سَمِعْنَا وَأَطَعْنَا غُفْرَانَكَ رَبَّنَا وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ* لاَ يُكَلِّفُ اللَّهُ نَفْساً إِلاَّ وُسْعَهَا لَهَا مَا كَسَبَتْ وَعَلَيْهَا مَا اكْتَسَبَتْ رَبَّنَا لاَ تُؤَاخِذْنَا إِن نَّسِينَا أَوْ أَخْطَأْنَا رَبَّنَا وَلاَ تَحْمِلْ عَلَيْنَا إِصْراً كَمَا حَمَلْتَهُ عَلَى الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِنَا رَبَّنَا وَلاَ تُحَمِّلْنَا مَا لاَ طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِهِ وَاعْفُ عَنَّا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَارْحَمْنَآ أَنتَ مَوْلاَنَا فَانصُرْنَا عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ﴾
duas.transliteration: Āmana ar-rasūlu bimā unzila ilayhi min rrabbihi wa-l-muʾminūna kullun āmana bi-llāhi wa malʾāʾikatihi wa kutubihi wa rusulihi lā nufarriqu bayna aḥadin mmin rrusulihi wa qālū samiʿnā wa aṭaʿnā ghufrānaka rabbanā wa ilayka l-maṣīru lā yukallifu llāhu nafsan illā wusʿahā lahā mā ka-sabat wa ʿalayhā mā iktasabat rabbanā lā tuʾākhidhnā in nnasīnā aw akhṭaʾnā rabbanā walā taḥmil ʿalaynā iṣran kamā ḥamaltahu ʿalā alladhīna min qablinā rabbanā walā tuḥammilnā mā lā ṭāqata lanā bihi wa iʿfu ʿannā wa ighfir lanā wa irḥamnā anta mawlānā fānṣurnā ʿalā l-qawmi l-kāfirīn
duas.translation: 285 The Messenger believes in what was revealed to him from his Lord, as do the believers. Each believes in Allah, His angels, His scriptures, and His messengers. “We make no distinction between any of His messengers.” They say, “We hear and obey. Our Lord, we seek Your forgiveness, and to You is the final return.” 286 Allah does not burden a soul beyond its capacity. It receives the good it earns and bears the evil it commits. “Our Lord, do not hold us to account if we forget or make a mistake. Our Lord, do not place upon us a burden like the one You placed upon those before us. Our Lord, do not burden us with what we cannot bear. Pardon us, forgive us, and have mercy on us. You are our Protector, so grant us victory over the disbelieving people.”
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · What to say before sleeping · Entry 101
duas.chapterTitle: What to say before sleeping

duas.title: What to say before sleeping (4 of 13)
duas.arabic: بِاسْمِكَ رَبِّي وَضَعْتُ جَنْبِي، وَبِكَ أَرْفَعُهُ، فَإِن أَمْسَكْتَ نَفْسِي فارْحَمْهَا، وَإِنْ أَرْسَلْتَهَا فَاحْفَظْهَا، بِمَا تَحْفَظُ بِهِ عِبَادَكَ الصَّالِحِينَ
duas.transliteration: Bi-ismika rabbī wa ḍaʿtu janbī, wabika arfaʿuhu, faʾin amsakta nafsī frḥamhā, waʾin arsaltahā fa iḥfaẓhā, bimā taḥfaẓu bihi ʿibādaka aṣ-ṣāliḥīn
duas.translation: In Your name my Lord, I lie down and in Your name I rise, so if You should take my soul then have mercy upon it, and if You should return my soul then protect it in the manner You do so with Your righteous servants.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · What to say before sleeping · Entry 102
duas.chapterTitle: What to say before sleeping

duas.title: What to say before sleeping (5 of 13)
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ خَلَقْتَ نَفْسِي وَأَنْتَ تَوَفَّاهَا، لَكَ مَمَاتُهَا وَمَحْياهَا، إِنْ أَحْيَيْتَهَا فَاحْفَظْهَا، وَإِنْ أَمَتَّهَا فَاغْفِرْ لَهَا. اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ العَافِيَةَ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma innaka khalaqta nafsī wa anta tawaffāhā, laka mamātuhā wa maḥyhā, in aḥyaytahā fa iḥfaẓhā, waʾin amattahā fa ighfir lahā. allāhumma innī asʾaluka l-ʿāfiyah
duas.translation: O Allah, verily You have created my soul and You shall take it’s life, to You belongs it’s life and death. If You should keep my soul alive then protect it, and if You should take it’s life then forgive it. O Allah, I ask You to grant me good health.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · What to say before sleeping · Entry 103
duas.chapterTitle: What to say before sleeping

duas.title: What to say before sleeping (6 of 13)
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ قِنِي عَذَابَكَ يَوْمَ تَبْعَثُ عِبَادَكَ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma qinī ʿadhābaka yawma tabʿathu ʿibādak
duas.translation: O Allah, protect me from Your punishment on the day Your servants are resurrected.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · What to say before sleeping · Entry 104
duas.chapterTitle: What to say before sleeping

duas.title: What to say before sleeping (7 of 13)
duas.arabic: بِاسْمِكَ اللَّهُمَّ أَمُوتُ وَأَحْيَا
duas.transliteration: Bi-ismika llāhumma amūtu wa aḥyā
duas.translation: In Your name O Allah, I live and die.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · What to say before sleeping · Entry 105
duas.chapterTitle: What to say before sleeping

duas.title: What to say before sleeping (8 of 13)
duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ
duas.transliteration: Subḥāna llāh
duas.translation: Glory be to Allah.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · What to say before sleeping · Entry 106
duas.chapterTitle: What to say before sleeping

duas.title: What to say before sleeping (8 of 13)
duas.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ
duas.transliteration: Al-ḥamdu li-llāh
duas.translation: All praise is for Allah.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · What to say before sleeping · Entry 106
duas.chapterTitle: What to say before sleeping

duas.title: What to say before sleeping (8 of 13)
duas.arabic: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
duas.transliteration: Allāhu akbar
duas.translation: Allah is the Greatest.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · What to say before sleeping · Entry 106
duas.chapterTitle: What to say before sleeping

duas.title: What to say before sleeping (9 of 13)
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ السَّمَوَاتِ السَّبْعِ وَرَبَّ الأَرْضِ، وَرَبَّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ، رَبَّنَا وَرَبَّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ، فَالِقَ الْحَبِّ وَالنَّوَى، وَمُنْزِلَ التَّوْرَاةِ وَالْإِنْجِيلِ، وَالْفُرْقَانِ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ أَنْتَ آخِذٌ بِنَاصِيَتِهِ. اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ الأَوَّلُ فَلَيْسَ قَبْلَكَ شَيْءٌ، وَأَنْتَ الآخِرُ فَلَيسَ بَعْدَكَ شَيْءٌ، وَأَنْتَ الظَّاهِرُ فَلَيْسَ فَوْقَكَ شَيْءٌ، وَأَنْتَ الْبَاطِنُ فَلَيْسَ دُونَكَ شَيْءٌ، اقْضِ عَنَّا الدَّيْنَ وَأَغْنِنَا مِنَ الْفَقْرِ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma rabba as-samawāti as-sabʿi warabba l-ʾarḍi, warabba l-ʿarshi l-ʿaẓīmi, rabbanā warabba kulli shayʾin, fa-l-qa l-ḥabbi wa an-nawā, wa munzila at-tawrāti wa-l-ʾinjīli, wa-l-furqāni, aʿūdhu bika min sharri kulli shayʾin anta ākhidhun bi-nāṣiyatih. allāhumma anta l-ʾawwalu fa laysa qablaka shayʾun, wa anta l-ʾākhiru fa laysa baʿdaka shayʾun, wa anta aẓ-ẓāhiru fa laysa fawqaka shayʾun, wa anta l-bāṭinu fa laysa dūnaka shayʾun, iqḍi ʿannā ad-dayna wa aghninā mina l-faqr
duas.translation: O Allah, Lord of the seven heavens and the exalted throne, our Lord and Lord of all things, Splitter of the seed and the date stone, Revealer of the Tawrah, the Injeel and the Furqan, I take refuge in You from the evil of all things You shall seize by the forelock i.e. You have total mastery over. O Allah, You are The First so there is nothing before You and You are The Last so there is nothing after You. You are Aththahir so there is nothing above You and You are Al-Batin so there is nothing closer than You. Settle our debt for us and spare us from poverty.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · What to say before sleeping · Entry 107
duas.chapterTitle: What to say before sleeping

duas.title: What to say before sleeping (10 of 13)
duas.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنَا وَسَقَانَا، وَكَفَانَا، وَآوَانَا، فَكَمْ مِمَّنْ لاَ كَافِيَ لَهُ وَلاَ مُؤْوِيَ
duas.transliteration: Al-ḥamdu li-llāhi alladhī aṭʿamanā wa saqānā, wa ka-fānā, wa āwānā, fakam mimman lā kāfiya lahu walā muʾwiy
duas.translation: All praise is for Allah, Who fed us and gave us drink, and Who is sufficient for us and has sheltered us, for how many have none to suffice them or shelter them.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · What to say before sleeping · Entry 108
duas.chapterTitle: What to say before sleeping

duas.title: What to say before sleeping (11 of 13)
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ عَالِمَ الغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ فَاطِرَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ، رَبَّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَمَلِيكَهُ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ نَفْسِي، وَمِنْ شَرِّ الشَّيْطانِ وَشِرْكِهِ، وَأَنْ أَقْتَرِفَ عَلَى نَفْسِي سُوءاً، أَوْ أَجُرَّهُ إِلَى مُسْلِمٍ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma ʿālima l-ghaybi wa ash-shahādati fāṭira as-samawāti wa-l-ʾarḍi, rabba kulli shayʾin wa malīkahu, ashhadu an lā ilāha illā anta, aʿūdhu bika min sharri nafsī, wamin sharri ash-shayṭni wa shirkihi, waʾan aqtarifa ʿalā nafsī sūʾan, aw ajurrahu ilā muslim
duas.translation: O Allah, Knower of the seen and the unseen, Creator of the heavens and the earth, Lord and Sovereign of all things I bear witness that none has the right to be worshipped except You. I take refuge in You from the evil of my soul and from the evil and shirk of the devil, and from committing wrong against my soul or bringing such upon another Muslim.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · What to say before sleeping · Entry 109
duas.chapterTitle: What to say before sleeping

duas.title: What to say before sleeping (13 of 13)
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَسْلَمْتُ نَفْسِي إِلَيْكَ، وَفَوَّضْتُ أَمْرِي إِلَيْكَ، وَوَجَّهْتُ وَجْهِي إِلَيْكَ، وَأَلْجَأْتُ ظَهْرِي إِلَيْكَ، رَغْبَةً وَرَهْبَةً إِلَيْكَ، لاَ مَلْجَأَ وَلاَ مَنْجَا مِنْكَ إِلاَّ إِلَيْكَ، آمَنْتُ بِكِتَابِكَ الَّذِي أَنْزَلْتَ، وَبِنَبِيِّكَ الَّذِي أَرْسَلْتَ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma aslamtu nafsī ilayka, wa fawwaḍtu amrī ilayka, wa wajjahtu wajhī ilayka, wa aljaʾtu ẓahrī ilayka, raghbatan wa rahbatan ilayka, lā maljaʾa walā manjā minka illā ilayka, āmantu bi-kitābika alladhī anzalta, wa bi-nabiyyika alladhī arsalt
duas.translation: O Allah, I submit my soul unto You, and I entrust my affair unto You, and I turn my face towards You, and I totally rely on You, in hope and fear of You. Verily there is no refuge nor safe haven from You except with You. I believe in Your Book which You have revealed and in Your Prophet whom You have sent.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · What to say before sleeping · Entry 111
duas.chapterTitle: What to say before sleeping

duas.title: Invocation to say if you stir in the night
duas.arabic: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ الْوَاحِدُ الْقَهّارُ، رَبُّ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا الْعَزيزُ الْغَفَّارُ
duas.transliteration: Lā ilāha illā llāhu l-wāḥidu l-qahhru, rabbu as-samawāti wa-l-ʾarḍi wamā baynahumā l-ʿazyzu l-ghaffār
duas.translation: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, The One, AL-Qahhar. Lord of the heavens and the Earth and all between them, The Exalted in Might, The Oft-Forgiving.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Invocation to say if you stir in the night · Entry 112
duas.chapterTitle: Invocation to say if you stir in the night

duas.title: What to say if you are afraid to go to sleep or feel lonely and depressed
duas.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ غَضَبِهِ وَعِقَابِهِ، وَشَرِّ عِبَادِهِ، وَمِنْ هَمَزَاتِ الشَّياطِينِ وَأَنْ يَحْضُرُونِ
duas.transliteration: Aʿūdhu bi-ka-li-māti llāhi at-tāmmāti min ghaḍabihi wa ʿiqābihi, washarri ʿibādihi, wamin hamazāti ash-shayṭīni waʾan yaḥḍurūn
duas.translation: I take refuge in the perfect words of Allah from His anger and punishment, and from the evil of His servants, and from the madness and appearance of devils.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · What to say if you are afraid to go to sleep or feel lonely and depressed · Entry 113
duas.chapterTitle: What to say if you are afraid to go to sleep or feel lonely and depressed

duas.title: Invocations for Qunut in the Witr prayer (1 of 3)
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اهْدِنِي فِيمَنْ هَدَيْتَ، وَعَافِنِي فِيمَنْ عَافَيْتَ، وَتَوَلَّنِي فِيمَنْ تَوَلَّيْتَ، وَبَارِكْ لِي فِيمَا أَعْطَيْتَ، وَقِنِي شَرَّ مَا قَضَيْتَ؛ فَإِنَّكَ تَقْضِي وَلاَ يُقْضَى عَلَيْكَ، إِنَّهُ لاَ يَذِلُّ مَنْ وَالَيْتَ، [وَلاَ يَعِزُّ مَنْ عَادَيْتَ]، تَبارَكْتَ رَبَّنا وَتَعَالَيْتَ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma ihdinī fīman hadayta, wa ʿāfinī fīman ʿāfayta, wa tawallanī fīman tawallayta, wa bārik lī fīmā aʿṭayta, wa qinī sharra mā qaḍayta; fa innaka taqḍī walā yuqḍā ʿalayka, innahu lā yadhillu man wa-l-yta, walā yaʿizzu man ʿādayta tabrakta rabban wa taʿālayt
duas.translation: O Allah, guide me along with those whom You have guided, pardon me along with those whom You have pardoned, be an ally to me along with those whom You are an ally to and bless for me that which You have bestowed. Protect me from the evil You have decreed for verily You decree and none can decree over You. For surety, he whom you show allegiance to is never abased and he whom You take as an enemy is never honoured and mighty. O our Lord, Blessed and Exalted are You.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Invocations for Qunut in the Witr prayer · Entry 116
duas.chapterTitle: Invocations for Qunut in the Witr prayer

duas.title: Invocations for Qunut in the Witr prayer (2 of 3)
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِرِضَاكَ مِنْ سَخَطِكَ، وَبِمُعَافَاتِكَ مِنْ عُقُوبَتِكَ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْكَ، لاَ أُحْصِي ثَنَاءً عَلَيْكَ، أَنْتَ كَمَا أَثْنَيْتَ عَلَى نَفْسِكَ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma innī aʿūdhu bi-riḍāka min sakhaṭika, wa bi-muʿāfātika min ʿuqūbatika, wa aʿūdhu bika minka, lā uḥṣī thanāʾan ʿalayka, anta kamā athnayta ʿalā nafsik
duas.translation: O Allah, I take refuge within Your pleasure from Your displeasure and within Your pardon from Your punishment, and I take refuge in You from You. I cannot enumerate Your praise. You are as You have praised Yourself.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Invocations for Qunut in the Witr prayer · Entry 117
duas.chapterTitle: Invocations for Qunut in the Witr prayer

duas.title: Invocations for Qunut in the Witr prayer (3 of 3)
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِيَّاكَ نعْبُدُ، وَلَكَ نُصَلِّي وَنَسْجُدُ، وَإِلَيْكَ نَسْعَى وَنَحْفِدُ، نَرْجُو رَحْمَتَكَ، وَنَخْشَى عَذَابَكَ، إِنَّ عَذَابَكَ بِالكَافِرِينَ مُلْحَقٌ. اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَسْتَعينُكَ، وَنَسْتَغْفِرُكَ، وَنُثْنِي عَلَيْكَ الْخَيْرَ، وَلاَ نَكْفُرُكَ، وَنُؤْمِنُ بِكَ، وَنَخْضَعُ لَكَ، وَنَخْلَعُ مَنْ يَكْفرُكَ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma iyyāka nʿbudu, walaka nuṣallī wa nasjudu, wa ilayka nasʿā wa naḥfidu, narjū raḥmataka, wa nakhshā ʿadhābaka, inna ʿadhābaka bi-l-kāfirīna mulḥaq. allāhumma innā nastaʿynuka, wa nastaghfiruka, wa nuthnī ʿalayka l-khayra, walā nakfuruka, wa nuʾminu bika, wa nakhḍaʿu laka, wa nakhlaʿu man yakfruk
duas.translation: O Allah, it is You we worship, and unto You we pray and prostrate, and towards You we hasten and You we serve. We hope for Your mercy and fear Your punishment, verily Your punishment will fall upon the disbelievers. O Allah, we seek Your aid and ask Your pardon, we praise You with all good and do not disbelieve in You. We believe in You and submit unto You, and we disown and reject those who disbelieve in You.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Invocations for Qunut in the Witr prayer · Entry 118
duas.chapterTitle: Invocations for Qunut in the Witr prayer

duas.title: What to say immediately following the Witr prayer
duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَ المَلِكِ القُدُّوسِ
duas.transliteration: Subḥāna l-maliki l-quddūs
duas.translation: Glory be to the King, the Most Holy.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · What to say immediately following the Witr prayer · Entry 119
duas.chapterTitle: What to say immediately following the Witr prayer

duas.title: What to say immediately following the Witr prayer
duas.arabic: رَبِّ الْمَلَائِكَةِ وَالرُّوحِ
duas.transliteration: Rabbi l-malāʾikati wa ar-rūḥ
duas.translation: Lord of the angels and the Spirit.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · What to say immediately following the Witr prayer · Entry 119
duas.chapterTitle: What to say immediately following the Witr prayer

duas.title: Invocations in times of worry and grief (1 of 2)
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي عَبْدُكَ، ابْنُ عَبْدِكَ، ابْنُ أَمَتِكَ، نَاصِيَتِي بِيَدِكَ، مَاضٍ فِيَّ حُكْمُكَ، عَدْلٌ فِيَّ قَضَاؤُكَ، أَسْأَلُكَ بِكُلِّ اسْمٍ هُوَ لَكَ، سَمَّيْتَ بِهِ نَفْسَكَ، أَوْ أَنْزَلْتَهُ فِي كِتَابِكَ، أَوْ عَلَّمْتَهُ أَحَداً مِنْ خَلْقِكَ، أَوِ اسْتَأْثَرْتَ بِهِ فِي عِلْمِ الغَيْبِ عِنْدَكَ، أَنْ تَجْعَلَ القُرْآنَ رَبِيعَ قَلْبِي، وَنُورَ صَدْرِي، وَجَلاَءَ حُزْنِي، وَذَهَابَ هَمِّي
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma innī ʿabduka, ibnu ʿabdika, ibnu amatika, nāṣiyatī bi-yadika, māḍin fīa ḥukmuka, ʿadlun fīa qaḍāʾuka, asʾaluka bikulli ismin huwa laka, sammayta bihi nafsaka, aw anzaltahu fī kitābika, aw ʿallamtahu aḥadan min khalqika, awi istaʾtharta bihi fī ʿilmi l-ghaybi ʿindaka, an tajʿala l-qurʾāna rabīʿa qalbī, wa nūra ṣadrī, wa jalāʾa ḥuznī, wa dhahāba hammī
duas.translation: O Allah, I am Your servant, son of Your servant, son of Your maidservant, my forelock is in Your hand i.e. You have total mastery over, Your command over me is forever executed and Your decree over me is just. I ask You by every name belonging to You which You named Yourself with, or revealed in Your Book, or You taught to any of Your creation, or You have preserved in the knowledge of the unseen with You, that You make the Quran the life of my heart and the light of my breast, and a departure for my sorrow and a release for my anxiety.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Invocations in times of worry and grief · Entry 120
duas.chapterTitle: Invocations in times of worry and grief

duas.title: Invocations in times of worry and grief (2 of 2)
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ، وَالْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ، وَالْبُخْلِ وَالْجُبْنِ، وَضَلَعِ الدَّيْنِ وَغَلَبَةِ الرِّجَالِ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma innī aʿūdhu bika mina l-hammi wa-l-ḥazani, wa-l-ʿajzi wa-l-kasali, wa-l-bukhli wa-l-jubni, wa ḍalaʿi ad-dayni wa ghalabati ar-rijāl
duas.translation: O Allah, I take refuge in You from anxiety and sorrow, weakness and laziness, miserliness and cowardice, the burden of debts and from being over powered by men.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Invocations in times of worry and grief · Entry 121
duas.chapterTitle: Invocations in times of worry and grief

duas.title: Invocations for anguish (1 of 4)
duas.arabic: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ الْعَظِيمُ الْحَلِيمُ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ رَبُّ السَّمَوَاتِ وَرَبُّ الْأَرْضِ وَرَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْكَرِيمِ
duas.transliteration: Lā ilāha illā llāhu l-ʿaẓīmu l-ḥalīmu, lā ilāha illā llāhu rabbu l-ʿarshi l-ʿaẓīmi, lā ilāha illā llāhu rabbu as-samawāti warabbu l-ʾarḍi warabbu l-ʿarshi l-karīm
duas.translation: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah Forbearing. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, Lord of the magnificent throne. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, Lord of the heavens, Lord of the Earth and Lord of the noble throne.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Invocations for anguish · Entry 122
duas.chapterTitle: Invocations for anguish

duas.title: Invocations for anguish (2 of 4)
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَحْمَتَكَ أَرْجُو، فَلاَ تَكِلْنِي إِلَى نَفْسِي طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ، وَأَصْلِحْ لِي شَأْنِي كُلَّهُ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma raḥmataka arjū, falā takilnī ilā nafsī ṭarfata ʿaynin, wa aṣliḥ lī shaʾnī kullahu, lā ilāha illā ant
duas.translation: O Allah, it is Your mercy that I hope for, so do not leave me in charge of my affairs even for a blink of an eye and rectify for me all of my affairs. None has the right to be worshipped except You.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Invocations for anguish · Entry 123
duas.chapterTitle: Invocations for anguish

duas.title: Invocations for anguish (3 of 4)
duas.arabic: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنْتُ مِنَ الظّالِمِينَ
duas.transliteration: Lā ilāha illā anta subḥānaka innī kuntu mina aẓ-ẓlimīn
duas.translation: None has the right to be worshipped except You. How perfect You are, verily I was among the wrong-doers.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Invocations for anguish · Entry 124
duas.chapterTitle: Invocations for anguish

duas.title: Invocations for anguish (4 of 4)
duas.arabic: اللَّهُ اللَّهُ رَبِّي لاَ أُشْرِكُ بِهِ شَيْئاً
duas.transliteration: Allāhu llāhu rabbī lā ushriku bihi shayʾā
duas.translation: Allah, Allah is my Lord, I do not associate anything with Him.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Invocations for anguish · Entry 125
duas.chapterTitle: Invocations for anguish

duas.title: Invocations for when you meet an adversary or a powerful ruler (1 of 3)
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَجْعَلُكَ فِي نُحُورِهِم، وَنَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شُرُورِهِمْ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma innā najʿaluka fī nuḥūrihim, wa naʿūdhu bika min shurūrihim
duas.translation: O Allah, we place You before them and we take refuge in You from their evil.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Invocations for when you meet an adversary or a powerful ruler · Entry 126
duas.chapterTitle: Invocations for when you meet an adversary or a powerful ruler

duas.title: Invocations for when you meet an adversary or a powerful ruler (2 of 3)
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ عَضُدِي، وَأَنْتَ نَصِيرِي، بِكَ أَحُولُ وَبِكَ أَصُولُ، وَبِكَ أُقاتِلُ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma anta ʿaḍudī, wa anta naṣīrī, bika aḥūlu wabika aṣūlu, wabika uqtil
duas.translation: O Allah, You are my supporter and You are my helper, by You I move and by You I attack and by You I battle.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Invocations for when you meet an adversary or a powerful ruler · Entry 127
duas.chapterTitle: Invocations for when you meet an adversary or a powerful ruler

duas.title: Invocations for when you meet an adversary or a powerful ruler (3 of 3)
duas.arabic: حَسْبُنا اللَّهُ وَنِعْمَ الْوَكِيلُ
duas.transliteration: Ḥasbun allāhu wa niʿma l-wakīl
duas.translation: Allah is sufficient for us, and how fine a trustee He is.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Invocations for when you meet an adversary or a powerful ruler · Entry 128
duas.chapterTitle: Invocations for when you meet an adversary or a powerful ruler

duas.title: Invocations against the oppression of rulers (1 of 2)
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ ربَّ السَّمَوَاتِ السَّبْعِ، وَرَبَّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ، كُنْ لِي جَاراً مِنْ فُلاَنِ بْنِ فُلاَنٍ، وَأَحْزَابِهِ مِنْ خَلاَئِقِكَ، أَنْ يَفْرُطَ عَلَيَّ أَحَدٌ مِنْهُمْ أَوْ يَطْغَى، عَزَّ جَارُكَ، وَجَلَّ ثَنَاؤُكَ، وَلاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma rbba as-samawāti as-sabʿi, warabba l-ʿarshi l-ʿaẓīmi, kun lī jāran min fulāni bni fulānin, wa aḥzābihi min khalāʾiqika, an yafruṭa ʿalayya aḥadun minhum aw yaṭghā, ʿazza jāruka, wajalla thanāʾuka, walā ilāha illā ant
duas.translation: O Allah, Lord of the seven heavens, Lord of the Magnificent Throne, be for me a support against [such and such a person] and his helpers from among your creatures, lest any of them abuse me or do me wrong. Mighty is your patronage and glorious are your praises. There is none worthy of worship but you.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Invocations against the oppression of rulers · Entry 129
duas.chapterTitle: Invocations against the oppression of rulers

duas.title: Invocations against the oppression of rulers (2 of 2)
duas.arabic: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَعَزُّ مِنْ خَلْقِهِ جَمِيعاً، اللَّهُ أَعَزُّ مِمَّا أَخَافُ وَأَحْذَرُ، أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ الَّذِي لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ، الْمُمْسِكِ السَّمَوَاتِ السَّبْعِ أَنْ يَقَعْنَ عَلَى الْأَرْضِ إِلاَّ بِإِذْنِهِ، مِنْ شَرِّ عَبْدِكَ فُلاَنٍ، وَجُنُودِهِ وَأَتْبَاعِهِ وَأَشْيَاعِهِ، مِنْ الْجِنِّ وَالإِنْسِ، اللَّهُمَّ كُنْ لِي جَاراً مِنْ شَرِّهِمْ، جَلَّ ثَنَاؤُكَ وَعَزَّ جَارُكَ، وَتَبَارَكَ اسْمُكَ، وَلاَ إِلَهَ غَيْرُكَ
duas.transliteration: Allāhu akbaru, allāhu aʿazzu min khalqihi jamīʿan, allāhu aʿazzu mimmā akhāfu wa aḥdharu, aʿūdhu bi-llāhi alladhī lā ilāha illā huwa, al-mumsiki as-samawāti as-sabʿi an yaqaʿna ʿalā l-ʾarḍi illā bi-idhnihi, min sharri ʿabdika fulānin, wa junūdihi wa atbāʿihi wa ashyāʿihi, min al-jinni wa-l-ʾinsi, allāhumma kun lī jāran min sharrihim, jalla thanāʾuka waʿazza jāruka, wa tabāraka ismuka, walā ilāha ghayruk
duas.translation: Allah is the Most Great, Mightier than all His creation. He is Mightier than what fear and dread. I seek refuge in Allah, Who there is none worthy of worship but Him. He is the One Who holds the seven heavens from falling upon the earth except by His command. [I seek refuge in You Allah] from the evil of Your slave [name of the person], and his helpers, his followers and his supporters from among the jinn and mankind. O Allah, be my support against their evil. Glorious Your praises and mighty is Your patronage. Blessed is Your Name, there is no true God but You.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Invocations against the oppression of rulers · Entry 130
duas.chapterTitle: Invocations against the oppression of rulers

duas.title: Invocation against an enemy
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ مُنْزِلَ الْكِتَابِ، سَرِيعَ الْحِسَابِ، اهْزِمِ الأَحْزَابَ، اللَّهُمَّ اهزِمْهُمْ وَزَلْزِلْهُمْ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma munzila l-kitābi, sarīʿa l-ḥisābi, ihzimi l-ʾaḥzāba, allāhumma hzimhum wa zalzilhum
duas.translation: O Allah, Revealer of the Book, Swift at reckoning, defeat the confederates. O Allah, defeat them and convulse them.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Invocation against an enemy · Entry 131
duas.chapterTitle: Invocation against an enemy

duas.title: What to say if you fear people may harm you
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اكْفِنِيهِمْ بِمَا شِئْتَ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma ikfinīhim bimā shiʾt
duas.translation: O Allah, protect me from them with what You choose.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · What to say if you fear people may harm you · Entry 132
duas.chapterTitle: What to say if you fear people may harm you

duas.title: Invocations for if you are stricken by doubt in your faith (2 of 3)
duas.arabic: آمَنْتُ بِاللَّهِ وَرُسُلِهِ
duas.transliteration: Āmantu bi-llāhi wa rusulih
duas.translation: I have believed in Allah and His Messenger.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Invocations for if you are stricken by doubt in your faith · Entry 134
duas.chapterTitle: Invocations for if you are stricken by doubt in your faith

duas.title: Invocations for if you are stricken by doubt in your faith (3 of 3)
duas.arabic: ﴿هُوَ الْأوَّلُ وَالْآخِرُ وَالظّاهِرُ وَالْباطِنُ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِيمٌ﴾
duas.transliteration: Huwa l-ʾwwalu wa-l-ʾākhiru wa aẓ-ẓhiru wa-l-bṭinu wahuwa bikulli shayʾin ʿalīm
duas.translation: He is the First and the Last, the Manifest and the Hidden, and He has full knowledge of everything.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Invocations for if you are stricken by doubt in your faith · Entry 135
duas.chapterTitle: Invocations for if you are stricken by doubt in your faith

duas.title: Invocations for the settling of a debt (1 of 2)
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اكْفِنِي بِحَلاَلِكَ عَنْ حَرَامِكَ، وَأَغْنِنِي بِفَضْلِكِ عَمَّنْ سِوَاكَ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma ikfinī bi-ḥalālika ʿan ḥarāmika, wa aghninī bi-faḍliki ʿamman siwāk
duas.translation: O Allah, make what is lawful enough for me, as opposed to what is unlawful, and spare me by Your grace, of need of others.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Invocations for the settling of a debt · Entry 136
duas.chapterTitle: Invocations for the settling of a debt

duas.title: Invocations for the settling of a debt (2 of 2)
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ، وَالْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ، وَالْبُخْلِ وَالْجُبْنِ، وَضَلَعِ الدَّيْنِ وَغَلَبَةِ الرِّجَالِ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma innī aʿūdhu bika mina l-hammi wa-l-ḥazani, wa-l-ʿajzi wa-l-kasali, wa-l-bukhli wa-l-jubni, wa ḍalaʿi ad-dayni wa ghalabati ar-rijāl
duas.translation: O Allah, I take refuge in You from anxiety and sorrow, weakness and laziness, miserliness and cowardice, the burden of debts and from being over powered by men.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Invocations for the settling of a debt · Entry 137
duas.chapterTitle: Invocations for the settling of a debt

duas.title: Invocation against the distractions of Satan during the prayer and recitation of the Quran
duas.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ
duas.transliteration: Aʿūdhu bi-llāhi mina ash-shayṭāni ar-rajīm
duas.translation: I seek refuge in Allah from the accursed devil.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Invocation against the distractions of Satan during the prayer and recitation of the Quran · Entry 138
duas.chapterTitle: Invocation against the distractions of Satan during the prayer and recitation of the Quran

duas.title: Invocation for when you find something becoming difficult for you
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لاَ سَهْلَ إِلاَّ مَا جَعَلْتَهُ سَهْلاً، وَأَنْتَ تَجْعَلُ الْحَزْنَ إِذَا شِئْتَ سَهْلاً
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma lā sahla illā mā jaʿaltahu sahlan, wa anta tajʿalu l-ḥazna idhā shiʾta sahlā
duas.translation: O Allah, there is no ease except in that which You have made easy, and You make the difficulty, if You wish, easy.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Invocation for when you find something becoming difficult for you · Entry 139
duas.chapterTitle: Invocation for when you find something becoming difficult for you

duas.title: Invocation for when something you dislike happens, or for when you fail to achieve what you attempt to do
duas.arabic: قَدَرُ اللَّهُ وَمَا شَاءَ فَعَلَ
duas.transliteration: Qadaru llāhu wamā shāʾa faʿal
duas.translation: Allah has decreed and what He wills, He does.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Invocation for when something you dislike happens, or for when you fail to achieve what you attempt to do · Entry 144
duas.chapterTitle: Invocation for when something you dislike happens, or for when you fail to achieve what you attempt to do

duas.title: Congratulations for new parents and how they should respond
duas.arabic: بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ فِي الْمَوْهُوبِ لَكَ، وَشَكَرْتَ الْوَاهِبَ، وَبَلَغَ أَشُدَّهُ، وَرُزِقْتَ بِرَّهُ
duas.transliteration: Bāraka llāhu laka fī l-mawhūbi laka, wa shakarta l-wāhiba, wa balagha ashuddahu, wa ruziqta birrah
duas.translation: May Allah bless the child granted to you, enable you to thank the Giver, allow the child to reach maturity, and bless you with the child’s dutifulness.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Congratulations for new parents and how they should respond · Entry 145
duas.chapterTitle: Congratulations for new parents and how they should respond

duas.title: Congratulations for new parents and how they should respond
duas.arabic: بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ وَبَارَكَ عَلَيْكَ، وَجَزَاكَ اللَّهُ خَيْراً، وَرَزَقَكَ اللَّهُ مِثْلَهُ، وَأَجْزَلَ ثَوَابَكَ
duas.transliteration: Bāraka llāhu laka wa bāraka ʿalayka, wa jazāka llāhu khayran, wa razaqaka llāhu mithlahu, wa ajzala thawābak
duas.translation: May Allah bless you and shower His blessings upon you, reward you with goodness, grant you a similar blessing, and make your reward abundant.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Congratulations for new parents and how they should respond · Entry 145
duas.chapterTitle: Congratulations for new parents and how they should respond

duas.title: How to seek Allah's protection for children
duas.arabic: أُعِيذُكُمَا بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّةِ مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْطَانٍ وَهَامَّةٍ، وَمِنْ كُلِّ عَيْنٍ لاَمَّةٍ
duas.transliteration: Uʿīdhukumā bi-ka-li-māti llāhi at-tāmmati min kulli shayṭānin wa hāmmatin, wamin kulli ʿaynin lāmmah
duas.translation: I commend you two to the protection of Allah’s perfect words from every devil, vermin, and every evil eye.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · How to seek Allah's protection for children · Entry 146
duas.chapterTitle: How to seek Allah's protection for children

duas.title: Invocations for visiting the sick (1 of 2)
duas.arabic: لاَ بأْسَ طَهُورٌ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ
duas.transliteration: Lā bʾsa ṭahūrun in shāʾa llāh
duas.translation: Never mind, may it the sickness be a purification, if Allah wills.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Invocations for visiting the sick · Entry 147
duas.chapterTitle: Invocations for visiting the sick

duas.title: Invocations for visiting the sick (2 of 2)
duas.arabic: أَسْأَلُ اللَّهَ الْعَظيمَ رَبَّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ أَنْ يَشْفيَكَ
duas.transliteration: Asʾalu llāha l-ʿaẓyma rabba l-ʿarshi l-ʿaẓīmi an yashfyak
duas.translation: I ask Allah The Supreme, Lord of the magnificent throne to cure you’. 7times he the sick person will be cured.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Invocations for visiting the sick · Entry 148
duas.chapterTitle: Invocations for visiting the sick

duas.title: Invocations of the terminally ill (1 of 3)
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي، وَارْحَمْنِي، وَأَلْحِقْنِي بِالرَّفِيقِ الْأَعْلَى
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma ighfir lī, wa irḥamnī, wa alḥiqnī bi-ar-rafīqi l-ʾaʿlā
duas.translation: ‘O Allaah, forgive me, have mercy upon me and unite me with the highest companions
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Invocations of the terminally ill · Entry 150
duas.chapterTitle: Invocations of the terminally ill

duas.title: Invocations of the terminally ill (2 of 3)
duas.arabic: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ إِنَّ لِلْمَوْتِ سَكَرَاتٍ
duas.transliteration: Lā ilāha illā llāhu inna lilmawti sakarāt
duas.translation: ‘None has the right to be worshipped except Allaah, death does indeed contain agony.’
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Invocations of the terminally ill · Entry 151
duas.chapterTitle: Invocations of the terminally ill

duas.title: Invocations of the terminally ill (3 of 3)
duas.arabic: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ لَهُ المُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَلاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِاللَّهِ
duas.transliteration: Lā ilāha illā llāhu wa-llāhu akbaru, lā ilāha illā llāhu waḥdahu, lā ilāha illā llāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lahu, lā ilāha illā llāhu lahu l-mulku walahu l-ḥamdu, lā ilāha illā llāhu walā ḥawla walā quwwata illā bi-llāh
duas.translation: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah and Allah is the greatest. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, to Him belongs all sovereignty and praise. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah and there is no might and no power except with Allah.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Invocations of the terminally ill · Entry 152
duas.chapterTitle: Invocations of the terminally ill

duas.title: What to encourage the dying person to say
duas.arabic: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ
duas.transliteration: Lā ilāha illā llāh
duas.translation: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · What to encourage the dying person to say · Entry 153
duas.chapterTitle: What to encourage the dying person to say

duas.title: Invocation for when tragedy strikes
duas.arabic: إِنَّا لِلَّهِ وَإِنَّا إِلَيْهِ رَاجِعُونَ، اللَّهُمَّ أْجُرْنِي فِي مُصِيبَتِي، وَأَخْلِفْ لِي خَيْرَاً مِنْهَا
duas.transliteration: Innā li-llāhi wa innā ilayhi rājiʿūna, allāhumma jurnī fī muṣībatī, wa akhlif lī khayrā minhā
duas.translation: To Allah we belong and unto Him is our return. O Allah, recompense me for my affliction and replace it for me with something better.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Invocation for when tragedy strikes · Entry 154
duas.chapterTitle: Invocation for when tragedy strikes

duas.title: Invocation for closing the eyes of the dead
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِـ{{deceasedName}} وَارْفَعْ دَرَجَتَهُ فِي الْمَهْدِيِّينَ، وَاخْلُفْهُ فِي عَقِبِهِ فِي الْغَابِرِينَ، وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَلَهُ يَا رَبَّ الْعَالَمِينَ، وَافْسَحْ لَهُ فِي قَبْرِهِ، وَنَوِّرْ لَهُ فِيهِ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma ighfir li-{{deceasedName}} wa irfaʿ darajatahu fī l-mahdiyyīna, wa ikhlufhu fī ʿaqibihi fī l-ghābirīna, wa ighfir lanā walahu yā rabba l-ʿālamīna, wa ifsaḥ lahu fī qabrihi, wa nawwir lahu fīh
duas.translation: O Allah, forgive {{deceasedName}} and raise his rank among the rightly guided, and be a successor to whom he has left behind, and forgive us and him O Lord of the worlds. Make spacious his grave and illuminate it for him.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Invocation for closing the eyes of the dead · Entry 155
duas.chapterTitle: Invocation for closing the eyes of the dead

duas.title: Invocations for the dead in the Funeral prayer (1 of 4)
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لَهُ وَارْحَمْهُ، وَعَافِهِ، وَاعْفُ عَنْهُ، وَأَكْرِمْ نُزُلَهُ، وَوَسِّعْ مُدْخَلَهُ، وَاغْسِلْهُ بِالْمَاءِ وَالثَّلْجِ وَالْبَرَدِ، وَنَقِّهِ مِنَ الْخَطَايَا كَمَا نَقَّيْتَ الثَّوْبَ الأَبْيَضَ مِنَ الدَّنَسِ، وَأَبْدِلْهُ دَاراً خَيْراً مِنْ دَارِهِ، وَأَهْلاً خَيْراً مِنْ أَهْلِهِ، وَزَوْجَاً خَيْراً مِنْ زَوْجِهِ، وَأَدْخِلْهُ الْجَنَّةَ، وَأَعِذْهُ مِنْ عَذَابِ القَبْرِ [وَعَذَابِ النَّارِ]
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma ighfir lahu wa irḥamhu, wa ʿāfihi, wa iʿfu ʿanhu, wa akrim nuzulahu, wa wassiʿ mudkhalahu, wa ighsilhu bi-l-māʾi wa ath-thalji wa-l-baradi, wa naqqihi mina l-khaṭāyā kamā naqqayta ath-thawba l-ʾabyaḍa mina ad-danasi, wa abdilhu dāran khayran min dārihi, wa ahlan khayran min ahlihi, wa zawjā khayran min zawjihi, wa adkhilhu l-jannata, wa aʿidhhu min ʿadhābi l-qabri wa ʿadhābi an-nār
duas.translation: O Allah, forgive and have mercy upon him, excuse him and pardon him, and make honourable his reception. Expand his entry, and cleanse him with water, snow, and ice, and purify him of sin as a white robe is purified of filth. Exchange his home for a better home, and his family for a better family, and his spouse for a better spouse. Admit him into the Garden, protect him from the punishment of the grave and the torment of the Fire.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Invocations for the dead in the Funeral prayer · Entry 156
duas.chapterTitle: Invocations for the dead in the Funeral prayer

duas.title: Invocations for the dead in the Funeral prayer (2 of 4)
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِحَيِّنَا وَمَيِّتِنَا، وَشَاهِدِنَا وَغَائِبِنَا، وَصَغِيرِنَا وَكَبيرِنَا، وَذَكَرِنَا وَأُنْثَانَا. اللَّهُمَّ مَنْ أَحْيَيْتَهُ مِنَّا فَأَحْيِهِ عَلَى الْإِسْلاَمِ، وَمَنْ تَوَفَّيْتَهُ مِنَّا فَتَوَفَّهُ عَلَى الإِيمَانِ، اللَّهُمَّ لاَ تَحْرِمْنَا أَجْرَهُ، وَلاَ تُضِلَّنَا بَعْدَهُ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma ighfir li-ḥayyinā wa mayyitinā, wa shāhidinā wa ghāʾibinā, wa ṣaghīrinā wa ka-byrinā, wa dhakarinā wa unthānā. allāhumma man aḥyaytahu minnā fa aḥyihi ʿalā l-ʾislāmi, waman tawaffaytahu minnā fa tawaffahu ʿalā l-ʾīmāni, allāhumma lā taḥrimnā ajrahu, walā tuḍillanā baʿdah
duas.translation: O Allah, forgive our living and our dead, those present and those absent, our young and our old, our males and our females. O Allah, whom amongst us You keep alive, then let such a life be upon Islam, and whom amongst us You take unto Yourself, then let such a death be upon faith. O Allah, do not deprive us of his reward and do not let us stray after him.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Invocations for the dead in the Funeral prayer · Entry 157
duas.chapterTitle: Invocations for the dead in the Funeral prayer

duas.title: Invocations for the dead in the Funeral prayer (3 of 4)
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّ فُلاَنَ بْنَ فُلاَنٍ فِي ذِمَّتِكَ، وَحَبْلِ جِوَارِكَ، فَقِهِ مِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْقَبْرِ، وَعَذَابِ النَّارِ، وَأَنْتَ أَهْلُ الْوَفَاءِ وَالْحَقِّ، فَاغْفِرْ لَهُ وَارْحَمْهُ إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الغَفُورُ الرَّحيمُ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma inna fulāna bna fulānin fī dhimmatika, wa ḥabli jiwārika, faqihi min fitnati l-qabri, wa ʿadhābi an-nāri, wa anta ahlu l-wafāʾi wa-l-ḥaqqi, fa ighfir lahu wa irḥamhu innaka anta l-ghafūru ar-raḥīm
duas.translation: O Allah, so-and-so is under Your care and protection so protect him from the trial of the grave and torment of the Fire. Indeed You are faithful and truthful. Forgive and have mercy upon him, surely You are The Oft-Forgiving, The Most-Merciful.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Invocations for the dead in the Funeral prayer · Entry 158
duas.chapterTitle: Invocations for the dead in the Funeral prayer

duas.title: Invocations for the dead in the Funeral prayer (4 of 4)
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ عَبْدُكَ وَابْنُ أَمَتِكَ احْتَاجَ إِلَى رَحْمَتِكَ، وَأَنْتَ غَنِيٌّ عَنْ عَذَابِهِ، إِنْ كَانَ مُحْسِناً فَزِدْ فِي حَسَنَاتِهِ، وَإِنْ كَانَ مُسِيئاً فَتَجَاوَزْ عَنْهُ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma ʿabduka wa ibnu amatika iḥtāja ilā raḥmatika, wa anta ghaniyyun ʿan ʿadhābihi, in kāna muḥsinan fazid fī ḥasanātihi, waʾin kāna musīʾan fa tajāwaz ʿanh
duas.translation: O Allah, Your servant and the son of Your maidservant is in need of Your mercy and You are without need of his punishment. If he was righteous then increase his reward and if he was wicked then look over his sins.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Invocations for the dead in the Funeral prayer · Entry 159
duas.chapterTitle: Invocations for the dead in the Funeral prayer

duas.title: Invocations for a child in the Funeral prayer (1 of 2)
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَعِذْهُ مِنْ عَذَابِ القَبْرِ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma aʿidhhu min ʿadhābi l-qabr
duas.translation: O Allah, protect him from the punishment of the grave.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Invocations for a child in the Funeral prayer · Entry 160
duas.chapterTitle: Invocations for a child in the Funeral prayer

duas.title: Invocations for a child in the Funeral prayer (1 of 2)
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْهُ فَرَطاً وَذُخْراً لِوَالِدَيْهِ، وَشَفِيعاً مُجَاباً، اللَّهُمَّ ثَقِّلْ بِهِ مَوَازِينَهُمَا، وَأَعْظِمْ بِهِ أُجورَهُمَا، وَأَلْحِقْهُ بِصَالِحِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ، وَاجْعَلْهُ فِي كَفَالَةِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَقِهِ بِرَحْمَتِكَ عَذَابَ الْجَحِيمِ، وَأَبْدِلْهُ دَاراً خَيْراً مِنْ دَارِهِ، وَأَهْلاً خَيْراً مِنْ أَهْلِهِ، اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِأَسْلاَفِنَا، وَأَفْرَاطِنَا، وَمَنْ سَبَقَنَا بِالْإِيمَانِ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma ijʿalhu fa raṭan wa dhukhran li-wa ad-dayhi, wa shafīʿan mujāban, allāhumma thaqqil bihi mawāzīnahumā, wa aʿẓim bihi ujwrahumā, wa alḥiqhu bi-ṣāliḥi l-muʾminīna, wa ijʿalhu fī ka-fa-l-ti ibrāhīma, waqihi bi-raḥmatika ʿadhāba l-jaḥīmi, wa abdilhu dāran khayran min dārihi, wa ahlan khayran min ahlihi, allāhumma ighfir li-aslāfinā, wa afrāṭinā, waman sabaqanā bi-l-ʾīmān
duas.translation: O Allah, make him a forerunner and a treasure for his parents, and an intercessor whose intercession is accepted. O Allah, make their scales heavy through him and increase their rewards through him. Join him with the righteous believers, place him in the care of Ibrahim, and protect him by Your mercy from the punishment of Hell. Grant him a home better than his home and a family better than his family. O Allah, forgive our predecessors, our children who died before us, and those who preceded us in faith.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Invocations for a child in the Funeral prayer · Entry 160
duas.chapterTitle: Invocations for a child in the Funeral prayer

duas.title: Invocations for a child in the Funeral prayer (2 of 2)
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْهُ لَنَا فَرَطاً، وَسَلَفاً، وَأَجْراً
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma ijʿalhu lanā fa raṭan, wa salafan, wa ajrā
duas.translation: O Allah, make him for us a precursor,a forerunner and a cause of reward
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Invocations for a child in the Funeral prayer · Entry 161
duas.chapterTitle: Invocations for a child in the Funeral prayer

duas.title: Invocation for the bereaved
duas.arabic: إِنَّ للَّهِ مَا أَخَذَ، وَلَهُ مَا أَعْطَى، وَكُلُّ شَيْءٍ عِنْدَهُ بِأَجَلٍ مُسَمَّى... فَلْتَصْبِرْ وَلْتَحْتَسِبْ
duas.transliteration: Inna li-llāhi mā akhadha, walahu mā aʿṭā, wakullu shayʾin ʿindahu bi-ajalin musammā... faltaṣbir waltaḥtasib
duas.translation: Indeed, to Allah belongs what He has taken, and to Him belongs what He has given. Everything with Him has an appointed term. So let her be patient and seek Allah’s reward.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Invocation for the bereaved · Entry 162
duas.chapterTitle: Invocation for the bereaved

duas.title: Invocation for the bereaved
duas.arabic: أَعْظَمَ اللَّهُ أَجْرَكَ، وَأَحْسَنَ عَزَاءَكَ، وَغَفَرَ لِمَيِّتِكَ
duas.transliteration: Aʿẓama llāhu ajraka, wa aḥsana ʿazāʾaka, wa ghafara li-mayyitik
duas.translation: May Allah increase your reward, comfort you in your bereavement, and forgive your deceased.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Invocation for the bereaved · Entry 162
duas.chapterTitle: Invocation for the bereaved

duas.title: Invocation to be recited when placing the dead in his grave
duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَعَلَى سُنَّةِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ
duas.transliteration: Bismi llāhi wa ʿalā sunnati rasūli llāh
duas.translation: In the name of Allah and upon the sunnah of the Messenger of Allah.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Invocation to be recited when placing the dead in his grave · Entry 163
duas.chapterTitle: Invocation to be recited when placing the dead in his grave

duas.title: Invocation to be recited after burying the dead
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لَهُ، اللَّهُمَّ ثَبِّتْهُ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma ighfir lahu, allāhumma thabbith
duas.translation: O Allah, forgive him. O Allah, strengthen him
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Invocation to be recited after burying the dead · Entry 164
duas.chapterTitle: Invocation to be recited after burying the dead

duas.title: Invocation for visiting the graves
duas.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكُمْ أَهْلَ الدِّيَارِ، مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُسْلِمِينَ، وَإِنَّا إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ بِكُمْ لاَحِقُونَ، [وَيَرْحَمُ اللَّهُ الْمُسْتَقدِمِينَ مِنَّا وَالْمُسْتأْخِرِينَ] أَسْأَلُ اللَّهَ لَنَا وَلَكُمُ الْعَافِيَةَ
duas.transliteration: As-salāmu ʿalaykum ahla ad-diyāri, mina l-muʾminīna wa-l-muslimīna, wa innā in shāʾa llāhu bikum lāḥiqūna, wa yarḥamu llāhu l-mustaqdimīna minnā wa-l-mustʾkhirīna asʾalu llāha lanā wa lakumu l-ʿāfiyah
duas.translation: Peace be upon you all, O inhabitants of the graves, amongst the believers and the Muslims. Verily we will, Allah willing, be united with you. [And may Allah have mercy on those of us who have gone before and those who come later.] I ask Allah for well-being for us and you.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Invocation for visiting the graves · Entry 165
duas.chapterTitle: Invocation for visiting the graves

duas.title: Invocations for when the wind blows (1 of 2)
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَهَا، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma innī asʾaluka khayrahā, wa aʿūdhu bika min sharrihā
duas.translation: O Allah, I ask You for it’s goodness and I take refuge with You from it’s evil.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Invocations for when the wind blows · Entry 166
duas.chapterTitle: Invocations for when the wind blows

duas.title: Invocations for when the wind blows (2 of 2)
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَهَا، وَخَيْرَ مَا فِيهَا، وَخَيْرَ مَا أُرْسِلَتْ بِهِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا، وَشَرِّ مَا فِيهَا، وَشَرِّ مَا أُرْسِلَتْ بِهِ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma innī asʾaluka khayrahā, wa khayra mā fīhā, wa khayra mā ursilat bihi, wa aʿūdhu bika min sharrihā, washarri mā fīhā, washarri mā ursilat bih
duas.translation: O Allah, I ask You for it’s goodness, the good within it, and the good it was sent with, and I take refuge with You from it’s evil, the evil within it, and from the evil it was sent with.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Invocations for when the wind blows · Entry 167
duas.chapterTitle: Invocations for when the wind blows

duas.title: Invocation for when it thunders
duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي يُسَبِّحُ الرَّعْدُ بِحَمْدِهِ وَالْمَلاَئِكةُ مِنْ خِيفَتِهِ
duas.transliteration: Subḥāna alladhī yusabbiḥu ar-raʿdu bi-ḥamdihi wa-l-malāʾiktu min khīfatih
duas.translation: How perfect He is, The One Whom the thunder declares His perfection with His praise, as do the angles out of fear of Him.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Invocation for when it thunders · Entry 168
duas.chapterTitle: Invocation for when it thunders

duas.title: Some invocations for rain (1 of 3)
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اسْقِنَا غَيْثاً مُغِيثاً مَرِيئاً مَرِيعاً، نَافِعاً غَيْرَ ضَارٍّ، عَاجِلاً غَيْرَ آجِلٍ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma isqinā ghaythan mughīthan marīʾan marīʿan, nāfiʿan ghayra ḍārrin, ʿājilan ghayra ājil
duas.translation: O Allah, send upon us helpful, wholesome and healthy rain, beneficial not harmful rain, now, not later.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Some invocations for rain · Entry 169
duas.chapterTitle: Some invocations for rain

duas.title: Some invocations for rain (2 of 3)
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَغِثْنَا، اللَّهُمَّ أَغِثْنَا، اللَّهُمَّ أَغِثْنَا
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma aghithnā, allāhumma aghithnā, allāhumma aghithnā
duas.translation: O Allah, relieve us, O Allah, relieve us, O Allah, relieve us.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Some invocations for rain · Entry 170
duas.chapterTitle: Some invocations for rain

duas.title: Some invocations for rain (3 of 3)
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اسْقِ عِبَادَكَ، وَبَهَائِمَكَ، وَانْشُرْ رَحْمَتَكَ، وَأَحْيِي بَلَدَكَ الْمَيِّتَ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma isqi ʿibādaka, wa bahāʾimaka, wa inshur raḥmataka, wa aḥyī baladaka l-mayyit
duas.translation: O Allah, provide water for Your servants and Your cattle, spread out Your mercy and resurrect Your dead land.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Some invocations for rain · Entry 171
duas.chapterTitle: Some invocations for rain

duas.title: Invocation for when it rains
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَيِّباً نَافِعاً
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣayyiban nāfiʿā
duas.translation: O Allah, may it be a beneficial rain cloud.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Invocation for when it rains · Entry 172
duas.chapterTitle: Invocation for when it rains

duas.title: Supplication after it rains
duas.arabic: مُطِرْنَا بِفَضْلِ اللَّهِ وَرَحْمَتِهِ
duas.transliteration: Muṭirnā bi-faḍli llāhi wa raḥmatih
duas.translation: We have been given rain by the grace and mercy of Allah.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Supplication after it rains · Entry 173
duas.chapterTitle: Supplication after it rains

duas.title: Invocation for the withholding of the rain
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ حَوَالَيْنَا وَلاَ عَلَيْنَا، اللَّهُمَّ عَلَى الآكَامِ وَالظِّرَابِ، وَبُطُونِ الْأَوْدِيَةِ، وَمَنَابِتِ الشَّجَرِ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma ḥawālaynā walā ʿalaynā, allāhumma ʿalā l-ʾākāmi wa aẓ-ẓirābi, wa buṭūni l-ʾawdiyati, wa manābiti ash-shajar
duas.translation: O Allah, let the rain fall around us and not upon us, O Allah, let it fall on the pastures, hills, valleys and the roots of trees.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Invocation for the withholding of the rain · Entry 174
duas.chapterTitle: Invocation for the withholding of the rain

duas.title: Invocation for sighting the new moon
duas.arabic: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُمَّ أَهِلَّهُ عَلَيْنَا بِالْأَمْنِ وَالْإِيمَانِ، وَالسَّلاَمَةِ وَالْإِسْلاَمِ، وَالتَّوْفِيقِ لِمَا تُحِبُّ رَبَّنَا وَتَرْضَى، رَبُّنَا وَرَبُّكَ اللَّهُ
duas.transliteration: Allāhu akbaru, allāhumma ahillahu ʿalaynā bi-l-ʾamni wa-l-ʾīmāni, wa as-salāmati wa-l-ʾislāmi, wa at-tawfīqi limā tuḥibbu rabbanā wa tarḍā, rabbunā wa rabbuka llāh
duas.translation: Allah is the greatest. O Allah, let the crescent loom above us in safety, faith, peace, and Islam, and in agreement with all that You love and pleases You. Our Lord and your Lord is Allah.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Invocation for sighting the new moon · Entry 175
duas.chapterTitle: Invocation for sighting the new moon

duas.title: Invocations for breaking the fast (1 of 2)
duas.arabic: ذَهَبَ الظَّمَأُ وَابْتَلَّتِ العُرُوقُ، وَثَبَتَ الْأَجْرُ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ
duas.transliteration: Dhahaba aẓ-ẓamaʾu wa ibtallati l-ʿurūqu, wa thabata l-ʾajru in shāʾa llāh
duas.translation: The thirst has gone and the veins are quenched, and reward is confirmed, if Allah wills.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Invocations for breaking the fast · Entry 176
duas.chapterTitle: Invocations for breaking the fast

duas.title: Invocations for breaking the fast (2 of 2)
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِرَحْمَتِكَ الَّتِي وَسِعَتْ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ أَنْ تَغْفِرَ لِي
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma innī asʾaluka bi-raḥmatika allatī wa siʿat kulla shayʾin an taghfira lī
duas.translation: O Allah, I ask You by Your mercy which envelopes all things, that You forgive me.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Invocations for breaking the fast · Entry 177
duas.chapterTitle: Invocations for breaking the fast

duas.title: Invocations before eating (1 of 2)
duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ
duas.transliteration: Bismi llāh
duas.translation: In the name of Allah.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Invocations before eating · Entry 178
duas.chapterTitle: Invocations before eating

duas.title: Invocations before eating (1 of 2)
duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ فِي أَوَّلِهِ وَآخِرِهِ
duas.transliteration: Bismi llāhi fī awwalihi wa ākhirih
duas.translation: In the name of Allah at its beginning and its end.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Invocations before eating · Entry 178
duas.chapterTitle: Invocations before eating

duas.title: Invocations before eating (2 of 2)
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِيهِ وَأَطْعِمْنَا خَيْراً مِنْهُ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma bārik lanā fīhi wa aṭʿimnā khayran minh
duas.translation: O Allah, bless it for us and provide us with food better than it.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Invocations before eating · Entry 179
duas.chapterTitle: Invocations before eating

duas.title: Invocations before eating (2 of 2)
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِيهِ وَزِدْنَا مِنْهُ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma bārik lanā fīhi wa zidnā minh
duas.translation: O Allah, bless it for us and give us more of it.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Invocations before eating · Entry 179
duas.chapterTitle: Invocations before eating

duas.title: Invocations after eating (1 of 2)
duas.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنِي هَذَا، وَرَزَقَنِيهِ، مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِنِّي وَلاَ قُوَّةٍ
duas.transliteration: Al-ḥamdu li-llāhi alladhī aṭʿamanī hādhā, wa razaqanīhi, min ghayri ḥawlin minnī walā quwwah
duas.translation: All praise is for Allah who fed me this and provided it for me without any might nor power from myself.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Invocations after eating · Entry 180
duas.chapterTitle: Invocations after eating

duas.title: Invocations after eating (2 of 2)
duas.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ حَمْداً كَثِيراً طَيِّباً مُبَارَكاً فِيهِ، غَيْرَ [مَكْفِيٍّ وَلاَ ] مُوَدَّعٍ، وَلاَ مُسْتَغْنَىً عَنْهُ رَبَّنَا
duas.transliteration: Al-ḥamdu li-llāhi ḥamdan ka-thīran ṭayyiban mubārakan fīhi, ghayra makfiyyin walā muwaddaʿin, walā mustaghnayan ʿanhu rabbanā
duas.translation: Allah be praised with an abundant beautiful blessed praise, a never-ending praise, a praise which we will never bid farewell to and an indispensable praise, He is our Lord. There are other views as regards to the understanding of this supplication, from them: Allah be praised with an abundant beautiful blessed praise. He is The One Who is sufficient, feeds and is not fed. The One Who is longed for, along with that which is with Him and The One Who is needed, He is our Lord.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Invocations after eating · Entry 181
duas.chapterTitle: Invocations after eating

duas.title: A dinner guest's invocation for his host
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَهُمْ فِيمَا رَزَقْتَهُم، وَاغْفِرْ لَهُمْ وَارْحَمْهُمْ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma bārik lahum fīmā razaqtahum, wa ighfir lahum wa irḥamhum
duas.translation: O Allah, bless for them, that which You have provided them, forgive them and have mercy upon them.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · A dinner guest's invocation for his host · Entry 182
duas.chapterTitle: A dinner guest's invocation for his host

duas.title: Invocation for someone who gives you drink or offers it to you
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَطْعِمْ مَنْ أَطْعَمَنِي، وَاسْقِ مَنْ سَقَانِي
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma aṭʿim man aṭʿamanī, wa isqi man saqānī
duas.translation: O Allah, feed him who fed me, and provide with drink him who provided me with drink.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Invocation for someone who gives you drink or offers it to you · Entry 183
duas.chapterTitle: Invocation for someone who gives you drink or offers it to you

duas.title: Invocation for a family who invites you to break your fast with them
duas.arabic: أَفْطَرَ عِنْدَكُمُ الصَّائِمُونَ، وَأَكَلَ طَعَامَكُمُ الْأَبْرَارُ، وَصَلَّتْ عَلَيْكُمُ الْمَلاَئِكَةُ
duas.transliteration: Afṭara ʿindakumu aṣ-ṣāʾimūna, wa akala ṭaʿāmakumu l-ʾabrāru, wa ṣallat ʿalaykumu l-malāʾikah
duas.translation: May the fasting break their fast in your home, and may the dutiful and pious eat your food, and may the angles send prayers upon you.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Invocation for a family who invites you to break your fast with them · Entry 184
duas.chapterTitle: Invocation for a family who invites you to break your fast with them

duas.title: What to say when you are fasting and someone is rude to you
duas.arabic: إِنِّي صَائِمٌ، إِنِّي صَائِمٌ
duas.transliteration: Innī ṣāʾimun, innī ṣāʾim
duas.translation: I am fasting, I am fasting.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · What to say when you are fasting and someone is rude to you · Entry 186
duas.chapterTitle: What to say when you are fasting and someone is rude to you

duas.title: Invocation for when you see the first dates of the season
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِي ثَمَرِنَا، وَبَارِكْ لَنَا فِي مَدِينَتِنَا، وَبَارِكْ لَنَا فِي صَاعِنَا، وَبَارِكْ لَنَا فِي مُدِّنَا
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma bārik lanā fī thamarinā, wa bārik lanā fī madīnatinā, wa bārik lanā fī ṣāʿinā, wa bārik lanā fī muddinā
duas.translation: O Allah, bless our fruit for us, bless our town for us, bless our saʿ for us and bless our mudd for us.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Invocation for when you see the first dates of the season · Entry 187
duas.chapterTitle: Invocation for when you see the first dates of the season

duas.title: Invocation for sneezing
duas.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ
duas.transliteration: Al-ḥamdu li-llāh
duas.translation: All praise is for Allah.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Invocation for sneezing · Entry 188
duas.chapterTitle: Invocation for sneezing

duas.title: Invocation for sneezing
duas.arabic: يَرْحَمُكَ اللَّهُ
duas.transliteration: Yarḥamuka llāh
duas.translation: May Allah have mercy on you.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Invocation for sneezing · Entry 188
duas.chapterTitle: Invocation for sneezing

duas.title: Invocation for sneezing
duas.arabic: يَهْدِيكُمُ اللَّهُ وَيُصْلِحُ بَالَكُمْ
duas.transliteration: Yahdīkumu llāhu wa yuṣliḥu bālakum
duas.translation: May Allah guide you and set your affairs right.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Invocation for sneezing · Entry 188
duas.chapterTitle: Invocation for sneezing

duas.title: What to say to the disbeliever if he sneezes and praises Allah
duas.arabic: يَهْدِيكُمُ اللَّهُ وَيُصْلِحُ بَالَكُمْ
duas.transliteration: Yahdīkumu llāhu wa yuṣliḥu bālakum
duas.translation: May Allah guide you and rectify your condition.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · What to say to the disbeliever if he sneezes and praises Allah · Entry 189
duas.chapterTitle: What to say to the disbeliever if he sneezes and praises Allah

duas.title: Invocation for the groom
duas.arabic: بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ، وَبَارَكَ عَلَيْكَ، وَجَمَعَ بَيْنَكُمَا فِي خَيْرٍ
duas.transliteration: Bāraka llāhu laka, wa bāraka ʿalayka, wa jamaʿa baynakumā fī khayr
duas.translation: May Allah bless for you your spouse and bless you, and may He unite both of you in goodness.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Invocation for the groom · Entry 190
duas.chapterTitle: Invocation for the groom

duas.title: The groom’s supplication on the wedding night or when buying an animal
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَهَا، وَخَيْرَ مَا جَبَلْتَهَا عَلَيْهِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا، وَشَرِّ مَا جَبَلْتَهَا عَلَيْهِ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma innī asʾaluka khayrahā, wa khayra mā jabaltahā ʿalayhi, wa aʿūdhu bika min sharrihā, washarri mā jabaltahā ʿalayh
duas.translation: O Allah, I ask You for the goodness within her and the goodness that you have made her inclined towards, and I take refuge with You from the evil within her and the evil that you have made her inclined towards.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · The groom’s supplication on the wedding night or when buying an animal · Entry 191
duas.chapterTitle: The groom’s supplication on the wedding night or when buying an animal

duas.title: Invocation to be recited before intercourse
duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، اللَّهُمَّ جَنِّبْنَا الشَّيْطَانَ، وَجَنِّبِ الشَّيْطَانَ مَا رَزَقْتَنَا
duas.transliteration: Bismi llāhi, allāhumma jannibnā ash-shayṭāna, wa jannibi ash-shayṭāna mā razaqtanā
duas.translation: In the name of Allah. O Allah, keep the devil away from us and keep the devil away from what you have blessed us with.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Invocation to be recited before intercourse · Entry 192
duas.chapterTitle: Invocation to be recited before intercourse

duas.title: Invocation for anger
duas.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ
duas.transliteration: Aʿūdhu bi-llāhi mina ash-shayṭāni ar-rajīm
duas.translation: I take refuge with Allah from the accursed devil.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Invocation for anger · Entry 193
duas.chapterTitle: Invocation for anger

duas.title: What to say if you see someone afflicted by misfortune
duas.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي عَافَانِي مِمَّا ابْتَلاَكَ بِهِ، وَفَضَّلَنِي عَلَى كَثِيرٍ مِمَّنْ خَلَقَ تَفْضِيلاً
duas.transliteration: Al-ḥamdu li-llāhi alladhī ʿāfānī mimmā ibtalāka bihi, wa faḍḍalanī ʿalā ka-thīrin mimman khalaqa tafḍīlā
duas.translation: All praise is for Allah Who saved me from that which He tested you with and Who most certainly favoured me over much of His creation.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · What to say if you see someone afflicted by misfortune · Entry 194
duas.chapterTitle: What to say if you see someone afflicted by misfortune

duas.title: What to say while sitting in an assembly
duas.arabic: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي، وَتُبْ عَلَيَّ، إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ التَّوَّابُ الغَفُورُ
duas.transliteration: Rabbi ighfir lī, watub ʿalayya, innaka anta at-tawwābu l-ghafūr
duas.translation: O my Lord, forgive me and turn towards me to accept my repentance. Verily You are The Oft-Returning. The Oft-Forgiving.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · What to say while sitting in an assembly · Entry 195
duas.chapterTitle: What to say while sitting in an assembly

duas.title: The Expiation of Assembly - Kaffaratul-Majlis
