duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ، أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْكَ
duas.transliteration: Subḥānaka llāhumma wa bi-ḥamdika, ashhadu an lā ilāha illā anta, astaghfiruka wa atūbu ilayk
duas.translation: How perfect You are O Allah, and I praise You. I bear witness that None has the right to be worshipped except You. I seek Your forgiveness and turn to You in repentance.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · The Expiation of Assembly - Kaffaratul-Majlis · Entry 196
duas.chapterTitle: The Expiation of Assembly - Kaffaratul-Majlis

duas.title: Invocation for someone who says: May Allah forgive you
duas.arabic: وَلَكَ
duas.transliteration: Walak
duas.translation: and you.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Invocation for someone who says: May Allah forgive you · Entry 197
duas.chapterTitle: Invocation for someone who says: May Allah forgive you

duas.title: Invocation for someone who does good to you
duas.arabic: جَزَاكَ اللَّهُ خَيْراً
duas.transliteration: Jazāka llāhu khayrā
duas.translation: May Allah reward you with goodness.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Invocation for someone who does good to you · Entry 198
duas.chapterTitle: Invocation for someone who does good to you

duas.title: Invocation for someone who tells you I love you for the sake of Allah
duas.arabic: أَحَبَّكَ الَّذِي أَحْبَبْتَنِي لَهُ
duas.transliteration: Aḥabbaka alladhī aḥbabtanī lah
duas.translation: May He, for whom you have loved me, love you.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Invocation for someone who tells you I love you for the sake of Allah · Entry 200
duas.chapterTitle: Invocation for someone who tells you I love you for the sake of Allah

duas.title: Invocation for someone who offers you a share of his wealth
duas.arabic: بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ فِي أَهْلِكَ وَمَالِكَ
duas.transliteration: Bāraka llāhu laka fī ahlika wa mālik
duas.translation: May Allah bless for you, your family and wealth.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Invocation for someone who offers you a share of his wealth · Entry 201
duas.chapterTitle: Invocation for someone who offers you a share of his wealth

duas.title: Invocation (upon receipt of the loan) for someone who lends you money
duas.arabic: بارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ فِي أَهْلِكَ وَمَالِكَ، إِنَّمَا جَزَاءُ السَّلَفِ الْحَمْدُ وَالأَدَاءُ
duas.transliteration: Braka llāhu laka fī ahlika wa mālika, innamā jazāʾu as-salafi l-ḥamdu wa-l-ʾadāʾ
duas.translation: May Allah bless for you, your family and wealth. Surely commendation and payment are the reward for a loan.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Invocation (upon receipt of the loan) for someone who lends you money · Entry 202
duas.chapterTitle: Invocation (upon receipt of the loan) for someone who lends you money

duas.title: Invocation for fear of Shirk
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ أُشْرِكَ بِكَ وَأَنَا أَعْلَمُ، وَأَسْتَغْفِرُكَ لِمَا لاَ أَعْلَمُ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma innī aʿūdhu bika an ushrika bika wa anā aʿlamu, wa astaghfiruka limā lā aʿlam
duas.translation: O Allah, I take refuge in You lest I should commit shirk with You knowingly and I seek Your forgiveness for what I do unknowingly.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Invocation for fear of Shirk · Entry 203
duas.chapterTitle: Invocation for fear of Shirk

duas.title: Invocation for someone who tells you: May Allah bless you
duas.arabic: وَفِيكَ بَارَكَ اللَّهُ
duas.transliteration: Wa fīka bāraka llāh
duas.translation: and may Allah bless them.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Invocation for someone who tells you: May Allah bless you · Entry 204
duas.chapterTitle: Invocation for someone who tells you: May Allah bless you

duas.title: Invocation against evil portent
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لاَ طَيْرَ إِلاَّ طَيْرُكَ، وَلاَ خَيْرَ إِلاَّ خَيْرُكَ، وَلاَ إِلَهَ غَيْرُكَ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma lā ṭayra illā ṭayruka, walā khayra illā khayruka, walā ilāha ghayruk
duas.translation: O Allah, there is no omen but there is reliance on You, there is no good except Your good and none has the right to be worshipped except You.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Invocation against evil portent · Entry 205
duas.chapterTitle: Invocation against evil portent

duas.title: Invocation for riding in a vehicle or on an animal
duas.arabic: ((بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ للَّهِ ﴿سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ، وَإِنَّا إِلَى رَبِّنَا لَمُنقَلِبُونَ﴾، ((الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي؛ فَإِنَّهُ لاَ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ))
duas.transliteration: Bismi llāhi, wa-l-ḥamdu li-llāhi subḥāna alladhī sakhkhara lanā hādhā wamā kunnā lahu muqrinīna, wa innā ilā rabbinā lamunqalibūna l-ḥamdu li-llāhi, al-ḥamdu li-llāhi, al-ḥamdu li-llāhi, allāhu akbaru, allāhu akbaru, allāhu akbaru, subḥānaka llāhumma innī ẓalamtu nafsī fa ighfir lī; fa innahu lā yaghfiru adh-dhunūba illā ant
duas.translation: In the name of Allah and all praise is for Allah. How perfect He is, the One Who has placed this transport at our service and we ourselves would not have been capable of that, and to our Lord is our final destiny. All praise is for Allah, All praise is for Allah, All praise is for Allah, Allah is the greatest, Allah is the greatest, Allah is the greatest. How perfect You are, O Allah, verily I have wronged my soul, so forgive me, for surely none can forgive sins except You.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Invocation for riding in a vehicle or on an animal · Entry 206
duas.chapterTitle: Invocation for riding in a vehicle or on an animal

duas.title: Invocation for traveling
duas.arabic: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، ﴿سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ * وَإِنَّا إِلَى رَبِّنَا لَمُنقَلِبُونَ﴾ اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَسْأَلُكَ فِي سَفَرِنَا هَذَا البِرَّ وَالتَّقْوَى، وَمِنَ الْعَمَلِ مَا تَرْضَى، اللَّهُمَّ هَوِّنْ عَلَيْنَا سَفَرَنَا هَذَا وَاطْوِ عَنَّا بُعْدَهُ، اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ الصَّاحِبُ فِي السَّفَرِ، وَالْخَلِيفَةُ فِي الْأَهْلِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ وَعْثَاءِ السَّفَرِ، وَكَآبَةِ الْمَنْظَرِ، وَسُوءِ الْمُنْقَلَبِ فِي الْمَالِ وَالْأَهْلِ
duas.transliteration: Allāhu akbaru, allāhu akbaru, allāhu akbaru, subḥāna alladhī sakhkhara lanā hādhā wamā kunnā lahu muqrinīna wa innā ilā rabbinā lamunqalibūna llāhumma innā nasʾaluka fī safarinā hādhā l-birra wa at-taqwā, wamina l-ʿamali mā tarḍā, allāhumma hawwin ʿalaynā safaranā hādhā wa iṭwi ʿannā buʿdahu, allāhumma anta aṣ-ṣāḥibu fī as-safari, wa-l-khalīfatu fī l-ʾahli, allāhumma innī aʿūdhu bika min waʿthāʾi as-safari, wa kābati l-manẓari, wa sūʾi l-munqalabi fī l-māli wa-l-ʾahl
duas.translation: Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest. Glory be to the One who has subjected this to us, though we could never have managed it ourselves. Surely, to our Lord we will return. O Allah, we ask You on this journey of ours for righteousness and piety, and for deeds that please You. O Allah, make this journey easy for us and shorten its distance. O Allah, You are the Companion on the journey and the One who watches over the family. O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the hardship of travel, from distressing sights, and from returning to find harm in our wealth or family.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Invocation for traveling · Entry 207
duas.chapterTitle: Invocation for traveling

duas.title: Invocation for traveling
duas.arabic: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، ﴿سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ * وَإِنَّا إِلَى رَبِّنَا لَمُنقَلِبُونَ﴾ اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَسْأَلُكَ فِي سَفَرِنَا هَذَا البِرَّ وَالتَّقْوَى، وَمِنَ الْعَمَلِ مَا تَرْضَى، اللَّهُمَّ هَوِّنْ عَلَيْنَا سَفَرَنَا هَذَا وَاطْوِ عَنَّا بُعْدَهُ، اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ الصَّاحِبُ فِي السَّفَرِ، وَالْخَلِيفَةُ فِي الْأَهْلِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ وَعْثَاءِ السَّفَرِ، وَكَآبَةِ الْمَنْظَرِ، وَسُوءِ الْمُنْقَلَبِ فِي الْمَالِ وَالْأَهْلِ
duas.transliteration: Allāhu akbaru, allāhu akbaru, allāhu akbaru, subḥāna alladhī sakhkhara lanā hādhā wamā kunnā lahu muqrinīna wa innā ilā rabbinā lamunqalibūna llāhumma innā nasʾaluka fī safarinā hādhā l-birra wa at-taqwā, wamina l-ʿamali mā tarḍā, allāhumma hawwin ʿalaynā safaranā hādhā wa iṭwi ʿannā buʿdahu, allāhumma anta aṣ-ṣāḥibu fī as-safari, wa-l-khalīfatu fī l-ʾahli, allāhumma innī aʿūdhu bika min waʿthāʾi as-safari, wa kābati l-manẓari, wa sūʾi l-munqalabi fī l-māli wa-l-ʾahl
duas.translation: Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest. Glory be to the One who has subjected this to us, though we could never have managed it ourselves. Surely, to our Lord we will return. O Allah, we ask You on this journey of ours for righteousness and piety, and for deeds that please You. O Allah, make this journey easy for us and shorten its distance. O Allah, You are the Companion on the journey and the One who watches over the family. O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the hardship of travel, from distressing sights, and from returning to find harm in our wealth or family.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Invocation for traveling · Entry 207
duas.chapterTitle: Invocation for traveling

duas.title: Invocation for traveling
duas.arabic: آيِبُونَ، تَائِبُونَ، عَابِدُونَ، لِرَبِّنَا حَامِدُونَ
duas.transliteration: Āyibūna, tāʾibūna, ʿābidūna, li-rabbinā ḥāmidūn
duas.translation: We return, repent, worship, and praise our Lord.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Invocation for traveling · Entry 207
duas.chapterTitle: Invocation for traveling

duas.title: Invocation for entering a town or city
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ السَّمَوَاتِ السَّبْعِ وَمَا أَظْلَلْنَ، وَرَبَّ الأَرَضِينَ السَّبْعِ وَمَا أَقْلَلْنَ، وَرَبَّ الشَّياطِينِ وَمَا أَضْلَلْنَ، وَرَبَّ الرِّيَاحِ وَمَا ذَرَيْنَ، أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ هَذِهِ الْقَرْيَةِ، وَخَيْرَ أَهْلِهَا، وَخَيْرَ مَا فِيهَا، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا، وَشَرِّ أَهْلِهَا، وَشَرِّ مَا فِيهَا
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma rabba as-samawāti as-sabʿi wamā aẓlalna, warabba l-ʾaraḍīna as-sabʿi wamā aqlalna, warabba ash-shayṭīni wamā aḍlalna, warabba ar-riyāḥi wamā dharayna, asʾaluka khayra hādhihi l-qaryati, wa khayra ahlihā, wa khayra mā fīhā, wa aʿūdhu bika min sharrihā, washarri ahlihā, washarri mā fīhā
duas.translation: O Allah, Lord of the seven heavens and all that they envelop, Lord of the seven earths and all that they carry, Lord of the devils and all whom they misguide, Lord of the winds and all whom they whisk away. I ask You for the goodness of this village, the goodness of its inhabitants and for all the goodness found within it and I take refuge with You from the evil of this village, the evil of its inhabitants and from all the evil found within it.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Invocation for entering a town or city · Entry 208
duas.chapterTitle: Invocation for entering a town or city

duas.title: Invocation for entering a market
duas.arabic: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ، وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ، وَهُوَ حَيٌّ لاِ يَمُوتُ، بِيَدِهِ الْخَيْرُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
duas.transliteration: Lā ilāha illā llāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lahu, lahu l-mulku, walahu l-ḥamdu, yuḥyī wa yumītu, wahuwa ḥayyun lʾi yamūtu, bi-yadihi l-khayru, wahuwa ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīr
duas.translation: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner, to Him belongs all sovereignty and praise. He gives life and causes death, and He is living and does not die. In His hand is all good and He is over all things, omnipotent.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Invocation for entering a market · Entry 209
duas.chapterTitle: Invocation for entering a market

duas.title: Invocation for when your vehicle or mount begins to fail
duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ
duas.transliteration: Bismi llāh
duas.translation: In the name of Allah.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Invocation for when your vehicle or mount begins to fail · Entry 210
duas.chapterTitle: Invocation for when your vehicle or mount begins to fail

duas.title: The traveler's invocation for the one he leaves behind
duas.arabic: أَسْتَوْدِعُكُمُ اللَّهَ الَّذِي لاَ تَضِيعُ وَدَائِعُهُ
duas.transliteration: Astawdiʿukumu llāha alladhī lā taḍīʿu wa dāʾiʿuh
duas.translation: I place you in the trust of Allah, whose trust is never misplaced.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · The traveler's invocation for the one he leaves behind · Entry 211
duas.chapterTitle: The traveler's invocation for the one he leaves behind

duas.title: The resident's invocations for the traveler (1 of 2)
duas.arabic: أَسْتَوْدِعُ اللَّهَ دِينَكَ، وَأَمَانَتَكَ، وَخَوَاتِيمَ عَمَلِكَ
duas.transliteration: Astawdiʿu llāha dīnaka, wa amānataka, wa khawātīma ʿamalik
duas.translation: I place your religion, your faithfulness and the ends of your deeds in the trust of Allah.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · The resident's invocations for the traveler · Entry 212
duas.chapterTitle: The resident's invocations for the traveler

duas.title: The resident's invocations for the traveler (2 of 2)
duas.arabic: زَوَّدَكَ اللَّهُ التَّقْوَى، وَغَفَرَ ذَنْبَكَ، وَيَسَّرَ لَكَ الخَيْرَ حَيْثُ ما كُنْتَ
duas.transliteration: Zawwadaka llāhu at-taqwā, wa ghafara dhanbaka, wa yassara laka l-khayra ḥaythu m kunt
duas.translation: May Allah endow you with taqwa, forgive your sins and facilitate all good for you, wherever you be.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · The resident's invocations for the traveler · Entry 213
duas.chapterTitle: The resident's invocations for the traveler

duas.title: The traveler's invocation at dawn
duas.arabic: سَمَّعَ سَامِعٌ بِحَمْدِ اللَّهِ، وَحُسْنِ بَلاَئِهِ عَلَيْنَا، رَبَّنَا صاحِبْنَا، وَأَفْضِلْ عَلَيْنَا، عَائِذاً بِاللَّهِ مِنَ النَّارِ
duas.transliteration: Sammaʿa sāmiʿun bi-ḥamdi llāhi, wa ḥusni balāʾihi ʿalaynā, rabbanā ṣḥibnā, wa afḍil ʿalaynā, ʿāʾidhan bi-llāhi mina an-nār
duas.translation: May a witness, be witness to our praise of Allah for His favours and bounties upon us. Our Lord, protect us, show favour on us and deliver us from every evil. I take refuge in Allah from the fire.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · The traveler's invocation at dawn · Entry 215
duas.chapterTitle: The traveler's invocation at dawn

duas.title: Invocation for a layover (stopping along the way) on the journey
duas.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
duas.transliteration: Aʿūdhu bi-ka-li-māti llāhi at-tāmmāti min sharri mā khalaq
duas.translation: I take refuge in Allah’s perfect words from the evil that He has created.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Invocation for a layover (stopping along the way) on the journey · Entry 216
duas.chapterTitle: Invocation for a layover (stopping along the way) on the journey

duas.title: What to say upon returning from a Journey
duas.arabic: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ، وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، آيِبُونَ، تَائِبُونَ، عَابِدُونَ، لِرَبِّنا حَامِدُونَ، صَدَقَ اللَّهُ وَعْدَهُ، وَنَصَرَ عَبْدَهُ، وَهَزَمَ الْأَحْزابَ وَحْدَهُ
duas.transliteration: Lā ilāha illā llāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lahu, lahu l-mulku, walahu l-ḥamdu, wahuwa ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīrun, āyibūna, tāʾibūna, ʿābidūna, li-rabbin ḥāmidūna, ṣadaqa llāhu waʿdahu, wa naṣara ʿabdahu, wa hazama l-ʾaḥzba waḥdah
duas.translation: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner. To Him belongs all sovereignty and praise, and He is over all things omnipotent. We return, repent, worship and praise our Lord. Allah fulfilled His promise, aided His Servant, and single-handedly defeated the allies.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · What to say upon returning from a Journey · Entry 217
duas.chapterTitle: What to say upon returning from a Journey

duas.title: What to say if something happens to please you or to displease you
duas.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي بِنِعْمَتِهِ تَتِمُّ الصَّالِحَاتُ
duas.transliteration: Al-ḥamdu li-llāhi alladhī bi-niʿmatihi tatimmu aṣ-ṣāliḥāt
duas.translation: All praise is for Allah, by whose grace good things are brought to completion.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · What to say if something happens to please you or to displease you · Entry 218
duas.chapterTitle: What to say if something happens to please you or to displease you

duas.title: What to say if something happens to please you or to displease you
duas.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ عَلَى كُلِّ حَالٍ
duas.transliteration: Al-ḥamdu li-llāhi ʿalā kulli ḥāl
duas.translation: All praise is for Allah in every circumstance.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · What to say if something happens to please you or to displease you · Entry 218
duas.chapterTitle: What to say if something happens to please you or to displease you

duas.title: How to reply to a disbeliever if he says Salam to you
duas.arabic: وَعَلَيْكُمْ
duas.transliteration: Wa ʿalaykum
duas.translation: And upon you.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · How to reply to a disbeliever if he says Salam to you · Entry 227
duas.chapterTitle: How to reply to a disbeliever if he says Salam to you

duas.title: Invocation for someone you have spoken ill to
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ فَأَيُّمَا مُؤْمِنٍ سَبَبْتُهُ فَاجْعَلْ ذَلِكَ لَهُ قُرْبَةً إِلَيْكَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma fa ayyumā muʾminin sababtuhu fa ijʿal dhālika lahu qurbatan ilayka yawma l-qiyāmah
duas.translation: O Allah, to any believer whom I have insulted, let that be cause to draw him near to You on the Day of Resurrection.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Invocation for someone you have spoken ill to · Entry 230
duas.chapterTitle: Invocation for someone you have spoken ill to

duas.title: How a Muslim should praise another Muslim
duas.arabic: أَحْسِبُ فُلاَناً وَاللَّهُ حَسِيبُهُ، وَلاَ أُزَكِّي عَلَى اللَّهِ أَحَداً
duas.transliteration: Aḥsibu fulānan wa-llāhu ḥasībuhu, walā uzakkī ʿalā llāhi aḥadā
duas.translation: I consider so-and-so [to be…], and Allah is his Reckoner. I do not declare anyone pure before Allah.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · How a Muslim should praise another Muslim · Entry 231
duas.chapterTitle: How a Muslim should praise another Muslim

duas.title: What a Muslim should say when he is praised
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لاَ تُؤَاخِذْنِي بِمَا يَقُولُونَ، وَاغْفِرْ لِي مَا لاَ يَعْلَمُونَ، [وَاجْعَلْنِي خَيْراً مِمَّا يَظُّنُّونَ]
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma lā tuʾākhidhnī bimā yaqūlūna, wa ighfir lī mā lā yaʿlamūna, wa ijʿalnī khayran mimmā yaẓẓunnūn
duas.translation: O Allah, do not call me to account for what they say and forgive me for what they have no knowledge of [and make me better than they imagine].
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · What a Muslim should say when he is praised · Entry 232
duas.chapterTitle: What a Muslim should say when he is praised

duas.title: The pilgrim's announcement of his arrival for Hajj or Umrah
duas.arabic: لَبَّيْكَ اللَّهُمَّ لَبَّيْكَ، لَبَّيْكَ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَكَ لَبَّيْكَ، إِنَّ الْحَمْدَ، وَالنِّعْمَةَ، لَكَ وَالْمُلْكَ، لاَ شَرِيكَ لَكَ
duas.transliteration: Labbayka llāhumma labbayka, labbayka lā sharīka laka labbayka, inna l-ḥamda, wa an-niʿmata, laka wa-l-mulka, lā sharīka lak
duas.translation: Here I am O Allah, in response to Your call, here I am. Here I am, You have no partner, here I am. Verily all praise, grace and sovereignty belong to You. You have no partner.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · The pilgrim's announcement of his arrival for Hajj or Umrah · Entry 233
duas.chapterTitle: The pilgrim's announcement of his arrival for Hajj or Umrah

duas.title: Invocation to be recited between the Yemenite Corner and the Black Stone
duas.arabic: ﴿رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ﴾
duas.transliteration: Rabbanā ātinā fī ad-dunyā ḥasanatan wa fī l-ʾākhirati ḥasanatan wa qinā ʿadhāba an-nār
duas.translation: Our Lord, give us what is good in this world and what is good in the Hereafter, and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Invocation to be recited between the Yemenite Corner and the Black Stone · Entry 235
duas.chapterTitle: Invocation to be recited between the Yemenite Corner and the Black Stone

duas.title: Invocation to be recited while standing at Safa and Marwah
duas.arabic: ﴿إِنَّ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةَ مِنْ شَعَآئِرِ اللَّهِ﴾ أَبْدَأُ بِمَا بَدَأَ اللَّهُ بِهِ
duas.transliteration: Inna aṣ-ṣafā wa-l-marwata min shaʿāʾiri llāhi abdaʾu bimā badaʾa llāhu bih
duas.translation: Indeed, Ṣafā and Marwah are among the symbols of Allah. I begin with what Allah began with.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Invocation to be recited while standing at Safa and Marwah · Entry 236
duas.chapterTitle: Invocation to be recited while standing at Safa and Marwah

duas.title: Invocation to be recited while standing at Safa and Marwah
duas.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
duas.transliteration: Lā ilāha illā llāhu, allāhu akbar
duas.translation: There is no deity worthy of worship except Allah. Allah is the Greatest.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Invocation to be recited while standing at Safa and Marwah · Entry 236
duas.chapterTitle: Invocation to be recited while standing at Safa and Marwah

duas.title: Invocation to be recited on the Day of Arafat
duas.arabic: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
duas.transliteration: Lā ilāha illā llāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lahu, lahu l-mulku walahu l-ḥamdu wahuwa ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīr
duas.translation: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner. To Him belongs all praise and sovereignty and He is over all things omnipotent.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Invocation to be recited on the Day of Arafat · Entry 237
duas.chapterTitle: Invocation to be recited on the Day of Arafat

duas.title: What to say when surprised or startled (1 of 2)
duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ!
duas.transliteration: Subḥāna llāh!
duas.translation: How perfect Allah is.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · What to say when surprised or startled · Entry 240
duas.chapterTitle: What to say when surprised or startled

duas.title: What to say when surprised or startled (2 of 2)
duas.arabic: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ!
duas.transliteration: Allāhu akbar!
duas.translation: Allah is the greatest.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · What to say when surprised or startled · Entry 241
duas.chapterTitle: What to say when surprised or startled

duas.title: What to say when you feel a pain in your body
duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ
duas.transliteration: Bismi llāh
duas.translation: In the name of Allah.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · What to say when you feel a pain in your body · Entry 243
duas.chapterTitle: What to say when you feel a pain in your body

duas.title: What to say when you feel a pain in your body
duas.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ وَقُدْرَتِهِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا أَجِدُ وَأُحَاذِرُ
duas.transliteration: Aʿūdhu bi-llāhi wa qudratihi min sharri mā ajidu wa uḥādhir
duas.translation: I seek refuge in Allah and His power from the evil of what I feel and fear.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · What to say when you feel a pain in your body · Entry 243
duas.chapterTitle: What to say when you feel a pain in your body

duas.title: What to say when you feel frightened
duas.arabic: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ!
duas.transliteration: Lā ilāha illā llāh!
duas.translation: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · What to say when you feel frightened · Entry 245
duas.chapterTitle: What to say when you feel frightened

duas.title: What to say when slaughtering or sacrificing an animal
duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ [اللَّهُمَّ مِنْكَ وَلَكَ] اللَّهُمَّ تَقَبَّلْ مِنِّي
duas.transliteration: Bismi llāhi wa-llāhu akbaru llāhumma minka walaka llāhumma taqabbal minnī
duas.translation: In the name of Allah, and Allah is the greatest. O Allah, it is from You and belongs to You, O Allah, accept this from me.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · What to say when slaughtering or sacrificing an animal · Entry 246
duas.chapterTitle: What to say when slaughtering or sacrificing an animal

duas.title: What to say to foil the devil's plots
duas.arabic: أَعُوذُ بكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ الَّتِي لاَ يُجَاوِزُهُنَّ بَرٌّ وَلاَ فَاجِرٌ: مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ، وَبَرَأَ وَذَرَأَ، وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا يَنْزِلُ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ، وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا يَعْرُجُ فيهَا، وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا ذَرَأَ فِي الْأَرْضِ، وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا يَخْرُجُ مِنْهَا، وَمِنْ شَرِّ فِتَنِ اللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ، وَمِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ طَارِقٍ إِلاَّ طَارِقاً يَطْرُقُ بِخَيْرٍ يَا رَحْمَنُ
duas.transliteration: Aʿūdhu bkalimāti llāhi at-tāmmāti allatī lā yujāwizuhunna barrun walā fājirun: min sharri mā khalaqa, wa baraʾa wa dharaʾa, wamin sharri mā yanzilu mina as-samāʾi, wamin sharri mā yaʿruju fyhā, wamin sharri mā dharaʾa fī l-ʾarḍi, wamin sharri mā yakhruju minhā, wamin sharri fitani l-layli wa an-nahāri, wamin sharri kulli ṭāriqin illā ṭāriqan yaṭruqu bi-khayrin yā raḥmān
duas.translation: I take refuge within Allah’s perfect words which no righteous or unrighteous person can transgress, from all the evil that He has created, made and originated. I take refuge from the evil that descends from the sky and the evil that rises up to it. I take refuge from the evil that is spread on Earth and the evil that springs from her, and I take refuge from the evil of the tribulations of night and day, and the evil of one who visits at night except the one who brings good, O Merciful One.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · What to say to foil the devil's plots · Entry 247
duas.chapterTitle: What to say to foil the devil's plots

duas.title: Repentance and seeking forgiveness (3 of 6)
duas.arabic: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ الْعَظيمَ الَّذِي لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ الْحَيُّ القَيّوُمُ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيهِ
duas.transliteration: Astaghfiru llāha l-ʿaẓyma alladhī lā ilāha illā huwa l-ḥayyu l-qayywumu wa atūbu ilayh
duas.translation: I seek Allah’s forgiveness, besides whom, none has the right to be worshipped except He, The Ever Living, The Self-Subsisting and Supporter of all, and I turn to Him in repentance.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · Repentance and seeking forgiveness · Entry 250
duas.chapterTitle: Repentance and seeking forgiveness

duas.title: The excellence of remembering Allah (1 of 12)
duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ
duas.transliteration: Subḥāna llāhi wa bi-ḥamdih
duas.translation: How perfect Allah is and I praise Him.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · The excellence of remembering Allah · Entry 254
duas.chapterTitle: The excellence of remembering Allah

duas.title: The excellence of remembering Allah (2 of 12)
duas.arabic: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ، وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
duas.transliteration: Lā ilāha illā llāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lahu, lahu l-mulku, walahu l-ḥamdu, wahuwa ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīr
duas.translation: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner. To Him belongs all sovereignty and praise and He is over all things omnipotent.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · The excellence of remembering Allah · Entry 255
duas.chapterTitle: The excellence of remembering Allah

duas.title: The excellence of remembering Allah (3 of 12)
duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ، سُبْحانَ اللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ
duas.transliteration: Subḥāna llāhi wa bi-ḥamdihi, subḥna llāhi l-ʿaẓīm
duas.translation: How perfect Allah is and I praise Him. How perfect Allah is, The Supreme.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · The excellence of remembering Allah · Entry 256
duas.chapterTitle: The excellence of remembering Allah

duas.title: The excellence of remembering Allah (4 of 12)
duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، وَلاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ، وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
duas.transliteration: Subḥāna llāhi, wa-l-ḥamdu li-llāhi, walā ilāha illā llāhu, wa-llāhu akbar
duas.translation: How perfect Allah is, and all praise is for Allah. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, and Allah is the greatest.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · The excellence of remembering Allah · Entry 257
duas.chapterTitle: The excellence of remembering Allah

duas.title: The excellence of remembering Allah (6 of 12)
duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ
duas.transliteration: Subḥāna llāhi l-ʿaẓīmi wa bi-ḥamdih
duas.translation: How perfect Allah is. The Supreme, and I praise Him.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · The excellence of remembering Allah · Entry 259
duas.chapterTitle: The excellence of remembering Allah

duas.title: The excellence of remembering Allah (7 of 12)
duas.arabic: لاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِاللَّهِ
duas.transliteration: Lā ḥawla walā quwwata illā bi-llāh
duas.translation: There is no might nor power except with Allah.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · The excellence of remembering Allah · Entry 260
duas.chapterTitle: The excellence of remembering Allah

duas.title: The excellence of remembering Allah (8 of 12)
duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، وَلاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ، وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
duas.transliteration: Subḥāna llāhi, wa-l-ḥamdu li-llāhi, walā ilāha illā llāhu, wa-llāhu akbar
duas.translation: How perfect Allah is, all praise is for Allah. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah and Allah is the greatest.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · The excellence of remembering Allah · Entry 261
duas.chapterTitle: The excellence of remembering Allah

duas.title: The excellence of remembering Allah (9 of 12)
duas.arabic: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ كَبِيراً، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ كَثِيراً، سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ رَبِّ العَالَمِينَ، لاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِاللَّهِ الْعَزِيزِ الْحَكِيمِ
duas.transliteration: Lā ilāha illā llāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lahu, allāhu akbaru ka-bi-yran, wa-l-ḥamdu li-llāhi ka-thīran, subḥāna llāhi rabbi l-ʿālamīna, lā ḥawla walā quwwata illā bi-llāhi l-ʿazīzi l-ḥakīm
duas.translation: There is no deity worthy of worship except Allah alone, without partner. Allah is the Greatest—supremely great. Abundant praise belongs to Allah. Glory be to Allah, Lord of the worlds. There is no power and no strength except through Allah, the Almighty, the All-Wise.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · The excellence of remembering Allah · Entry 262
duas.chapterTitle: The excellence of remembering Allah

duas.title: The excellence of remembering Allah (9 of 12)
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي، وَارْحَمْنِي، وَاهْدِنِي، وَارْزُقْنِي
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma ighfir lī, wa irḥamnī, wa ihdinī, wa irzuqnī
duas.translation: O Allah, forgive me, have mercy on me, guide me, and provide for me.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · The excellence of remembering Allah · Entry 262
duas.chapterTitle: The excellence of remembering Allah

duas.title: The excellence of remembering Allah (10 of 12)
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرِ لِي، وَارْحَمْنِي، وَاهْدِنِي، وَعَافِنِي وَارْزُقْنِي
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma ighfiri lī, wa irḥamnī, wa ihdinī, wa ʿāfinī wa irzuqnī
duas.translation: O Allah, forgive me, have mercy upon me, guide me, give me health and grant me sustenance.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · The excellence of remembering Allah · Entry 263
duas.chapterTitle: The excellence of remembering Allah

duas.title: The excellence of remembering Allah (11 of 12)
duas.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ
duas.transliteration: Al-ḥamdu li-llāh
duas.translation: All praise is for Allah.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · The excellence of remembering Allah · Entry 264
duas.chapterTitle: The excellence of remembering Allah

duas.title: The excellence of remembering Allah (11 of 12)
duas.arabic: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ
duas.transliteration: Lā ilāha illā llāh
duas.translation: There is no deity worthy of worship except Allah.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · The excellence of remembering Allah · Entry 264
duas.chapterTitle: The excellence of remembering Allah

duas.title: The excellence of remembering Allah (12 of 12)
duas.arabic: سبحان الله والحمد لله، ولا إله إلا الله،والله أكبر،و لا حول ولا قوة إلا بالله
duas.transliteration: Sbḥn allāh wlḥmd li-llāh wl ilāh l allāh wllh kbr w l ḥwl wl qwh l bllh
duas.translation: 'Glorified is Allah', and'The praise is for Allah', and'but There is none worthy of worship Allah', and'Allah is the Most Great', and'There is no power and no might except by Allah'
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim · The excellence of remembering Allah · Entry 265
duas.chapterTitle: The excellence of remembering Allah
